blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Foundation models are built through large-scale pretraining, often followed by post-training, and are then adapted to specific tasks and behaviors. But, does the adaptation add truly new capabilities, or the base model already holds it? We decompose the update induced by different adaptations into a component shared across all inputs and a residual that varies with the input. We find that the shared component suffices for most of the adaptation gain and can be learned directly: a shift adapter that learns a constant vector per layer, identical for every input, reproduces the behavior of LoRA and full fine-tuning. We call this the potentiality principle of foundation models: the base model already contains the capacity needed for task-specific expertise. To adapt to a new task, the model just needs to be actualized, i.e., pushed in a certain direction via a constant, input-independent shift. We show the implications of this principle on parameter-efficient adaptation, steering, and convergence across models, and how it explains the neural thickets phenomenon.
blocks.zh: 基础模型是通过大规模前期训练来构建的,通常之后是后期训练,然后被适应具体的任务和行为. 但是,适应是否增加了真正的新能力,还是基础模型已经掌握了? 我们把因不同调整而导致的更新分解成所有投入共享的组成部分和随投入而变化的剩余部分。 我们发现,共享的组件足以满足大多数适应增益,并且可以直接学习:一个能学习每层恒定向量的转动适配器,与每层输入完全相同,复制了LORA的行为并完全微调. 我们称这是基础模型的潜力原则:基础模型已经包含了针对具体任务的专门知识所需的能力。 为了适应新的任务,模型只需要被实现,即通过不断的,输入独立的转变来向某个方向推进. 我们显示了这一原则对参数效率高的适应、引导和各种模型的趋同的影响,以及它如何解释神经厚度现象。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1: The Potentiality and Actuality Principle. A foundation model holds task-specific expertise (hills) in potentiality . For most tasks, a single shift, same for every input (arrow), is all it takes to move the inputs to one of these tasks. We call this process actualization .
blocks.zh: 图1:潜力和作用原则。 基金会模式具有特定任务的专门知识(山)的潜力。 对于大多数任务来说,将输入移到其中一项任务只需要一个单一的转变,每个输入(狭义)相同. 我们称这一进程为实际化。

blocks.en: The rapid progress of foundation models ( Bommasani et al., 2021 ) has been driven by large-scale pre-training on general-domain data, often followed by post-training and finally adaptation to a specific task, behavior, or domain. To adapt these models effectively, different adaptation strategies have been explored. The earliest form of adaptation is full fine-tuning, which updates all model parameters on a given task ( Howard and Ruder, 2018 ; Devlin et al., 2019 ) . To reduce computational cost, parameter-efficient methods freeze the model and learn only a small update, such as the widely used low-rank update of LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Li and Liang, 2021 ; Lester et al., 2021 ) . In-context learning showed that it is possible to adapt by eliminating parameter updates altogether and instead conditioning the model on demonstrations in the prompt ( Brown et al., 2020 ) . Similarly, activation steering leaves the model parameters unchanged, but adapts model behavior at inference time by directly modifying hidden activations ( Turner et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2023 ) . So far, the field has largely treated these adaptation strategies as different tools suited for different settings.
blocks.zh: 基础模型的快速进步(Bommasani等人,2021年)是由关于一般领域数据的大规模预训所推动的,之后经常是后训,最后适应特定的任务,行为,或域. 为了有效地调整这些模型,探讨了不同的适应战略。 最早的适应形式是全面微调,它更新了特定任务的所有模型参数(Howard and Ruder, 2018;Devlin等人, 2019). 为降低计算成本,参数高效方法冻结了模型,只学习少量更新,如广泛使用的低级更新LORA(Hu等人,2022年;Liang和Liang,2021年;Lester等人,2021年). 校正中学习显示,通过完全取消参数更新,而是在即时(Brown等人,2020年)对模型进行调适是可能的。 同样,激活方向让模型参数保持不变,但在推论时通过直接修改隐藏激活来适应模型行为(Turner等人,2023年;Rimsky等人,2024年;Zou等人,2023年). 迄今为止,实地基本上将这些适应战略视为适合不同环境的不同工具。

blocks.en: But what is the underlying mechanism of adaptation, and what changes inside a foundation model when it gains task-specific expertise? While these questions remain largely unanswered, a growing body of evidence suggests that task adaptation may rely on small changes to a pre-trained model. In particular, fine-tuning succeeds when the update is restricted to a small parameter space ( Aghajanyan et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) , or even when it is restricted to biases with a new task layer ( Ben Zaken et al., 2022 ) or to 0.01 % 0.01\% of the weights ( Panigrahi et al., 2023 ) . Recent work on neural thickets even showed that random perturbations of pre-trained weights find dense sets of diverse task experts ( Gan and Isola, 2026 ) . Why such small interventions are sufficient to produce task-specific expertise remains poorly understood. Previous work has suggested that we are in the elicitation overhang: AI models have untapped capabilities, and we do not know how to elicit them from frontier models ( Turner et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 但是,什么是适应的基本机制,当基础模型获得特定任务的专门知识时,它内部有什么变化? 虽然这些问题基本上仍未得到答复,但越来越多的证据表明,任务调整可能依赖于对预先培训过的模型的小改动。 特别是,当更新仅限于一个小参数空间时(Aghajanyan等人,2021年;Hu等人,2022年),或者甚至仅限于带有新任务层的偏差时(Ben Zaken等人,2022年),或者在0.01%的重量时(Panigrahi等人,2023年),微调成功。 最近关于神经厚度的研究甚至表明,预先训练的重量的随机扰动会发现密集的一组多样的任务专家(Gan and Isola, 2026). 为何如此小的干预措施足以产生针对具体任务的专门知识,人们仍然不了解。 以前的工作表明,我们正处在悬疑之中: AI模型具有未开发的能力,我们不知道如何从前沿模型中引出它们(Turner等人,2023年)。

blocks.en:
To understand the adaptation mechanism, we first decompose the update that LoRA learns into two components: (i) a component shared across all inputs, and (ii) an input-specific component, i.e. , a residual that varies with the input.
Across many diverse tasks, we find that most of the adaptation gain can be reached without input-specific adaptation: the update vectors point in nearly the same direction independent of the input. Quantitatively, on 26 benchmarks and 18 language models from 7 architecture families, the component shared across all the inputs preserves 85 % 85\% of the adapted behavior. Motivated by this finding, we adapt the model via shift adapter , a simple adaptation mechanism that learns only the shared part of adaptation: a single vector per layer, constant for every input. Since the update a shift adapter learns is added unchanged to every input, unlike the update of LoRA, bias-only training, or full fine-tuning, every difference between the answers to two inputs is computed by the frozen base model. The shift adapter matches LoRA’s performance across 17 tasks and 18 language models, with roughly two orders of magnitude fewer parameters. The same holds for adaptation without the rank constraint and for full fine-tuning, where the savings are even larger.
blocks.zh:
为了了解适应机制,我们首先将LORA所学习的更新分解为两个部分:(一)一个在所有投入中共享的组件,以及(二)一个特定投入的组件,即一个随投入而变化的剩余部分.
在许多不同的任务中,我们发现,大多数适应收益都可以在没有具体投入适应的情况下实现:更新矢量指向与投入无关的几乎相同的方向。 从数量上看,在来自7个建筑家族的26个基准和18个语言模型中,在所有投入中共享的部分保留了85%的适应行为。 基于这个发现,我们通过转动适配器来调整模型, 一个简单的适应机制,它只学习适应的共享部分:每层一个单一的矢量,每个输入的常数。 由于更新一个转动适配器的学习在每一个输入中都无变化地添加,与更新LORA,只偏偏训练,或完全微调不同,两个输入的答案之间的每个差异都通过冷冻基模型计算. 转向适配器与LORA在17项任务和18种语言模型上的性能相匹配,大约两个数量级的参数更少. 在没有等级限制的情况下进行适应和全面微调也是如此,在这些地方,节余更大。

blocks.en: These findings suggest that the base model itself already has the capacity for diverse task-specific expertise and only a small push in the right direction is needed to put this capacity to work. We call this the potentiality principle of foundation models, and the push towards a direction to gain task-specific expertise the actualization of a foundation model. The terms reflect Aristotle’s distinction between potentiality ( dunamis ), a capacity that a thing holds without exercising it, and actuality ( energeia ), that same capacity at work ( Aristotle, ca. 350 B.C.E. ) . In this terminology, a pre-trained foundation model holds different task-specific expertise as potentiality, and that expertise can be actualized via a constant shift that moves the model into a state where it can be exercised ( Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,这一基本模式本身已经具备掌握不同任务的专门知识的能力,只需朝正确的方向小幅推进,即可使这种能力发挥作用。 我们称这为基础模型的潜力原则,推动实现基础模型,以获得具体任务的专门知识。 这些术语反映了亚里士多德在潜在性(dunamis)与实际性(engeia)之间的区别,亚里士多德在工作中具有同样的能力(公元前350年)。 在这个术语中,经过预先培训的基础模型具有不同的任务特有专长作为潜力,而这种专长可以通过不断的转变来实现,这种转变将模型推向可以行使的状态(图1)。

blocks.en:
The potentiality and actuality principle has implications on fine-tuning , steering , neural thickets , and model convergence . It provides an explanation for why fine-tuning can succeed in a tiny parameter space ( Aghajanyan et al., 2021 ; Hu et al., 2022 ; Ben Zaken et al., 2022 ; Sinii et al., 2025 ) , identifies the trained shift as a reference direction for steering ( Turner et al., 2023 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2023 ) , relates the dense task experts found by random perturbations to states that actualize existing capacities ( Gan and Isola, 2026 ) , and shows that the states of different models grow alike as the models gain capability ( Huh et al., 2024 ; Gröger et al., 2026 ) .
In each case the mechanism is the same: a state that actualizes a capacity the model already has.
blocks.zh:
潜在性和实际性原则对微调、引导、神经厚度和模型趋同都有影响。 它解释了为何微调能够在微小参数空间中取得成功(Aghajanyan等人,2021年;Hu等人,2022年;Ben Zaken等人,2022年;Sinii等人,2025年),确定了经过培训的转变作为指导的参考方向(Turner等人,2023年;Rimsky等人,2024年;Zou等人,2023年),将随机扰动发现的密集任务专家与实现现有能力的国家(Gan和Isola,2026年)联系起来,并表明随着模型能力的增强,不同模型的状态也在增长(Huh等人,2024年;Gröger等人,2026年)。
在每一种情况下,机制都是相同的:即实现模型已经具备的能力的状态。

blocks.en: 2 Shared and input-specific components of adaptation
blocks.zh: 2. 适应的共同和具体投入组成部分

blocks.en:
Imagine that a foundation model already holds the task-specific expertise in potentiality and that adaptation only has to actualize it by selecting the desired expertise.
In such a case, the selection would be the same for every input of the task, i.e. , the update learned during adaptation would not vary across inputs, or would vary only slightly.
blocks.zh:
想象一下,一个基础模型已经具备了具体任务的专门知识的潜力,适应只能通过选择所需的专门知识来实现。
在这种情况下,对于任务的每一项投入,选择相同,即适应期间获得的更新不会因投入而异,或只略有变化。

blocks.en:
To test this hypothesis, we split the change that adaptation does into two components: (i) a component shared by all the inputs, and (ii) an input-specific component. We measure how much of each component changes during adaptation, and evaluate the model using only one of the two components to determine which component the adaptation relies on.
We explore this for different kinds of adaptation: LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , the same update trained without the rank constraint (the unconstrained update ), full fine-tuning ( Howard and Ruder, 2018 ; Devlin et al., 2019 ) , and in-context learning ( Brown et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
为了测试这个假设,我们把适应确实发生的变化分为两个部分:(一)所有投入共享的成分,以及(二)特定投入的成分. 我们衡量每个组成部分在适应期间的改变程度,并仅使用两个组成部分中的一个评估模型,以确定适应所依赖的成分。
我们为不同种类的改编探索:LORA(Hu et al.,2022年),同一更新训练没有军衔限制(不受约束的更新),全面微调(Howard and Ruder,2018年;Devlin et al.,2019年),以及内语学习(Brown et al.,2020年).

blocks.en:
Experimental setup. We apply the decomposition to trained LoRAs of rank 8 8 , on 18 models from 7 architecture families: 14 instruction-tuned, 3 base models, and 1 trained on instructions but not preference-tuned ( Section C.2 ).
Each model is adapted on 26 benchmarks from two categories: (i) 17 reasoning and knowledge tasks with labeled answers which test what the model knows and how it reasons, and (ii) 9 behaviors including 4 traits which ask for the answer in a given language, persona, or format, 3 transformations which ask the model to apply a specific rule to the input, and 2 maps, a letter cipher and a lookup table, which assign each input an answer by an arbitrary rule. Nothing in pretraining fixes that rule, so the maps are the one category the model can only learn from the adaptation data. We refer to the first category as tasks , and the second as behaviors . The tasks span commonsense reasoning, text classification, subject-specific question answering, and recent complex reasoning benchmarks (e.g., BoolQ, HellaSwag, MMLU-Pro, and SuperGPQA), following the protocol of Hu et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2024b) (details Section C.3 ). Tasks are evaluated by accuracy on their evaluation splits, while behaviors are evaluated on 1,000 1{,}000 held-out generations by adherence to the target behavior. For each intervention, we report the fraction of the adaptation gain over the base model that is retained. Unless stated otherwise, results are averaged over 3 seeds.
blocks.zh:
实验设置. 我们把分解法用于训练8级8级的LORA, 使用来自7个建筑家族的18种模型:14种教学调试,3种基础模型,1种教学调试,但没有调整偏好(C.2节)。
每个模型根据两类的26个基准进行调整:(一) 17个推理和知识任务,附有标签的答案,测试模型知道什么及其原因;(二) 9个行为,包括以特定语言、人称或格式要求答案的4个特征,3个要求模型对输入适用特定规则的转变,2个地图、字母密码和检索表,这些都按照任意规则为每个输入分配答案。 在预训中没有任何东西可以修正这个规则,所以地图是模型只能从适应数据中学习的一类. 我们把第一类称为任务,而第二类称为行为。 任务范围包括常见推理,文字分类,主题特定问题答案,以及最近复杂的推理基准(如BoulQ,HelaSwag,MMLU-Pro,和SuperGPQA),遵循Hu等人的协议(2023);刘等人(2024b)(详见C.3节). 任务在评价分拆时以准确性来评价,而行为则通过坚持目标行为来评价1000 1{,}000个持有的世代. 对于每一项干预措施,我们报告相对于保留的基础模型而言,适应收益的一小部分。 除非另有说明,结果平均超过3个种子。

Observation. Across 17 tasks and 18 models, each input’s field points along the shared component at a cosine of 0.91 0.91 on average, and the shared component holds 83 % 83\% of the field’s energy ( Figure 3 a, all models in Section D.2 ).
Across the 9 behaviors and 18 models, the cosine is 0.84 0.84 and the shared component holds 71 % 71\% of the field’s energy ( Section D.5 ). The same decomposition applies to the adapter’s own output a ⁡ ( x ) = Δ ​ W ​ z ​ ( x ) a(x)=\Delta Wz(x) , before it propagates through the model. There the shared component a ¯ \bar{a} holds 89 % 89\% of the energy on these behaviors and 89 % 89\% on the tasks, averaged over every adapted matrix ( Section D.3 ). The fields of different inputs thus point in nearly the same direction: LoRA moves every input mostly the same way, and the part of the change that depends on the input holds the smaller share of the energy on both tasks and behaviors.
blocks.zh:
观察. 在17项任务和18个模型中,每个输入的场点沿共享部分平均为0.91 0.91 ,共享部分拥有83%的实地能量(图3 a,D.2节所有模型)。
在9个行为和18个模型中, 余弦为0.84 0.84, 共享部分拥有71%的能量(D.5节)。 同样的分解适用于适配器自己的输出一个 (x) = Δ W z(x) a(x) =\ Delta Wz(x),然后通过模型传播. 共享的“ bar{a}” 包含89%的这些行为的能量和89%的89%的任务,平均为每个调整后的矩阵(D.3节)。 因此,不同投入领域的方向几乎相同: LORA移动每个输入的方式大多相同,取决于输入的部分变化在任务和行为上占据能量的较小份额.

blocks.en:
Interventions. We next explored which component the LoRA gains come from using two interventions: (i) keeping only the shared component, and (ii) removing the shared component. In the first intervention, the same shared vector a ¯ \bar{a} replaces a ⁡ ( x ) a(x) in Equation 3 at every adapted matrix and at every position so the adapter becomes one constant vector per matrix. In the second intervention, a ¯ \bar{a} is subtracted at every position, so the model relies only on the input-specific component a ~ ​ ( x ) \widetilde{a}(x) .
The former tests whether the shared component alone produces the adapted behavior on new inputs, while the latter tests whether the trained adapter depends on the shared component.
blocks.zh:
干预。 接下来,我们探讨了LORA收益的哪些部分来自使用两种干预措施:(一) 仅保留共享部分,以及(二) 删除共享部分。 在第一次干预中,一个\bar{a}的同一共享矢量在每一个经调整的矩阵和每个位置替换第3个方程式中的QQ(x) a(x),使适配器成为每个矩阵的一个恒定矢量. 在第二次干预中,每个位置都减去一个\bar{a},所以模型只依赖输入特定组件一个~(x)\广度{a}(x).
前者测试共享组件是否单独在新投入上产生适应行为,而后者测试训练有素的适配器是否依赖于共享组件.

blocks.en:
Over all 18 models, keeping only the shared component keeps on average 85 % 85\% of the adapter’s gain on the tasks, and removing it keeps 61 % 61\% ( Figure 3 b, Figure 12 ). Two other ways of removing it keep 84 % 84\% and 75 % 75\% ( Section D.2 ), so on the tasks each component alone can produce most of the gain.
All models keep more with the shared component alone than without it. The only exception is Mistral-7B, which relies on both components about equally.
The 3 models that never received instruction tuning keep 85 % 85\% of the gain with only the shared component and 59 % 59\% with it removed, against 87 % 87\% and 63 % 63\% on the instruction-tuned models, so the reliance on the shared component is not a product of instruction tuning ( Section D.4 ).
The same holds for behaviors, where the shared component alone keeps 86 % 86\% of the gain on average, and removing it keeps 33 % 33\% on the traits, 57 % 57\% on the transformations, and 26 % 26\% on the maps. The update matters while the model reads the input, not while it writes the answer: with the adapter switched on only for the input tokens, LoRA keeps 83 % 83\% of its gain, and only for the answer tokens 12 % 12\% , on 18 models and 6 tasks ( Section D.7 ). So most of what LoRA gains comes from one vector per matrix that is the same for every input, added while the model reads the input.
blocks.zh:
在所有18种模型中,只有共享组件能平均保持85 % 的适配器任务收益,而去除时则保持61% 的61 %(图3b,图12 ) 。 另外两种移除方式保留了84%的84\%和75%的75\%(D.2节),因此每个组件单独的任务就可以产生大部分收益.
所有模型都只保留共享组件,而不是没有它。 唯一的例外是Mistral-7B,两者的依赖程度大致相同.
从未接受过指令调制的3种模式保留了85%的85%的增益,只有共享部分,59%的59%被移除,而87%的87%和63%的63%在指令调制模式上,因此依赖共享部分不是指令调制的产物(D.4节)。
行为上也是如此,仅共享部分就平均保留了86%的86 % 收益,去除部分保留了33%的33 % 特征,57%的57 % 转型,26%的26 % 地图。 更新在模型读取输入时很重要,而不是在它写出答案时:由于适配器只打开输入符,LORA保留其收益的83%83\%,而仅用于回答符的12%12\%,在18个模型和6个任务上(D.7节). 所以LORA获得的收益大多来自每个矩阵一个矢量,每个输入都相同,加起来,而模型读取输入.

blocks.en:
We next ask whether adaptation still relies on a shared component when producing the correct behavior requires input-specific computation. The 3 transformations, such as copying the input or returning its last word, apply a rule to the input that the base model can already follow, so the computation that varies with the input is the model’s own.
Surprisingly, even there, keeping only the shared component keeps 92 % 92\% of the gain, as much as on the 4 traits, which ask for the same behavior on every input ( 88 % 88\% , Figure 3 c).
The 2 maps apply a rule fixed by an arbitrary key, a substitution of the first letter, or a table of words, which the model can only learn during adaptation, and they keep the least, 74 % 74\% of adaptation gain.
This indicates that gains of the shared component fall when the base model does not hold the rule. On the maps, what adaptation adds is the table, and what the base model provides is the ability to use one: a shift adapter trained on a map answers as well as LoRA does, and the table it stores produces nothing on its own ( Section E.5 ).
blocks.zh:
我们接下来问,在产生正确行为时,适应是否仍然依赖于一个共享的组件,需要特定的输入计算。 3个变换,如复制输入或返回其最后一个字,对基准模型已经可以遵循的输入应用一条规则,因此随输入而变化的计算是模型自己的.
令人惊讶的是,即使在那里,只有共享组件保留了92%的92QQ收益,就像4个特征一样,4个特征要求每个输入都采取相同的行为(88%88QQ,图3c).
2地图应用了任意键设定的规则,取代第一个字母,或文字表,模型只能在适应过程中学习,它们保留了最小的74%的74QQ适应收益.
这表明,当基准模式不守规则时,共享组件的收益就会下降。 在地图上,适应增加的是表格,基础模型提供的能力是使用一个:一个在地图答案上受过训练的转向适配器以及LORA做的,它储存的表格本身没有产生任何效果(E.5节).

blocks.en:
Unconstrained update. To investigate the influence of the low-rank update on the decomposition result, we train the same update without the low-rank factorization, so that Δ ​ W \Delta W is a full matrix at every adapted matrix, on the same 18 models, the 4 traits, and the 3 transformations.
After training, the update has high rank (median stable rank 47 47 * * * Stable rank is ∥ W ∥ F 2 / ∥ W ∥ 2 2 \lVert W\rVert_{F}^{2}/\lVert W\rVert_{2}^{2} , the squared Frobenius norm over the squared spectral norm. ) and raises adherence as much as LoRA does ( 0.44 0.44 against 0.43 0.43 above the base model), yet its shared component holds 95 % 95\% of the energy of what it adds, against LoRA’s 90 % 90\% .
Without the shared component, it keeps 26 % 26\% of the adaptation gain on traits and 49 % 49\% on transformations, against LoRA’s 39 % 39\% and 59 % 59\% . With the shared component alone, it keeps 69 % 69\% against LoRA’s 87 % 87\% on traits ( Section D.9 ).
The shared component is therefore not a product of the low-rank constraint: with the constraint gone, it grows from 90 % 90\% of the energy to 95 % 95\% , while the behavior relies on it slightly less.

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning and ICL. We further examine whether full fine-tuning and in-context learning (ICL) rely on the shared component in the same way LoRA does.
Full fine-tuning changes every weight, so its update cannot be decomposed and intervened on as LoRA’s. However, we can examine the structure of its adaptation field: we find that adaptation via fine-tuning results in nearly the same shared structure as LoRA. Across the 17 tasks and 18 models, its cosine is 0.90 0.90 , and its field share is 0.81 0.81 on average, compared to 0.91 0.91 and 0.83 0.83 for LoRA ( Section E.2 ), suggesting that all inputs are moved in the same direction, just like we observe for LoRA.
In contrast, ICL relies more on input-dependent changes: its shared component keeps less of the gain than LoRA’s on traits, transformations and tasks, and its shared component remains nearly orthogonal to LoRA’s even as their induced hidden-state changes become more aligned in later layers ( Section D.10 ). This suggests that ICL reaches similar behaviors through a different, more input-dependent route. Additional results are in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
微调与ICL. 我们进一步审查全面微调和内涵学习是否以LORA同样的方式依赖共享部分。
完全微调改变每个重量, 然而,我们可以研究其适应领域的结构:我们发现,通过微调调整的适应结果与LORA几乎相同。 在整个17项任务和18种模型中,其余弦为0.90 0.90,其外地份额平均为0.81 0.81,而LORA(E.2节)为0.91 0.91和0.83 0.83,这表明所有输入都朝同一方向移动,就像我们为LORA观察到的那样.
相比之下,ICL更依赖于依赖输入的改变:其共享组件在特征,变换和任务上保持比LORA少的收益,其共享组件在LORA诱导的隐藏状态变化在后几层更趋一致(D.10节)时仍然几乎与LORA的正交. 这表明ICL通过不同,更依赖输入的路径达到类似的行为. 其他结果见附录D。

blocks.en:
In the previous section, we showed that we can preserve most of the adaptation gain by keeping only the component shared across the inputs. If this shared component is indeed sufficient to produce the adapted behavior or solve a task, then we should be able to learn such a change directly.
We therefore define a shift adapter : one learned vector b ℓ ∈ ℝ d b_{\ell}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} per layer ℓ \ell , added to the hidden state of every input at every position.
Its only operation is a constant push.
The shift applies the same push to every input and moves the model into a state in which its expertise for one task is actualized. We call such a state an actualizing state . Note that a constant parameter does not mean a constant effect: the layers above process the push together with an input-dependent hidden state, so the same push can move different inputs differently, and they can reach different actualizing states. However, the capacity to move inputs differently lies in the base model, and the shift only actualizes it via a constant push. This sets the shift adapter apart from LoRA, bias training and full fine-tuning, which can change the output of a block differently for each input ( Section B.3 ).
This gives an operational distinction: a capacity is actualized when a constant vector suffices on inputs never seen in training, and memorized when the gain holds only on the items seen in training ( Sections E.6 and F.12 ).
blocks.zh:
在上一节中,我们表明,我们只能保留所有投入中共享的部分,从而能够保持大部分适应收益。 如果这个共享的组件确实足以产生适应行为或解决一个任务,那么我们就应该能够直接学习这样的变化.
因此,我们定义了一个变位适配器:一个已学习的矢量 b l ∈ R  d ell ell ell ell ell }\ }\ }\ }\ { { { { { { }^{ }^{ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈  position  position ∈  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position  position ∈ ∈  position  position ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈ ∈

这种转变对每一项投入都采用同样的推力,并将模型推向其一项任务的专门知识得以实现的状态。 我们称这种状态为实际状态。 注意一个恒定参数并不意味着一个恒定效应:上面的层将推力与一个依赖输入的隐藏状态一起处理,因此同样的推力可以不同地移动不同的输入,它们可以达到不同的实际状态. 然而,转移不同投入的能力则在于基模型,而转移只能通过不断的推力实现. 这使得转动适配器与LORA,偏差培训和全微调不同,这可以改变每个输入区块的输出(B.3节).
这在业务上作了区分:当培训中从未看到的投入的恒定矢量足够时,即能实现能力,当收益只存在于培训中的项目时,即能记住能力(E.6和F.12节)。

blocks.en:
Shift adapter matches LoRA. We compare the shift adapter to LoRAs of rank { 1 , 4 , 8 , 16 , 64 } \{1,4,8,16,64\} on the 17 tasks across 18 models, with the training and evaluation protocol of Section E.1 .
The shift reaches a mean accuracy of 0.746 0.746 , against 0.745 0.745 for a LoRA of rank 8 and 0.620 0.620 for the base model ( Figure 4 a), recovering all of the LoRA’s gain, with L × d L\times d trainable parameters, 0.04 0.04 M on Qwen2.5-1.5B compared to 9.2 9.2 M for LoRA with rank 8.
The same holds at every rank: from rank 1 1 to rank 64 64 the LoRA’s accuracy moves by 0.003 0.003 while its parameters grow from 1.2 1.2 M to 74 74 M on that model.
The shift stays within 0.012 0.012 of the rank-8 LoRA on any task and within 0.011 0.011 on any model, from 0.5 0.5 B to 26 26 B parameters ( Figure 4 b,c).
Training all weights reaches 0.718 0.718 under the protocol above, so the shift adapter is above full fine-tuning on every model.

Left, the cosine of each input’s field to its adapter’s own shared component, for the shift, the LoRA and a LoRA with random weights, on the 17 tasks and on the 9 behaviors. Right, the cosine of the LoRA’s shared component (LoRA and random LoRA) to the shift adapter, on the 17 tasks and on the 9 behaviors.
blocks.zh: 图5:独立改造推进方式相同. 平均95%的间隔 左,每个输入的字段的余弦到适配器自己的共享组件,用于转动,LORA和一个随机加权的LORA,用于17项任务和9项行为. 对,LORA共享组件的余弦(LORA和随机LORA)到转动适配器,17项任务和9项行为.

blocks.en:
The shift and LoRA agree on the actualizing direction. The shift adapter and LoRA are trained independently, so we next wondered whether they push the inputs along the same direction and finally reach the same actualizing state.
Across the 17 tasks and 18 models, the average cosine similarity of LoRA’s shared component and the shift adapter is 0.64 0.64 on average, while a LoRA with random weights gives 0.06 0.06 ( Section E.4 ). Across the 9 behaviors and 18 models, the cosine similarity is 0.53 0.53 on average, while a LoRA with random weights gives 0.07 0.07 compared to the shift adapter ( Figure 5 ). Every bar sits above its random counterpart: a LoRA with random weights reaches 0.84 0.84 on the tasks and 0.66 0.66 on the behaviors for the cosine to its own shared component, and only 0.06 0.06 and 0.07 0.07 for its cosine to the trained shift ( Figure 5 ).
If, instead of weighting each layer equally as before, we weight each layer by how far the shift adapter moves it, cosine similarity rises to 0.69 0.69 , and the random LoRA remains at 0.08 0.08 ( Section C.7 ).
The comparable performance and similar direction of the shift adapter and LoRA indicate that LoRA relies on the direction the shift adapter learns, even though it can vary its update with every input. Additional results are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
转变与LORA就实际化方向达成一致. 转向适配器和LORA是独立训练的,所以我们接下来想知道它们是否将输入向同一方向推进,最终达到相同的实际状态.
在17项任务和18项模型中,LORA共享组件和转向适配器的平均余弦相似度平均为0.64 0.64,而随机加权的LORA则给出0.06 0.06(E.4节)。 在整个9个行为和18个模型中,余弦的相似度平均为0.53 0.53,而一个随机加权的LORA给出了0.07 0.07,与转向适配器相比(图5). 每个条坐落在随机对应物之上:一个随机加权的LORA在任务上达到0.84 0.84,在余弦对自身共享成分的行为上达到0.66 0.66,在余弦对训练的转向上只有0.06 0.06和0.07(图5).
如果不是像以前一样对每一层进行同等的加权,而是按转向适配器移动的多远对每一层进行加权,则余弦相似度上升至0.69 0.69,随机的LORA保持在0.08(C.7节)。
转向适配器和LORA的可比较性能和类似方向表明,LORA依赖于转向适配器学习的方向,尽管它可以随每个输入而变化更新. 其他结果见附录E。

blocks.en: 4 The structure of actualization
blocks.zh: 页:1 实际化的结构

blocks.en:
Figure 6: The task-specific expertise forms during pretraining, and a shift actualizes it whenever it has formed. OLMo-2-7B at 15 15 checkpoints on the 17 tasks of Figure 4 .
Accuracy of the shift (solid) and of the base model with no adaptation (dashed) per task type: the 3 text classifications, the 4 commonsense question-answering tasks, the 3 science question-answering tasks, the 4 domain tasks, sentence completion, and the 2 expert question-answering tasks.
Bands are 95 % 95\% intervals. The per-task view is in Section F.1 .

图6:在预训期间,具体任务的专门知识表格,一旦形成,即实现转变。 OLMo-2-7B在15个检查站执行图4中的17项任务。
按任务类型分类的变换(固态)和没有适应(dashed)的基础模型的准确性:3文本分类,4常识问答任务,3科学问答任务,4域任务,句子完成,2专家问答任务.

blocks.en:
All these results indicate that the base model already holds task-specific expertise in potentiality, and adaptation can rely on a constant input-independent push to reach the state in which task-specific expertise can be actualized.
Together they form the two parts of the potentiality and actuality principle : (i) the base model holds the task-specific expertise in potentiality, and (ii) a constant shift can actualize the task-specific expertise of the base model.
In this section, we aim to better understand this principle. In particular, we aim to understand when, during training, the potentiality forms in the base model, and what geometry the actualizing region has.
blocks.zh:
所有这些结果都表明,基础模型已经具备了针对具体任务的专业知识的潜力,适应工作可以依靠不断的投入独立推动,以达到能够实现针对具体任务的专业知识的状态。
它们共同构成潜在性和实际性原则的两个部分:(一) 基准模型具有特定任务的专门知识,具有潜在性;(二) 不断转变可以实现基准模型的具体任务专门知识。
在本节中,我们的目的是更好地理解这一原则。 特别是,我们的目标是了解在培训期间,底模中的潜在形式,以及实际区域有哪些几何特征。

blocks.en:
When during training potentiality forms. If the base model holds the task-specific expertise in potentiality and a shift actualizes it, when during training does the potentiality form?
We investigate this question in OLMo-2-7B ( Team OLMo et al., 2025 ) , which has intermediate public checkpoints.
Specifically, we look at 15 checkpoints spanning its training: 5 from stage-one pretraining on Dolma ( Soldaini et al., 2024 ) between 1 1 B and 3,896 3{,}896 B tokens, 6 from the 50 50 B-token stage two, and 4 released base, supervised, preference-tuned, and instruct models.
At every checkpoint we repeat the comparison of Section 3 and the decomposition of Section 2 , on the 17 tasks ( Section F.1 ).
blocks.zh:
培训期间可能采用的形式。 如果基准模型具有特定任务的专门知识潜力,并发生转变,那么潜力在培训期间是何时形成的?
我们在OLMo-2-7B(OLMo et al.,2025年)中调查这一问题,该组设有中间公共检查站。
具体来说,我们检查了15个检查站,跨越培训范围:5个检查站来自多尔马的第一阶段预训 (Soldaini等人,2024年)在1 B和3,896 3{,}896之间 B令牌,从50个B-token二期的6个,以及4个放行的基座,监督,偏好调整,并指示模型.
在每个检查站,我们重复第3款的比较和第2款的分解,涉及17项任务(F.1节)。

blocks.en:
The analysis shows that the potentiality already forms during pretraining, at different points for different kinds of tasks ( Figure 6 ).
Text classification comes first, the shift adapter raises the base model’s accuracy on the 3 classifications from 0.57 0.57 to 0.86 0.86 already at 9 9 B tokens.
Science question answering, the domain tasks, sentence completion, and expert question answering arrive far later, and until 105 105 B tokens the adapted model does no better than answering with the most frequent label.
So the potentiality forms in the base model during stage-one pretraining, at different points for different kinds of tasks, and once a kind of task-specific expertise has formed, the shift actualizes it at every later checkpoint, through stage two and post-training alike.
blocks.zh:
分析表明,在预训期间,在不同地点,各种任务的潜力已经形成(图6)。
文字分类第一,转向适配器将基模在3个分类上的准确性从0.57 0.57提高到0.86 0.86,已经在9个B符号上.
科学问题回答,域名任务,句子完成,以及专家问题回答的到来很晚,直到105 105 B令牌,经过调整的模型不会比用最频繁的标签回答更好.
因此,在第一阶段预训期间,在不同类型的任务的不同点上,以及一旦形成某种特定任务的专门知识时,基模中的潜在性形式,在以后的每一个检查站,通过第二阶段和后期训练,都实现了这一转变。

blocks.en:
From 9 9 B tokens on, the shift and the rank-8 LoRA reach accuracy within 0.01 0.01 of each other at every checkpoint, so the shift matches LoRA once the expertise has formed. Only at 1 1 B tokens does the rank-8 LoRA score slightly higher than the shift ( Section F.1 ).
For behaviors, the potentiality principle forms later: at 9 9 B tokens a rank-8 LoRA produces 40 40 to 42 42 of the 42 42 writing systems (non-Latin scripts such as Thai), where a shift produces 7 7 to 8 8 , and the two meet only at 105 105 B tokens ( Section F.2 , F.11 ). The shift adapter fails at 9 9 B tokens because the capacity has not yet formed: at this checkpoint the trained LoRA itself does not rely on its shared component, which alone produces none of the writing systems, while at 105 105 B tokens the same shared component alone produces 37 37 to 40 40 of them and a shift adapter 38 38 to 41 41 ( Section F.11 ). A shift adapter thus reaches a behavior from the point at which pretraining has formed the capacity, and LoRA starts to rely on its shared component from about the same point.
Pythia-12B shows the same order across its pretraining checkpoints ( Section F.3 ).
On the 17 tasks, the LoRA relies on its shared component at every checkpoint: with only that component it keeps between 70 % 70\% and 93 % 93\% of its gain at the 15 checkpoints, from 1 1 B tokens to the instruct model ( Table 10 ). So pretraining forms the task-specific expertise, and adaptation actualizes it through the component shared by all inputs, which remains the same from the first checkpoint on.
blocks.zh:
从9起 9 B标志开始,班次和8级LORA在每一个检查站的相互0.01之间达到精确度,因此一旦专业知识形成,班次就与LORA匹配. 只有在1 1 B 令牌时,军衔-8 LoRA的得分才略高于班次(F.1节.
对于行为,潜在原则在后来形成:在9 9 B 符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符符 转动适配器在9个9个B符号上失灵,因为容量尚未形成:在这个检查站,训练有素的LORA本身并不依赖其共享组件,单是该组件不产生任何写作系统,而在105个105个B符号上,仅同一共享组件就产生37个37个至40个40个,转动适配器38个38个至41个41(F.11节)。 转动适配器由此从预训形成能力的地方到达行为,LORA从大约同一点开始依赖其共享的组件.
Pythia-12B在其训练前检查站上显示同样的顺序(F.3节)。
在17项任务中,LORA依靠每个检查站的共用部分:只有该部分在15个检查站保留其收益的70%、70%和93%,从1个B到指示式(表10)。 因此预训形成任务特有专长,适应通过所有投入共享的组件实现,从第一个检查站开始,该部分保持不变.

blocks.en: Figure 7: The region around a trained state. The fraction of the trained shift’s gain kept as the shift is scaled (vertical) and rotated away from the trained direction (horizontal), median over the 9 behaviors of the setup on 18 models. The circle is the trained shift, and inside the dotted line at least half of the gain is kept. Ticks mark the 7 magnitudes and 9 angles measured.
blocks.zh: 图 7:一个训练有素的国家周围的地区. 随着转向的缩放(垂直)和旋转离开训练方向(横向),经过训练的转向收益的一小部分被保持在18个模型上的9个行为之上。 圆是训练有素的转向,在点线内至少保留一半的收益. 滴答标记了测量到的7级和9角.

blocks.en:
What geometry does the actualizing region have. We characterize an actualizing region by three properties: (i) width in magnitude, (ii) width in direction, and (iii) connectivity. Across the 9 behaviors of the setup on 18 models, we measure width in magnitude by scaling a trained shift and width in direction by rotating it away from its trained direction. The region is narrow in magnitude but wider in direction: at least 90 % 90\% of the gain is preserved between 0.80 × 0.80\times and 1.34 × 1.34\times the trained magnitude and up to a 34 ∘ 34^{\circ} rotation, while half is preserved between 0.61 × 0.61\times and 1.86 × 1.86\times and up to 50 ∘ 50^{\circ} ( Figure 7 , Sections F.6 and F.7 ). Directional width depends on what the shift is rotated toward: on the 4 traits, rotating toward another trait’s shift reduces the 90 % 90\% and 50 % 50\% thresholds to 13 ∘ 13^{\circ} and 26 ∘ 26^{\circ} , respectively ( Section F.8 ).
We measure connectivity by interpolating between independently trained states for the same behavior.
Specifically, we train the same behavior at 3 seeds, take two of the resulting states, and score the shift at 5 equally spaced points on the straight line between them.
Across the 9 behaviors and 18 models, the lowest point along the interpolation retains a median 99 % 99\% of the endpoint gain, indicating that the two states lie in a single connected region, with the gain remaining high along the entire interpolation path. Connectivity also holds when the two states are trained from different supervision sources: one from the model’s system-prompted answers and the other from externally translated answers, across French, German, and Spanish. This shows that actualizing states of the same behavior lie in connected regions, not in separate pockets ( Section F.9 ). We next assessed whether the size of the region correlates with the performance. Indeed, larger measured regions show stronger behaviors: across the 9 behaviors and 18 models, region area correlates with adherence at the center at within-model Spearman + 0.64 +0.64 ( Section F.10 ).
blocks.zh:
实现区域有哪些几何特征. 我们以三个属性描述一个实际化的区域:(一) 宽度,(二) 方向宽度,(三) 连接。 在18个模型上的9个设置行为中, 我们测量宽度, 将训练有素的转变和宽度 缩小到方向, 使其脱离训练有素的方向。 该区域在规模上是狭小的,但在方向上是:在0.80x0.80\时和1.34x1.34\时之间至少保留90%的增益,在经过训练的幅度和高达34×34××××××××××0.61\时和1.86×1.86\时和不超过50××××××50×××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××时,在0.6××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××× (图7,F.6和F.7节)。 方向宽度取决于向什么方向的转变:在4个特征上,向另一个特征的转变将90%的90++和50%的50++的阈值分别降低到13+++13+crc}和26+++26+crc}(F.8节)。
我们通过在受过独立训练的各州之间进行同一行为的内插来测量连通性。
具体来说,我们在3个种子中训练相同的行为, 取两个结果的状态, 并在它们之间的直线上以5个等距的点来评分。
在整个9个行为和18个模型中,内插线上的最低点保留了99%的末点增益,表明这两个州位于一个单一的连接区域,沿整个内插线的增益仍然很高. 当两个州从不同的监督来源接受培训时,连通性也维持不变:一个来自模型的系统催化答案,另一个来自法语、德语和西班牙语的外部翻译答案。 这表明,同一种行为的实际状态存在于相连的区域,而不是单独的口袋(F.9节)。 我们随后评估了该区域的规模是否与业绩相关。 实际上,较大的测量区域显示出更强烈的行为:在9个行为和18个模型中,区域领域与模范Spearman+0.64+0.64的中心遵守有关(F.10节)。

blocks.en: 5 Implications of the potentiality and actuality principle
blocks.zh: 5 潜在性和实际性原则的影响

blocks.en: We examine implications the potentiality and actuality principle has on (i) steering, (ii) convergence, and (iii) neural thickets.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了潜在性和实际性原则对(一)方向、(二)趋同和(三)神经厚度的影响。

blocks.en:
Implications on steering. Activation steering ( Subramani et al., 2022 ) provides a direct example of the potentiality and actuality principle: adding an appropriate direction in activation space can actualize a desired behavior without changing the model’s weights.
However, the challenge for steering is to identify the right actualizing direction.
Existing steering methods extract such directions from model activations ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2023 ; Beaglehole et al., 2026 ) , but the resulting interventions can be sensitive to how the direction is constructed and how strongly it is applied.
Instead of extracting the direction heuristically, the shift adapter learns the actualizing shift directly from behavioral examples.
We compare three extracted vectors, the mean difference of CAA ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ) , the leading principal component of the same differences ( Zou et al., 2023 ) , and the in-context task vector ( Hendel et al., 2023 ) , with the shift adapter on the 9 behaviors and 18 models.
Following standard practice ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ; Zou et al., 2023 ) , we choose the strength on 200 200 held-out instructions and evaluate all methods on 800 800 further instructions.
The shift adapter reaches an adherence of 0.68 0.68 against 0.17 0.17 for the best of the three extracted vectors, on average over 18 models with intervals over models, and it leads in every class: 0.45 0.45 against 0.20 0.20 on the traits, 0.87 0.87 against 0.10 0.10 on the transformations, and 0.83 0.83 against 0.23 0.23 on the maps ( Figure 8 a).
We further evaluate on AxBench ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , where the shift adapter scores 0.87 0.87 compared with 0.21 0.21 for CAA on Gemma-2-2B ( Section G.2 ).
In this view, activation steering is one way of actualizing what the model already holds.
However, it often fails to find the right actualizing state.
The shift adapter instead reliably actualizes the desired state.
blocks.zh:
对方向的影响。 激活方向(Subramani等人,2022年)为潜在性和实际性原则提供了一个直接的例子:在激活空间中添加一个适当的方向可以实现想要的行为而不改变模型的权重.
然而,指导的挑战是确定正确的实际方向。
现有的引导方法从模型激活中提取出这样的方向(Rimsky等人,2024年;Zou等人,2023年;Beaglehole等人,2026年),但由此产生的干预可以对方向的构造方式以及应用力度敏感.
转动适配器没有从行为实例中直接提取方向的高度,而是直接学习实际的转变.
我们比较了三个提取的矢量,CAA的平均值差(Rimsky等人,2024年),相同差异的主要主要成分(Zou等人,2023年),以及内文本任务矢量(Hendel等人,2023年),与9行为和18模型的转向适配器.
遵循标准惯例(Rimsky等人, 2024; Zou et al., 2023),我们选择200200搁置指令的实力,并评价800800进一步指令的所有方法.
转向适配器在三个提取的矢量中,最佳位数达到0.68 0.68对0.17 0.17的坚持度,平均超过18种型号,且间隔超过模型,它在每个类中领先:特征0.45 04.5对0.20 0.20,变速0.87 0.87对0.10 0.10,地图0.83 0.83对0.23 0.23(图8 a).
我们进一步评价了Ax Bench(Wu等人,2025年),该变速器在Gemma-2B(G.2节)上的分数是0.870.87,而CAA的分数是0.210.21。
这种观点认为,激活方向盘是实现模型已经持有的东西的一种方式.
然而,它往往没有找到正确的实际状态。
转向适配器则可靠地实现理想状态.

blocks.en: Implications on convergence. The Platonic representation hypotheses ( Huh et al., 2024 ) observes that the representations of different models grow alike as the models grow more capable. The potentiality and actuality principle raises the same question for the states a model can be brought to: do the actualizing states of different models converge, and does the agreement grow with capability? A state is named by the behavior it produces, so the state for answering in French in one model has a partner in every other model that answers in French, and we can compare how two models arrange their states just as we compare how they arrange their representations ( Kriegeskorte et al., 2008 ; Kornblith et al., 2019 ) . We train one shift adapter for each of the 75 75 behaviors that 14 14 instruction-tuned models all reach, each behavior with a name and a system prompt (languages, output forms of the kind IFEval verifies ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , personas of the kind persona vectors control ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , and eras, registers, affects and audiences, Section C.4 ), and compare the arrangements of the 75 75 states between all model pairs with RSA ( Kriegeskorte et al., 2008 ) , which compares the rank order of the angles between states, CKA ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) , which compares their inner products up to a rotation and a scale, and mutual- k k NN ( Huh et al., 2024 ) , which compares which states are nearest neighbors. To know what agreement two unrelated arrangements show, we shuffle which behavior is which in one of the two models and score the shuffled pair the same way ( Gröger et al., 2026 ) . The states of different models show high agreement: RSA between models of different families is 0.64 0.64 , every pair lies above its shuffled counterpart ( p < 0.01 p<0.01 ), and the more capable the two models, the closer their arrangements under RSA (Spearman ρ = 0.68 \rho=0.68 , p = 0.003 p=0.003 ) and mutual- k k NN ( ρ = 0.40 \rho=0.40 , p = 0.03 p=0.03 ), while CKA does not rise with capability ( Figure 8 b, Section G.3 ). In this view, models converge not only in what they compute for a given input but in what they hold in potentiality, and they converge more the more capable they become.
blocks.zh: 对趋同的影响。 柏拉图表示假说(Huh et al., 2024)观察到,随着模型能力的增强,不同模型的表示力也在增长. 潜在性和实际性原则对各州提出了同样的问题:不同模式的实际化状态是否趋同,协议是否随能力而增长? 一个状态是由它产生的行为命名的,因此一个模型中用于回答法语的状态在其他每个模型中都有一个用法语回答的合作伙伴,我们可以比较两个模型如何安排它们的状态,就像我们比较它们如何安排它们的表达(Kriegeskorte等人,2008年;Kornblith等人,2019年). 我们为14个14个指令调制模型全部达到的75个75个行为中每个行为训练一个调制器,每个行为都有一个名称和系统提示(语言,IFEval类的输出形式验证(周等人,2023年),人种矢量控制(陈等人,2026年),以及时代,注册,影响和受众,C.4节),比较75个75个状态与RSA(Kriegeskorte等人,2008年)之间的所有模式配对,比较了各州之间角度的等级顺序,CKA(Kornblith等人,2019年),比较了它们的内产值的旋转和尺度,以及相互Kk NN(Huh等人,2024年),比较了哪个是最近的邻国. 要知道两种不相关的安排所显示的是什么,我们洗涤了两种模式中哪一种行为,并以同样的方式对洗涤的对(Gröger等人,2026年)。 不同型号的状态显示高度一致:不同家族型号之间的RSA为0.64 0.64,每对型号位于其被洗掉的对应型号(p < 0.01 p < 0.01)之上,两种型号的能力越强,在RSA(Spearman à = 0.68\rho = 0.68,p= 0.003 p= 0.003)和相互-k k NN(ρ = 0.40\rho = 0.40,p= 0.03 p= 0.03)下,它们的安排就越接近(图8b, section G.3),而CKA不随能力上升(图8b, section G.3). 在这种观点中,模型不仅在计算给定的输入时会趋同,而且在它们所持有的潜质中也会趋同,而且它们变得越有能力。

blocks.en:
Implications on neural thickets. Gan and Isola (2026) recently showed that adding random perturbations to the weights of the large pretrained model can yield task-improving experts.
In large models, the density of such experts is high: a substantial fraction of random weight perturbations improve performance on a task.
However, why such task-improving experts become abundant around pretrained weights is an open question.
The potentiality and actuality principle offers a way to explain this phenomenon: an expert is a perturbation that happens to land in the actualizing region of the task, i.e. , the region in which the behavior can be actualized.
A perturbation of fixed size lands in the actualizing region and finds experts by chance only when the actualizing regions are wide, and none when the regions are narrow.
To test this, we first reproduce the random-search protocol of Gan and Isola (2026) on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) and then run it on the 9 behaviors of our setup, whose actualizing regions we measured in Section 4 .
Following Gan and Isola (2026) , we sample 300 300 random weight perturbations at several noise scales, keep the 20 20 that score highest on a selection set, and evaluate those on a disjoint held-out set. We call the share of the 20 20 that still improve the behavior on the held-out set the expert fraction. On the GSM8K the search finds experts in 12 of the 18 models, with an expert fraction of 0.20 0.20 on average.
Across model-behavior pairs, expert density increases with actualizing-region size. In the 8 models where the search finds an expert, the behaviors with an expert have wider regions than those without: region size and expert density correlate at Spearman ρ = 0.43 \rho=0.43 over the 72 model–behavior pairs ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , Section G.4 ), and the share of pairs with an expert rises from 0 % 0\% in the narrowest quarter of regions to 17 % 17\% in the widest ( Figure 8 c). The three behaviors with the narrowest regions have no expert in any model.
Thus, neural thickets can be understood as random search entering actualizing regions by chance: the wider the region, the more likely it is to contain randomly discovered experts.
blocks.zh:
对神经粘膜的影响 甘和伊索拉(2026年)最近显示,在大型预训模型的重量上增加随机扰动可以产生改进任务的专家.
在大型模型中,这类专家的密度很高:随机重量扰动的相当一部分改善了任务的业绩。
然而,为什么这种改进任务的专家在预先受过训练的重量方面变得丰富,这是一个有待解决的问题。
潜在性和实际性原则为解释这一现象提供了一种方法:一位专家是发生在任务实际化区域,即行为能够实际化的区域着陆时的一种扰动.
扰动实际区域固定面积的土地,只有在实际区域广阔时才偶然找到专家,而在区域狭窄时才找到专家。
为了测试这一点,我们首先复制了甘和伊索拉(2026年)关于GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年)的随机搜索协议,然后运行在我们设定的9个行为上,我们在第4节中测量到它们的实际化区域.
在Gan和Isola(2026年)之后,我们抽查了300300个随机重量在几个噪声尺度上的扰动,将评分最高的20个在选集中,并评价了脱节的搁置集中. 我们称这20个 仍然能改善被搁置者的行为的20个份额 将专家分成 在GSM8K上,搜索发现了18种模型中的12种专家,专家分数平均为0.200.
跨模型-行为对子,专家密度随实际化-区域大小而增加。 在寻找专家的8个模型中,与专家的行为相比,区域大小和专家密度比没有的区域要大:在Spearman ^ = 0.43\rho = 0.43 的72个模型中,行为对(p < 0.001 p < 0.001, section G.4),与专家对对的比例从最窄的四分之一区域的0 % = -0%上升到最广的17% = 17%(图8 c)。 与最狭小的区域的三种行为在任何模型上都没有专家.
因此,神经厚度可以被理解为偶然进入实际化区域的随机搜索:区域越广,就越可能包含随机发现的专家.

blocks.en: 6 Related work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: The potentiality and actuality principle connects different adaptation strategies through the states they induce. More details are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 潜在性和实际性原则通过其诱导的状态将不同的适应战略联系起来。 详情见附录A。

blocks.en:
Parameter-efficient and representation fine-tuning. Parameter-efficient methods restrict adaptation to low-rank updates ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , biases with a new task layer on linguistic classification tasks ( Ben Zaken et al., 2022 ) , updates over frozen factors ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , or updates restricted to particular subspaces ( Gao et al., 2024 ) .
Representation-based methods instead modify hidden states directly, from input-dependent low-rank updates in ReFT ( Wu et al., 2024 ) to fixed offsets at selected attention heads in LoFiT ( Yin et al., 2024 ) . Each of these updates can change the output of a block differently for each input: the biases of Ben Zaken et al. (2022) sit inside the block, so their change passes through attention and the MLP ( Section B.3 ), while the shift adapter adds its vector after the block. Moreover, 13/18 models we evaluate have no biases at all, making bias training not applicable. Sinii et al. (2025) train one vector per layer with reinforcement learning for mathematical reasoning and see its input-independence as a limitation, while we find that most of what LoRA adds is the same for every input. The potentiality and actuality principle shows that a constant, input-independent shift is sufficient to move the model into a state in which task-expertise can be actualized.
blocks.zh:
参数高效度和表示度微调. 参数高效方法限制对低级更新的适应(Hu等人,2022年),语言分类任务新增任务层的偏差(Ben Zaken等人,2022年),对冷冻因子的更新(Zhang等人,2023年),或仅限于特定子空间的更新(Gao等人,2024年).
基于代表的方法直接修改隐藏状态,从ReFT中依赖输入的低级更新(Wu等人,2024年)改为LoFiT中某些关注头的固定抵消(Yin等人,2024年). 这些更新可以对每个输入改变一个块的输出: Ben Zaken等人(2022年)的偏差坐落在块内,因此它们的改变会经过注意和MLP(B.3节),而转向适配器会在块后增加它的矢量. 此外,我们评价的13/18种模式根本没有偏见,使偏见培训不适用。 Sinii等人(2025年)每层训练一个载体,为数学推理进行强化学习,并视其输入-独立为限制,而我们发现洛拉添加的大部分内容对于每个输入都是相同的. 潜在性和实际性原则表明,不断的,投入独立的转变足以使模型进入可以实现任务专长的状态.

blocks.en: In-context learning. In-context learning adapts through demonstrations ( Brown et al., 2020 ) . Prompt tuning, prefix tuning, and gisting learn that conditioning instead of supplying it ( Lester et al., 2021 ; Li and Liang, 2021 ; Mu et al., 2023 ) . Our comparison reveals a different route from LoRA: the demonstrations’ shared component keeps less of the gain than LoRA’s on traits, transformations and tasks, and is nearly orthogonal to LoRA’s shared component.
blocks.zh: 内结习. 内容内学习通过演示适应(Brown等人,2020年). 即时调音,前缀调音,和 gi学调音,而不是提供调音(Lester等人,2021年;李和良,2021年;Mu等人,2023年). 我们的对比揭示了与LORA不同的路线:示威的共享部分与LORA在特征、转变和任务上的共享部分相比,保留了较少的收益,并且与LORA共享部分几乎正统。

blocks.en: Activation steering. Activation steering modifies hidden states using directions extracted from activation contrasts ( Subramani et al., 2022 ; Rimsky et al., 2024 ) or their principal components ( Zou et al., 2023 ) . We compare extracted directions with the shift adapter added at the same place in the model and find it reaches behaviors that steering misses.
blocks.zh: 激活方向盘。 激活方向导利用从激活对比中提取的方向(Subramani等人,2022年;Rimsky等人,2024年)或其主要成分(Zou等人,2023年)修改隐藏状态。 我们比较抽取的方向和模型中同一位置添加的转向适配器,发现它达到方向偏差的行为.

blocks.en:
From weight updates to actualizing states. Wang et al. (2025) show that single-layer LoRA updates in out-of-context reasoning point in nearly the same direction across tokens, and that extracted or trained steering vectors can induce the learned behavior. Adila et al. (2026) derive a local first-order relation between weight updates and activation shifts and build post-block activation adapters.
Our paired intervention tests this correspondence in trained, multi-layer LoRAs: keeping only the shared component tests its sufficiency, while removing it tests the update’s reliance on it.
blocks.zh:
从体重更新到实际状态. Wang et al. (2025)显示,单层LORA在文本外的推理点上更新到几乎相同的方向跨符,提取或训练的引导矢量可以诱导学到的行为. Adila等人著. (2026)从重量更新和激活移位之间获得本地第一阶关系,并构建后块激活适配器.
我们配对的干预用训练有素的多层次的LORA测试这种对应:只保留共享组件测试其充足性,而去除它测试更新对它的依赖性.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we explore what adaptation does to a foundation model.
By disentangling the shared and input-dependent components of adaptation, we find the potentiality and actuality principle : adaptation primarily actualizes expertise already present in the model.
The shared component suffices for most of the adaptation gain and can be learned directly: a shift adapter that trains a single input-independent vector per layer reproduces the behavior of LoRA and full fine-tuning.
This principle provides a common perspective on parameter-efficient fine-tuning, activation steering, convergence across models, and neural thickets, and connects adaptation through weights, prompts, and hidden representations as different routes to actualizing model capabilities.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们探索了如何适应一个基础模型。
通过分离适应的共同和投入依赖部分,我们发现潜在性和实际性原则:适应主要体现模型中已有的专门知识。
共享组件足以满足大多数适应增益,并且可以直接学习:一个每层训练单一输入独立矢量的转向适配器复制LORA的行为并进行全微调.
这一原则为参数高效的微调,激活引导,跨模型的趋同,神经厚度提供了共同的视角,并通过权重,提示,隐藏的表示方式将适应联系起来,作为实现模型能力的不同途径.

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended related work
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en: Adaptation strategies differ in what they change: parameter-efficient fine-tuning learns a small update to the weights, in-context learning conditions the model on demonstrations in the prompt, activation steering modifies the hidden activations at inference time, and representation fine-tuning learns a change to the representations themselves. The field has treated these as different tools. The potentiality and actuality principle reads each of them as reaching an actualizing state.
blocks.zh: 适应策略在变化方面有所不同:参数高效的微调能学习微小的权重更新,即时对演示模型的内文本学习条件,激活方向盘在推论时修改隐藏的激活,表现微调能学习到表达本身的改变. 现场视这些为不同的工具。 潜在性和实际性原则将其中每一项理解为达到实际状态。

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning freezes the model and trains a small update to its weights. The update can be a low-rank matrix on selected weights ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , the existing biases and a new task layer ( Ben Zaken et al., 2022 ) , per-feature scales over frozen random factors ( Kopiczko et al., 2024 ) , one LoRA factor with the other left random ( Zhu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) , or an update confined to a random, Fourier, shared or gradient subspace ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Mandica et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) . Low intrinsic dimension is the broadest form of the observation that so little suffices ( Aghajanyan et al., 2021 ) . Grafting the fine-tuned values of 0.01 % 0.01\% of the weights, chosen by a learned sparse mask, onto the base model keeps over 95 % 95\% of the fine-tuned accuracy, and in a model tuned on several tasks at once the tasks use nearly disjoint sets of weights ( Panigrahi et al., 2023 ) . That work finds which weights carry the gain and in which layers and modules they sit. Each such weight still multiplies the input, so its effect on the hidden states could differ from input to input. For LoRA and full fine-tuning we find the opposite: most of the gain lies in a component shared by all inputs ( Section 2 ). We show why it suffices: the update selects a state the base model holds in potentiality, and the shift adapter, one vector per layer, is the smallest member of this family that does so ( Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 参数高效微调. 参数高效的微调冻结了模型,并训练了少量更新其重量. 更新可以是选定重量(Hu等人,2022年)的低排名矩阵、现有的偏差和一个新的任务层(Ben Zaken等人,2022年),冻结随机因子(Kopiczko等人,2024年)上的每个天平和左随机因子(Zhu等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2023年),或者更新限于随机的Fourier、共享或梯度亚空间(Gao等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年;Zhao等人,2024年;Mandica等人,2026年;Xia等人,2025年)。 低内在的维度是观测的最广泛形式,但仅此而已(Aghajanyan等人,2021年)。 将0.01%0.01%的权重的微调值(由学得的稀有面具所选择)移到基准模型上,保留了95%以上的微调精确度,在一个模型中,这些任务同时使用几乎脱节的权重组合(Panigrahi等人,2023年)。 这部作品找出了哪个重量带增益,以及它们所在的层次和模块。 每个这样的权重仍然能使输入倍增,因此它对隐藏状态的影响会因输入而异. 对LORA和全面微调来说,我们发现情况恰恰相反:大部分收益来自所有投入共享的组成部分(第2节)。 我们说明为什么它足够:更新会选择一个基本模型具有潜在性的状态,而转动适配器,每层一个矢量,是这个家族中最小的这样做的成员(第3节).

blocks.en: In-context learning. In-context learning adapts a model through demonstrations in the prompt, with no change to the weights ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , carried by attention heads that copy from the context ( Olsson et al., 2022 ) . Mechanism work compresses the demonstrations into a single vector: a task vector read from the hidden state at the end of the prompt ( Hendel et al., 2023 ) , or a function vector read from a small set of attention heads, which reproduces the task when added to the forward pass ( Todd et al., 2024 ) . The prompt itself can also be learned: prompt tuning trains the embeddings of a few tokens placed before the input ( Lester et al., 2021 ) , prefix tuning trains such tokens at every layer ( Li and Liang, 2021 ) , and gisting trains the model to compress a long prompt into a few tokens that stand in for it ( Mu et al., 2023 ) . We place in-context learning beside adaptation on the same behaviors and find that it reaches them by a different route: its shared component keeps less of the gain than LoRA’s on the traits, the transformations and the tasks, and it points nearly orthogonally to LoRA’s shared component ( Section 2 ). The task vector is then one of the three extracted vectors we compare with the trained shift adapter in Section 5 .
blocks.zh: 内结习. 校对:Soup 机理工作将演示压缩成单个向量:从提示末端隐藏状态读取的任务向量(Hendel等人,2023年),或从一小组注意头读取函数向量,当添加到前传时复制任务(Todd等人,2024年). 提示本身也可以被学习到:即时调试输入前放置的几个符的嵌入(Lester等人,2021年),前缀调试每层(Li and Liang, 2021年)的此类符的嵌入(Liang),以及 gi刻火车以压缩一个长的符的嵌入(Mu等人, 2023年). 我们把同一种行为放在适应外的文字学习,发现它通过不同的途径到达它们:其共享的成分在特征、转化和任务上比LORA的收益少,它几乎正统地指向LORA的共享成分(第2节)。 然后,任务矢量是我们与第5节中训练有素的转向适配器相比较的三个提取矢量之一。

blocks.en: Activation steering. Activation steering adds a vector to the hidden states at inference time and leaves the weights untouched. The vector comes from the model’s own activations: Activation Addition takes the difference between the activations of two prompts ( Turner et al., 2023 ) , Contrastive Activation Addition averages that difference over many prompt pairs with and without the behavior ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ) , Representation Engineering reads the leading direction of such differences ( Zou et al., 2023 ) , and persona vectors apply the same construction to character traits ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . AxBench benchmarks these methods against fine-tuning on one fixed model, Gemma-2-2B, with its own judge ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . The trained shift adapter adds its vector at the same place, one per layer, but learns it by adaptation, and Section 5 shows that training reaches behaviors that extraction misses.
blocks.zh: 激活方向盘。 激活方向盘在推断时会给隐藏状态添加一个矢量,使重量不受影响. 矢量来自模型自身的激活: " 激活加法 " 采用了两个诱因(Turner 等人,2023年)激活的区别, " 对抗激活加法 " 是指与许多诱因对有行为和没有行为存在差别的平均值(Rimsky 等人,2024年),代表 工程读取这种差异的主要方向(Zou等人,2023年),人物矢量对性格特征应用同样的构造(Chen等人,2026年). Ax Bench将这些方法与一个固定模型Gemma-2-2B的微调作为基准(Wu等人,2025年)。 训练有素的转向适配器在同一个地方添加了它的矢量,每层一个,但通过适应来学习,第5节显示训练达到了提取缺失的行为.

blocks.en: Representation fine-tuning. Representation fine-tuning trains a change to the hidden representations and leaves the weights frozen. ReFT learns a low-rank transformation of the representations at chosen positions, which in general depends on the input ( Wu et al., 2024 ) . LoFiT learns fixed offsets at a few selected attention heads ( Yin et al., 2024 ) . Bias training trains the existing biases together with a new classification layer for each task, through which every answer leaves the model ( Ben Zaken et al., 2022 ) , and Sinii et al. (2025) train a bias vector per layer with reinforcement learning to match fully tuned reasoning models on mathematical benchmarks, a bound on how few parameters reasoning needs. They see the input-independence of this vector as a limitation that may cap performance, while our paper shows that most of what LoRA adds is the same for every input ( Section 2 ) and explains why such a vector suffices ( Sections F.11 and F.12 ). The new layer of Ben Zaken et al. (2022) adds an input-specific component trained on the task, so accuracy there cannot show that the expertise was already in the base model. The vector of a shift adapter is the shared component of what any adaptation learns, on which a LoRA relies for most of its gain ( Section 2 ).
blocks.zh: 代表性微调. 代表器微调对隐藏的表示方式进行修改,使重量冻结。 ReFT学习了在所选位置上表现的低阶转变,一般取决于投入(Wu等人,2024). LoFiT在几个选定的关注头学习固定抵消(Yin等人,2024年). Bias训练会训练现有的偏差,同时为每项任务设置一个新的分类层,通过这个层,每个答案都会离开模型(Ben Zaken等人,2022年),以及Sinii等人. (2025年)每层训练一个带有加固学习的偏差矢量,以在数学基准上完全调制推理模型,这是关于参数推理需要的几何约束. 他们认为,这种载体的输入独立是一种限制,可能会限制性能,而我们的文件表明,LORA添加的大部分内容与每项输入相同(第2节),并解释了为什么这种载体足够(F.11和F.12节)。 Ben Zaken等人(2022年)的新层增加了一个经过任务培训的具体输入部分,因此准确性无法表明该专门知识已经存在于基准模型中。 转动适配器的矢量是任何适应所学到的东西的共同成分,而LORA的大部分收益都依赖这个成分(第2节)。

blocks.en: From weight updates to actualizing states. Wang et al. (2025) study single-layer LoRAs on out-of-context reasoning tasks and find that the update’s added vectors point in nearly the same direction across tokens, and that extracted or directly trained steering vectors can induce the learned behavior. Adila et al. (2026) derive a local first-order relation between weight updates and activation shifts and use it to build post-block activation adapters. Both connect changes in weights to states in activation space. Our paired intervention turns this correspondence into a test of the trained update itself: keeping only the shared component and removing it establish when a flexible multi-layer LoRA relies on an actualizing state ( Section 2 ).
blocks.zh: 从体重更新到实际状态. Wang等人(2025年)研究单层LORAs的脱文本推理任务,发现更新后添加的矢量指向几乎相同的方向跨符,提取或直接训练的转向矢量可以诱导学到的行为. Adila等人著. (2026)从重量更新和激活转换之间获得本地第一阶关系,并用它来构建后块激活适配器. 两者都将权重变化与激活空间中的状态联系起来. 我们的配对干预将这种函证变成了对训练有素的更新本身的考验:当一个灵活的多层LORA依赖于一个实际状态时,只保留共享的组件并删除它(第2节).

blocks.en: B.3 Bias training is not a shift adapter
blocks.zh: B.3 联合国 偏执训练不是换班

blocks.en: Prior work on bias training adapts a model by training its existing bias terms ( Ben Zaken et al., 2022 ) . The shift adapter instead adds one new vector at the output of each block, the same for every input and every position. Both train few parameters and reach the accuracy of larger updates, so to position the two works we ask whether they are the same parameterization. They are not. The biases of our models act inside attention, before the softmax and the MLP of the same block, so a change of them changes the output of the block differently for each input. The shift adapter adds the same vector to the output of the block for every input. Below we show which biases our models have and what a change of each bias can affect, and then formally show that no change of a block’s attention parameters, its biases included, reproduces a shift adapter.
blocks.zh: 先前关于偏见培训的工作通过培训现有偏见条款来调整模式(Ben Zaken等人,2022年)。 转向适配器反而在每个块输出时添加了一个新的矢量,每个输入和每个位置都一样. 两者都训练了很少的参数,并达到了更大的更新的精度,所以为了定位两个作品,我们询问它们是否是相同的参数化. 他们不是。 我们的模型的偏差作用在注意内部, 在同一块的软马克斯和MLP之前, 所以它们的改变会改变每个输入的块的输出。 转向适配器为每个输入在块的输出中添加相同的矢量. 下面我们显示我们的模型有什么偏差,以及每个偏差的改变会影响什么,然后正式显示一个块的注意力参数没有变化,包括它的偏差,复制一个转动适配器。

blocks.en: Bias terms of our models. Thirteen of our 18 models have no bias terms at all ( Table 2 ), so bias training has no parameters to train on them. The other five are the Qwen2.5 models, which have biases only on the query, key, and value projections of attention. No model has a bias at the output of a block or at the output of its MLP, which is where the shift adapter is placed. On most of the models in this paper, bias training thus does not exist, while the shift adapter applies to every model, and where both exist, they differ in placement.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型有偏见 我们的18个模式中,有13个根本没有偏差(表2),因此偏差培训没有参数可以对其进行培训。 其他五个是Quen2.5模型,它们只偏向于关注的查询、关键和价值预测。 没有任何模型对块的输出或者其MLP的输出有偏差,这就是移位适配器的位置. 因此,在本文的大多数模型上,偏差训练并不存在,而转向适配器适用于每个模型,如果两者都存在,则在位置上有所不同.

blocks.en: Proof idea. Scaling the input up leaves attention unchanged and makes the two MLP terms cancel, so attention itself must add b b . Since scaling the input does not change it either, the MLP would give the same output everywhere, which it does not.

blocks.en: What the proposition covers. • Methods. It covers every change of the attention parameters: its biases, as in bias training, its weights, a LoRA on its projections, and the offsets of LoFiT ( Yin et al., 2024 ) , which add a fixed vector to the output of selected heads before the output projection. None of them acts as a shift adapter. • Models. It applies to the pre-norm blocks of 16 of our 18 models. The other 2, the Gemma-2 models, also normalize the output of attention and of the MLP before adding it to the residual stream. They have no bias, so bias training does not apply to them. • Earlier blocks. A change of the biases of an earlier block reaches this block only through its input. The proposition applies to the block that holds the changed parameter. The proof treats the RMSNorm as exactly scale invariant. In practice a constant of 10 − 6 10^{-6} is added to the mean square for numerical stability, which at the hidden-state norms of our models changes the normalization by less than one part in 10 9 10^{9} . The proof also uses that the MLP is differentiable, which holds for the gated MLPs of all 18 models.

blocks.en: C.1 The setup
blocks.zh: C.1 联合国 设置

blocks.en: Unless a subsection states otherwise, every experiment uses the setup of Section 2 : the 18 models of Section C.2 , the 26 benchmarks of Table 3 (17 tasks and 9 behaviors) and 3 training seeds. Every method trains at the learning rate selected for it ( Section C.5 ). A run is one model, benchmark, method and seed, so a benchmark contributes 54 runs per method. Every reported number is the mean over the seeds, and every interval a 95 % 95\% bootstrap interval over models. Tasks are scored on their full evaluation split and behaviors on 1,000 1{,}000 held-out generations per run. A subsection that departs from this setup, in its models, benchmarks, seeds or evaluation size, states its own design in its first paragraph.
blocks.zh: 除非某一小节另有说明,否则每个实验都采用第2节的设置:第C.2节的18个模型,表3的26个基准(17项任务和9个行为)和3个训练种子. 每一种方法都按照为其选择的学习率进行训练(C.5节)。 一个运行是一个模型,基准,方法和种子,所以一个基准每个方法贡献54个运行. 每个报告的数字是种子的平均值,每个间隔95%的95%的靴子间隔在模型上。 任务在完全评价上得分 行为在1000 1{,} 000 hold 与其模型、基准、种子或评价规模不同的一个小节在第一段中说明了自己的设计。

blocks.en: C.2 Models

blocks.en:
The text experiments use 18 models from 7 architecture families.
Fourteen are instruction-tuned: Qwen2.5-0.5B, 1.5B, 3B and 7B, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, Qwen3.6-27B,
Llama-3.2-1B and 3B, Llama-3.1-8B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Mistral-7B and Gemma-2-2B. Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 interleave
three gated linear-attention blocks with every full-attention block, so the models are not one
architecture repeated at different scales.
Four further models are read before preference tuning ( Section D.4 ): the base models behind Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-2B, and Tulu-3-8B-SFT ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) , which is trained on instructions but not preference tuned. The convergence analysis in Section 5 uses the 14 instruction-tuned models.

(2024) . MMLU-Pro and SuperGPQA ship one labeled split, and we hold out a fixed part of it for evaluation.

blocks.en: C.5 Instructions, teachers and training

blocks.en: Figure 10: How a trait is trained. The base model answers an instruction under the trait’s system prompt (teacher). The same base model, frozen and without the prompt, is adapted to reproduce that answer, with cross-entropy on the answer tokens (student).

blocks.en: Instructions and teachers. Every trait is trained and scored on instructions from the no-context part of dolly-15k ( Conover et al., 2023 ) , about 15 15 k instructions of 20 20 to 160 160 characters with duplicates removed. Each seed draws its own training instructions, and the held-out instructions a behavior is scored on never overlap the ones it trained on. The number of instructions is fixed within each experiment for every model and method it compares, and follows how many states the experiment trains. A behavior of the setup trains on 80 80 instructions for 250 250 steps, and a map on 160 160 for 400 400 , so that every first letter occurs in training. An atlas, which trains hundreds of behaviors per model, uses 160 160 for 300 300 steps, as do the in-context comparison and the behavior counts along the training of OLMo-2-7B. A region grid, which scores hundreds of points around one state, uses 60 60 for 300 300 , and the steering comparison uses 400 400 for 200 200 . The teacher is the base model under a system prompt for a trait, and the rule itself for a transformation or a map.

blocks.en: Figure 11: Loss and adherence rank the two adapters differently (Qwen2.5-1.5B on pirate, the shift adapter and the rank-8 LoRA trained on the same teacher answers). Both losses are the next-token cross-entropy on the tokens of the teacher’s answer, with the instruction masked. (a) On the training answers, per step (faint: raw, bold: rolling mean). (b) On held-out answers, every 20 20 steps, with min–max bands over seeds. The model is given the teacher’s answer and scored on predicting each next token of it, so nothing is generated. The LoRA reaches near-zero training loss and its held-out loss turns up, while the shift adapter’s falls slowly and stays flat. Scored on generated held-out answers, the two adapters reach an adherence of 0.05 0.05 (shift adapter) and 0.08 0.08 (LoRA), a difference of 0.03 0.03 , which is why methods are compared on generated text and loss stays a diagnostic.

blocks.en:
Learning-rate selection. For the 17 tasks of Figure 4 the learning rate is selected per model, adapter, and task with the same procedure, so that no adapter is compared at a tuned rate against another at an untuned one. For each task we split the training data in two: a validation part and the rest. Every rate is trained on the rest and scored on the validation part, and the rate that scores highest is kept, ties within 0.005 0.005 going to the smaller rate.
The adapter is then retrained on the full training data at that rate, for every seed. The evaluation split is never used for selection, and no rate carries from one task to another.
The rates are { 1 , 5 } × 10 − 5 \{1,5\}\times 10^{-5} , { 1 , 5 } × 10 − 4 \{1,5\}\times 10^{-4} , { 1 , 2 , 5 } × 10 − 3 \{1,2,5\}\times 10^{-3} and 10 − 2 10^{-2} for the shift adapter, { 1 , 2 , 5 } × 10 − 5 \{1,2,5\}\times 10^{-5} and { 1 , 2 , 5 } × 10 − 4 \{1,2,5\}\times 10^{-4} for LoRA, and { 3 × 10 − 7 , 10 − 6 , 3 × 10 − 6 , 10 − 5 , 3 × 10 − 5 , 10 − 4 } \{3\times 10^{-7},10^{-6},3\times 10^{-6},10^{-5},3\times 10^{-5},10^{-4}\} for full fine-tuning.

C.6 Evaluation
blocks.zh: C.6 评价

blocks.en: Every claim is scored on generated text for held-out instructions, never on teacher-forced loss. The format behaviors (bullet points, all caps, JSON, one word and socratic) are scored by a rule-based verifier, as the adapted rate minus the base model’s rate. Every other trait is scored by the token-F1 similarity of the generation to the teacher’s generation, minus the same similarity for the base model. We call this score adherence . Transformations and maps are scored by exact match.
blocks.zh: 每项索赔都是在生成的关于搁置指示的文本上打分的,绝不是教师造成的损失。 格式行为(bullet points, all caps,JSON,一个单词和 socratic)由基于规则的验证器评分,作为调整后的评分减去基准模型的评分. 每个其它特征都通过代号-F1与教师一代的相似性来评分,减去基模的相同相似性. 我们称此为守分。 变形和地图通过精确的匹配来打分.

blocks.en: Direct checks of the language and persona scores. We rescore the saved generations of the interventions of Section 2 with a direct measure, without new training or generation. A frozen 97 97 -language identifier finds the target language in under 1 % 1\% of the base model’s answers and in 67 % 67\% to 100 % 100\% of the trained adapter’s, on every one of the 18 models. Counting an answer as French when the identifier labels it French, across the 18 models, keeping only the shared component keeps 99 % 99\% of the gain and removing it keeps 16 % 16\% (medians over runs), close to the token-F1 values. A lexical marker gives the same ordering for the personas: with only the shared component, pirate keeps 99 % 99\% . The result on the languages does not depend on token F1. Token F1 scores a generation by its overlap with the teacher’s answer. A different wording of the same behavior scores low. The direct checks above read the behavior itself, and they give the same ordering.
blocks.zh: 直接检查语言和人物分数。 我们以直接措施将第2节所拯救的几代人的干预重新计时,而不进行新的培训或代代人。 被冻结的97 97 - 语言标识器在基准模型的答案中发现目标语言不到1%的1%,在训练有素的适配器中发现目标语言的占67%的67-100%的100. 当标识符标注为法语时,将一个答案算作法语,跨越18种模式,只保留共享组件保留99 % 99% 收益,并删除它保留16% 16% (媒体运行结束),接近符号-F1值. 海盗持有99 % 99%。 对语言的结果并不取决于符号F1. Token F1与老师的回答重叠, 同一行为的不同措辞得分较低. 上面的直接检查读了行为本身,他们给出了同样的命令.

With only the shared component, the LoRA keeps 85 % 85\% [ 81 81 , 89 89 ] of its gain, and with it removed 61 % 61\% [ 52 52 , 69 69 ]. By task type, with intervals over models, the fractions kept with only the shared component and with it removed are 97 % 97\% [ 96 96 , 98 98 ] and 59 % 59\% [ 46 46 , 71 71 ] on the three text classifications, 87 % 87\% [ 83 83 , 90 90 ] and 58 % 58\% [ 50 50 , 66 66 ] on the four commonsense question-answering tasks, 78 % 78\% [ 70 70 , 87 87 ] and 49 % 49\% [ 18 18 , 74 74 ] on the three science question-answering tasks, 79 % 79\% [ 73 73 , 85 85 ] and 73 % 73\% [ 64 64 , 82 82 ] on the four domain tasks, 66 % 66\% [ 45 45 , 79 79 ] and 61 % 61\% [ 31 31 , 77 77 ] on HellaSwag, and 69 % 69\% [ 60 60 , 76 76 ] and 66 % 66\% [ 58 58 , 75 75 ] on the two expert question-answering tasks, MMLU-Pro and SuperGPQA. The shared component alone keeps at least 66 % 66\% of the gain on every task type.

blocks.en: Two checks concern how the fractions are measured. First, estimating the shared component as the average input of the matrix over all prompt positions, instead of at the last token of the input, keeps 70 % 70\% [ 66 66 , 73 73 ] of the gain with only that component and 93 % 93\% [ 91 91 , 94 94 ] with it removed. The gain relies on the component the adapter adds at the last token of the input, on the tasks as on the traits ( Section D.8 ). Second, macro accuracy stays close to accuracy: within 0.037 0.037 on those runs, and on the setup’s runs, each scored under the trained adapter and the two interventions, within 0.04 0.04 in all but 4 of the 2,754 2{,}754 reports (at most 0.083 0.083 , under removal), with a mean gap of 0.00 0.00 . No fraction comes from predicting the majority class.
blocks.zh: 两项检查涉及分数如何衡量。 首先,将共享部分估计为所有快速位置的矩阵的平均输入,而不是输入的最后一点,保留了收益的70% 70 \% [66 66,73] ,只有该部分,保留了93% 93 \% [91 91,94],删除了该部分。 收益取决于适配器在输入的最后一个符号上添加的部件,取决于任务和特性(D.8节)。 第二,宏观精确度接近精确度:在0.037 0.037的运行中,在设置的运行中,在训练有素的适配器和两种干预下,除4种外,其余2 754 2{}754份报告中,每个都得分0.04 0.04,平均差0.00。 没有分数来自预测多数阶级.

blocks.en: Removing the shared component position by position. The interventions estimate one shared component at the last token of the input and apply it at every position. To test what the earlier positions share, we estimate a second shared component over the positions before the last token, on the same held-out probes, and remove each component where it was estimated: (i) the component estimated over the prompt from the prompt positions, and (ii) the component estimated at the last token from that token. Across the 18 models and 17 tasks, removing both in this way keeps 84 % 84\% of LoRA’s gain, against 61 % 61\% when the single component is removed at every position. Removing the direction of the shared component, by projecting the field at every position onto the subspace orthogonal to it so that nothing the adapter adds points along it, keeps 75 % 75\% . Each of the 3 removals leaves a different part of the update, and each keeps more than half of the gain.
blocks.zh: 按位置删除共享组件位置。 干预措施在投入的最后一点估计一个共同部分,并应用于每个位置。 为了测试先前位置的相同之处,我们估计在最后一点之前的位置上,在同一被搁置的探测器上,第二个共享部分,并删除估计的每个组件:(一) 迅速位置上估计的组件,以及(二) 从该标识上估计的最后一个组件。 在18种模式和17项任务中,通过这种方式消除这两种模式,使LORA的收益保持在84 % 84 % , 而当每个位置移除单一组件时,则保持在61 % 61 % 。 删除共享组件的方向, 将每个位置的字段投影到正向子空间上, 这样适配器不会沿着它添加任何点, 保留 75% 75% 。 3次清除中的每一次都留下了不同的更新部分,每个保留了超过一半的收益.

blocks.en: The two methods solve the same items. Matched accuracy does not tell whether the shift adapter and LoRA solve the same held-out items. On the 17 tasks and 18 models, we take the items the base model gets wrong and compare the ones each method newly solves. Of the items one method newly solves, the other newly solves 82 % 82\% (median over the runs), against 51 % 51\% if the two methods picked their items at random from the base model’s failures. In 916 916 of the 918 918 runs (one per model, task, and seed), the observed share is above this chance level. It is above chance on every one of the 17 tasks ( Figure 13 a), and most clearly on the harder tasks, such as MedMCQA ( 68 % 68\% against 22 % 22\% ) and ARC-Challenge ( 74 % 74\% against 30 % 30\% ). Chance is high only where both methods solve almost every item the base model gets wrong, as on DBpedia, since two nearly complete sets of items always overlap. Per model, it runs from 73 % 73\% on Mistral-7B to 91 % 91\% on the Llama-3.1-8B base model ( Figure 13 b). Two seeds of one method agree on the items to the same degree: of the items one seed of the shift adapter newly solves, another seed solves 85 % 85\% , and for LoRA 82 % 82\% . The shift adapter and LoRA thus solve the same items as closely as one method does across its own seeds.
blocks.zh: 两种方法解决了相同的项目. 匹配的精确度不能显示移位适配器和LORA是否解决了相同的被搁置的项目. 在17项任务和18项模型上,我们把基础模型得到的错误项目,比较每个方法新解决的项目. 其中一种方法新解决了,另一种方法新解决了82%的82\%(在运行中居中),而如果两种方法从基准模型的失败中随机选择项目,则51%的51\%。 在918 918次运行中的916 916次运行(每个型号1次,任务,和种子)中,观测到的分享率都高于这个机会水平. 这在17项任务(图13a)中都高于机会,在更艰巨的任务(如MedMCQA(68% 68%,22% 22%)和ARC-Challenge(74% 74%,30% 30%))中最为明显。 只有在两种方法都解决了几乎每个基本模型错误的项目的情况下,如DBpedia上,机会才很高,因为两套几乎完整的项目总是重叠的。 每个模型从Mistral-7B的73% 73%到Llama-31-8B基模型的91% 91%(图13b)。 一种方法的两个种子在项目上达成一致的程度相同:在项目上,一个变位适配器新解决的种子,另一个种子解决85%85\%,对于Lora 82%82\%. 因此,转动适配器和LORA像一种方法在自己的种子中那样紧密地解决同样的项目。

blocks.en: We repeat this measurement on the 17 tasks and the 18 models, and the result is the same: at almost every adapted matrix, LoRA adds nearly the same vector for every input. The shared component holds 89 % 89\% of the energy on average (median 98 % 98\% ), from 82 % 82\% on Tulu-3-8B-SFT to 93 % 93\% on Qwen3.6-27B, and between 97 % 97\% and 98 % 98\% for every kind of matrix ( Figure 14 a). The share stays above 99 % 99\% in the first tenth of the layers and falls only toward the last layers, to 92 % 92\% for the query, key, and value matrices and to 84 84 to 87 % 87\% for the output and MLP matrices in the last tenth ( Figure 14 b). The part of the update that differs between inputs is thus small, and it is concentrated in the last layers.
blocks.zh: 我们在17项任务和18项模型上重复这一测量,结果是一样的:在几乎每一个经过调整的矩阵中,LORA为每一个输入都添加了几乎相同的矢量. 共享部分平均拥有89%的能量(中位数为98%,98),从Tulu-3-8B-SFT上的82%82,到Quen3.6-27B上的93%93,以及各种基质的97%97-97-98-98(图14a)。 份额保持在第10层的99%以上,直到最后一层,用于查询、键和值矩阵的占92%,用于产出和MLP矩阵的占84.84-87%(图14b)。 因此,更新中不同输入的部分很小,集中在最后一层。
