blocks.zh: D.4 调试前的模型

blocks.en:
Instruction tuning could be what makes adaptation rely on a shared component. We test this on the 3 models that never received instruction tuning: the base models behind Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-2B. They run on the same 17 tasks.
With only the shared component, the LoRA keeps 85 % 85\% [ 82 82 , 92 92 ] of its gain, and with it removed 59 % 59\% [ 25 25 , 70 70 ], against 87 % 87\% [ 84 84 , 91 91 ] and 63 % 63\% [ 53 53 , 72 72 ] on the 14 instruction-tuned models. Per model, the fraction kept with only the shared component is 84 % 84\% for Llama-3.1-8B, 92 % 92\% for Qwen2.5-7B and 82 % 82\% for Gemma-2-2B.
blocks.zh:
指令调整可能是使适应依赖于共同组成部分的原因。 我们在3个从未接受过指令调制的模型上测试这个:Llama-3.1-8B,Quen2.5-7B和Gemma-2-2B背后的基础模型. 他们执行同样的17项任务。
LORA只保留了85%的85%[82 82,92 92]收益,并随即删除了59% 59%[25 25,70]收益,而在14个指令调整模型中,则取消了87% 87%[84 84,91 91]和63% 63%[53 53,72]收益。 每个型号,只保留共享组件的分数是:Llama-31-8B为84%,Quen2.5-7B为92%,Gemma-2-2B为82%。

blocks.en: On the 9 behaviors, the same 3 models keep 81 % 81\% [ 76 76 , 90 90 ] of the gain with only the shared component and 55 % 55\% [ 51 51 , 59 59 ] with it removed, against 87 % 87\% [ 80 80 , 92 92 ] and 39 % 39\% [ 29 29 , 49 49 ] on the 14 instruction-tuned models. Per model, the fraction kept with only the shared component is 76 % 76\% for Llama-3.1-8B, 90 % 90\% for Qwen2.5-7B and 78 % 78\% for Gemma-2-2B ( Figure 12 b). Adaptation relies on the shared component before instruction tuning, on tasks and behaviors alike.
blocks.zh: 在9个行为上,同一3个模型保留了81%的81%[76.76,90.90]收益,只有共享部分,55%的55.%[51.51,5959]被移除,而在14个指令调制模型中,87%的87.[80.80,92]和39%的39.%[29.29,4949]. 每个模型中,仅保留共享组件的分数为:Llama-31-8B的76%76%;Quen2.5-7B的90%90%;Gemma-2-2B的78%78%(图12b)。 适应取决于指令调整前的共同组成部分、任务和行为。

blocks.en: D.5 Interventions on the traits and transformations
blocks.zh: D.5 关于特征和转变的干预

blocks.en: Figure 15: The two interventions per model on the traits and transformations. Fraction of the LoRA gain kept with only the shared component (hollow) and with it removed (filled), 18 models, in the order of Figure 12 b.
blocks.zh: 图15:每个模型关于特征和转化的两种干预措施。 仅保留共享组件(hollow)的LORA收益分数,并删除(填充),18个模型,依图12b的顺序排列.

blocks.en: We apply the two interventions to LoRAs trained on the 4 traits and the 3 transformations. What the LoRA adds at an adapted matrix is a ⁡ ( x ) = Δ ​ W ​ z ​ ( x ) a(x)=\Delta Wz(x) . Keeping only the shared component replaces it by a ¯ = Δ ​ W ​ μ \bar{a}=\Delta W\mu at every position, while the input is read and at every generated token, where μ \mu is the mean input of the matrix at the last token of held-out probes: held-out instructions given as bare prompts, disjoint from training. Removing the shared component keeps a ⁡ ( x ) − a ¯ = Δ ​ W ​ ( z ⁡ ( x ) − μ ) a(x)-\bar{a}=\Delta W(z(x)-\mu) at every position. The estimate of μ \mu does not depend on which probes or how many are used ( Section D.8 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把两项干预措施应用于经过4个特点和3个转变培训的LORAs。 LORA在经过调整的矩阵中添加的是一个 QQ (x) = Δ W z (x) a (x) =\ Delta Wz (x) . 仅保留共享组件将替换为“ = = = W μ\ bar{ a} 。 Delta W\mu在每一个位置,而输入则被读取,并在每一个生成的符号上读取,其中μ \ mu是矩阵在被搁置探测器最后一个符号上的平均输入: 被搁置指示作为光提示给出,与训练脱节. 删除共享组件时, 每个位置都保留 QQ (x) − a = QW (z ⁡ (x) − μ) a (x)-\ bar{a}=\ Delta W(z (x)-\mu) 。 μ\mu的估计数并不取决于使用哪个探测器或使用多少探测器(D.8节)。

blocks.en: Across the 18 models (14 instruction-tuned and the 4 of Appendix C ), the LoRA keeps 88 % 88\% [ 83 83 , 92 92 ] of its gain on the traits and 92 % 92\% [ 85 85 , 96 96 ] on the transformations with only its shared component, and 33 % 33\% [ 23 23 , 43 43 ] and 57 % 57\% [ 46 46 , 67 67 ] with it removed. These intervals resample models. Figure 15 draws every model, with the traits and the transformations apart.
blocks.zh: 在整个18种模式(14种指令调整和附录C的4种)中,LORA保留着88% 88 \% [83 83,92 92] 的特质收益,92% 92 \% [85 85,96 96] 的转换只有其共同成分,33% 33 \% [23 23,43 43] 和57% 57 \% [46 46,67] 的特性收益,同时将其删除。 这些间隔重现模型. 图15绘制了每个模型,其特征和转变是分开的。

blocks.en: The adaptation field of these LoRAs points along its shared component at a cosine of 0.84 0.84 [ 0.80 0.80 , 0.87 0.87 ], and the shared component holds 71 % 71\% [ 65 65 , 76 76 ] of the field’s energy, over the 18 models on the 9 behaviors. Both statistics are averaged over the layers the adapter reaches, as on the tasks ( Section C.7 ). On behaviors as on tasks, the shared component alone keeps most of the gain, and removing it keeps far less.
blocks.zh: 这些LORAs的适应场沿其共享的元件在0.84 0.84 [0.80 0.80, 0.87 0.87] 的余弦上标注,共享的元件持有71% 71\% [65 65, 76] 的元件,比起关于9种行为的18种模型. 这两个统计数据均按适配器所达到的层次和任务进行平均计算(C.7节)。 在行为和任务上,共享组件单独保留了大部分收益,去除它则保持远小.

blocks.en: D.6 Interventions on the maps
blocks.zh: D.6 关于地图的发言

blocks.en: The cipher and the lookup are the two behaviors whose rule the model can only learn during adaptation. Over the 18 models, the LoRA keeps 84 % 84\% [ 79 79 , 89 89 ] of its gain on the cipher and 64 % 64\% [ 50 50 , 77 77 ] on the lookup with only its shared component, and 33 % 33\% [ 20 20 , 46 46 ] and 19 % 19\% [ 9 9 , 30 30 ] with it removed. The lookup keeps the least of any benchmark, as expected for a table of new content ( Section E.6 ), so part of the table sits in the LoRA’s input-specific component. A shift adapter trained directly on the lookup learns it ( Section E.5 ).
blocks.zh: 密码和望子是两种行为,其规则模型只能在适应时学习. 在18种模式中,LORA在密码上保留了84%的84\%[79 79,89 ]],在只使用其共享组件的检索上保留了64%的64\%[50 50,7777],在删除后保留了33%的33\%[20 20,46]和19%的19\%[9 9,30]。 检索保持了任何基准中的最低值,如新内容表(E.6节)所预期的那样,因此表中的一部分位于LORA具体输入部分。 一个直接接受过仰视培训的转向适配器学习了它(E.5节)。

blocks.en: D.7 Reading and writing
blocks.zh: D.7 读写

blocks.en: The interventions change what the adapter adds at every position. Here we ask at which positions the adapter has to be active at all. We keep the trained update unchanged in one phase and switch it off in the other. Active only while reading, the update is switched off at every generated position. Active only while writing, it is switched off while the input is read. Switching off acts on the same adapted matrices as the interventions. The first generated token comes from the forward pass over the input, so it belongs to the reading phase. We report each condition as a fraction of the run’s gain ( Figure 16 ).
blocks.zh: 干预措施改变了适配器在每个位置上增加的内容。 在这里,我们询问适配器在哪个位置必须活动. 一个阶段我们保持训练有素的更新不变,另一个阶段关闭. 仅在读取时活动,更新在每个生成的位置都会关闭. 仅在写入时激活, 它在读取输入时被关闭 。 关闭与干预措施相同的调整矩阵。 最早生成的符号来自输入的前传,所以属于读相. 我们报告每个条件都是跑步收益的一小部分(图16)。

blocks.en: Figure 16: Adaptation acts while the model reads. Fraction of the gain kept with the adapter active only while reading or only while writing, per task, median and quartiles over the runs of the 18 models whose gain reaches 0.05 0.05 . On DBpedia, a classification task scored on one label token, either phase alone keeps most of the gain.
blocks.zh: 图16: 适应在模型读取时起作用。 每个任务、中位数和四分位数在18种模型运行时只读或只写时与适配器保持小分数,其增益达到0.050.05。 在DBpedia上,一个分类任务在一个标签符上得分,任何一个阶段都单独保留大部分收益.

blocks.en: Across the 18 models, on the 6 generative behaviors and tasks (bullets, French, pirate, last word, conditional echo and GSM8K), over the 324 324 runs, the update active only while reading keeps 83 % 83\% of the gain, and active only while writing 12 % 12\% . In a quarter of the 303 303 runs whose gain reaches 0.05 0.05 , reading alone keeps more than the full update, up to 165 % 165\% , so switching the adapter off during generation can raise adherence.
blocks.zh: 在18种模式中,关于6种遗传行为和任务(布列特、法语、海盗、最后一个词、有条件的回声和GSM8K),在324 324次运行中,更新只在读取时有效,保留收益的83% 83%;在写作时有效,12% 12%。 在收益达到0.050.05的303次运行中的四分之一中,单读保持了超过全部更新,高达165 % 165%,因此在一代中切换适配器可以提高坚持性.

blocks.en: Two cases differ. On label-token classification, either phase alone suffices: the update at the last input position alone keeps 92 % 92\% to 101 % 101\% of the gain, and the update everywhere except that position keeps 68 % 68\% to 100 % 100\% (medians over the seeds of each of the 18 models, and 82 % 82\% reading and 99 % 99\% writing on DBpedia pooled, Figure 16 ). There is no generated text, and the update at the last position adds directly to the label logit. The order reverses on three behaviors of the base models: pirate on the base models behind Llama-3.1-8B and Gemma-2-2B, where writing keeps 76 % 76\% and 81 % 81\% of the gain against − 1 % -1\% and 4 % 4\% for reading, and bullets on the Gemma-2-2B base model, where writing keeps 113 % 113\% against 41 % 41\% , every seed in the same order. In their saved generations the update active only while reading sets the first word and the model continues in its own register, and active only while writing the model starts in its own register and takes the persona or the list form within a sentence. Pirate on the Qwen2.5-7B base model leans the same way by a smaller margin ( 62 % 62\% against 47 % 47\% ), with both phases producing the persona. On Gemma-2-2B with bullets the two phases tie ( 61 % 61\% against 56 % 56\% , the seeds split).
blocks.zh: 两个案件不同。 就标签分类而言,仅两个阶段都足够:仅最后一个输入位置的更新就保留了收益的92%、92%、92%、101%、除了该位置之外,各地的更新都保持了68%、68 %、100%、100 %(18种模型的种子上都有媒体,在DBpedia集合上读取了82%、99 %)。 没有生成文本,最后一个位置的更新直接添加到标签日志中. 命令颠倒了基础模型的三种行为:Llama-3.1-8B和Gemma-2-2B的基模型上的海盗,写作保留了76%的76\%和81%的81\%对-1%-1\%和4%-4\%对读,以及Gemma-2-2B的基模型上的子弹,写作保留了113%-113\%对41\%,每个种子的顺序相同. 在他们保存的几代人中,更新只在读出第一个单词时激活,模型在自己的寄存器中继续运行,在写出该寄存器在自己的寄存器中开始,并在句子中采用人物或列表形式时才激活. Qwen2.5-7B基型上的海盗以较小的比值(62% 62\%对47% 47\%)同样倾斜,两个阶段都产生人物a. 在带子弹的Gemma-2-2B上,两个阶段的领带(61%的61\%对56%的56\%,种子分裂).

blocks.en: The shared component alone, in each phase. The test above switches the whole adapter on or off. We combine it with the first intervention to ask whether the shared component alone is enough within each phase. On 6 models (Llama-3.2-1B and 3B, Qwen2.5-1.5B and 3B, SmolLM2-1.7B and Gemma-2-2B), we apply only the shared component Δ ​ W ​ μ \Delta W\mu during one phase and nothing during the other, and compare it with the full adapter active in the same phase.
blocks.zh: 在每个阶段,单独分担部分。 上面的测试打开或关闭整个适配器。 我们把它与第一次干预结合起来,以问,在每个阶段中,单独分担的部分是否足够。 在6种型号(Llama-3.2-1B和3B,Quen2.5-1.5B和3B,SmolLM2-1.7B和Gemma-2-2B)上,我们只在一个阶段应用共享的组件QQW μ →Delta W\mu,而在另一个阶段则没有应用,并将它与活跃在同一阶段的全适配器进行比较.

blocks.en: While the input is read, the shared component alone keeps a median 79 % 79\% of the gain over the 90 90 generative runs whose gain reaches 0.05 0.05 , against 92 % 92\% for the full adapter. The difference comes from one behavior on two models: pirate on Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.2-1B, where the shared component keeps 37 % 37\% and 50 % 50\% against 69 % 69\% and 76 % 76\% for the full adapter. It does not come from pirate needing the input-specific component: applied in both phases, the same shared component keeps 89 % 89\% to 97 % 97\% on these models. In the saved generations, a run takes the persona in its first words or not at all.
blocks.zh: 在读取输入时,仅共享组件就保持了90个基因循环的中位值79%的79%,而完全适配器的增益为92%的92%。 区别来自两种模式上的一种行为:Llama-3.2-3B和Llama-3.2-1B上的盗版,共享组件保留了37%的37\%和50%的50\%,而全适配器则保留了69%的69\%和76%的76\%. 这并非来自海盗需要特定输入部分:在两个阶段都适用,同一共享部分在这些模型上保留了89 % 89%到97 %97%。 在被拯救的几代人中,跑步会以第一话来夺取人格,或者根本就没有.

blocks.en: While the answer is written, the shared component alone keeps as much of the gain as the full adapter in all 30 30 medians over family and behavior, including Gemma-2-2B with bullets, where the two phases carry the same share ( 67 % 67\% against 66 % 66\% ). On the transformations both keep 0 % 0\% . Wherever a phase carries part of the gain, the shared component alone carries the same part.
blocks.zh: 虽然答案是书写的,但仅共享部分就保留了所有30个中位数的完整适配器,包括带子弹的Gemma-2-2B,这两个阶段所占份额相同(67%-67%=66.6%=66.6%)。 在转换时,两者都保持0%. 只要一个阶段带来部分收益,共享部分就具有相同的部分。

blocks.en: D.8 The estimate of the shared component and the evaluation size
blocks.zh: D.8 联合国 共享部分的估计和评价规模

blocks.en:
The shared component is estimated from held-out probes. We check on 3 models from 3 families (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Llama-3.2-3B and SmolLM2-1.7B) that the number of probes does not move the fractions.
The estimate converges quickly: its mean cosine to the estimate from all 200 200 probes is 0.988 0.988 from 10 10 probes, 0.995 0.995 from 20 20 and 0.999 0.999 from 100 100 . The fraction kept with only the shared component does not change with the number of probes: 94 % 94\% [ 90 90 , 97 97 ] on the traits whether μ \mu comes from 20 20 , 40 40 or 100 100 probes (largest change 0.001 0.001 ), and 95 % 95\% on the transformations.
Most of the uncertainty comes from differences between runs: in adherence, the interval over runs for the drop on the traits, [ 0.013 0.013 , 0.037 0.037 ], is wider than the bootstrap over probes within runs, [ 0.021 0.021 , 0.028 0.028 ], so measurement noise within a run does not drive the pooled interval.
Estimating μ \mu as the average input over every position of the prompt, instead of at its last token, keeps 55 % 55\% [ 44 44 , 66 66 ] of the gain on the traits against 87 % 87\% [ 82 82 , 92 92 ] at the last token, over the 18 models. The behavior relies on the component the adapter adds at the last token of the input.
blocks.zh:
共享部分是从搁置的探测器中估算出来的。 我们检查3个家庭的3个模型(Quen2.5-1.5B,Llama-3.2-3B和SmolLM2-1.7B),发现探测器的数量不会移动分数.
估计迅速汇合:其平均余弦与所有200个探测器的估计值为10个探测器的0.988 0.988,20个探测器的0.995 0.995,100 100个探测器的0.999 0.999. 仅保留共享成分的分数不会随着探测器数量的变化而变化:94% 94\% [90 90,97 ]]在特征上是μ\mu来自20 20,40 40还是100 100 个探测器(最大变化0.001 0.001),在转换上是95% 95\%.
大部分的不确定性来自运行间的差异:在坚持性上,对特征下降的间隔运行,[0.013 0.013,0.037 0.037],比运行内探测器的靴子圈更大,[0.021 0.021,0.028],因此运行内测量噪声不会驱动集合间隔.
将μ\mu估计为在提示的每个位置上的平均输入,而不是在最后的标语中,将特性收益的55% [44,44,66,66] 保留在最后一个标语中的87% [82,82,92] 相对于18种模型. 行为依赖于适配器在输入的最后一个符号上添加的组件.

blocks.en: D.9 The update without the rank constraint
blocks.zh: D.9 联合国 没有级别限制的更新

blocks.en: LoRA factorizes its update into two low-rank matrices, so the shared component could be a product of that factorization. We therefore apply the two interventions to an update that is not factorized. We train the matrices that a rank-8 LoRA adapts directly, with the ordinary optimizer, and keep every other parameter frozen, so weight decay pulls the update toward zero and not toward the base weights. The update is W FT − W 0 W_{\mathrm{FT}}-W_{0} , and we intervene on it exactly as on LoRA’s, at every position of the input and the answer. The setup follows Section D.5 , on the 18 models, the 4 traits and the 3 transformations. On the two maps, with only the shared component LoRA keeps 79 % 79\% [ 70 70 , 87 87 ] of its gain and the unconstrained update 54 % 54\% [ 46 46 , 61 61 ], and with it removed 26 % 26\% [ 17 17 , 37 37 ] and 19 % 19\% [ 10 10 , 29 29 ].
blocks.zh: LORA将其更新为两个低级矩阵,因此共享的组件可能是这种要素化的产物. 因此,我们把这两项发言应用于没有因地制宜的更新。 我们训练一个8级LORA直接适应的矩阵, 与普通的优化器, 并保持所有其他参数的冻结, 因此重量衰减将更新拉向零而不是基重。 最新消息是W FT – W 0 W_{\mathrm{FT}}-W_{0},我们正像LORA一样,在输入和答案的每一个位置上进行干预。 设置沿用D.5节,关于18种型号,4种特质和3种变换. 在两张地图上,只有共享组件LORA保留其收益的79% 79 \% [70 70,87] 和不受限制的更新 54% 54\% [46 46,61 61],并随即删除26% 26\% [17 17,37 37] 和19% 19\% [10 10,29].

blocks.en: The update has high rank, and training without weight decay leaves its stable rank and the shared component’s share of the energy unchanged on the 18 models ( 47.8 47.8 and 97.2 % 97.2\% , against 46.6 46.6 and 97.2 % 97.2\% with it), so weight decay does not produce the high rank. Its shared component holds 95 % 95\% of the energy of what it adds (median 98 % 98\% ), against 89 % 89\% for LoRA on the same runs ( Section D.3 ), so the concentration does not come from the parameterization. The two methods gain about the same, a mean trait gain of 0.442 0.442 for LoRA and 0.437 0.437 without the rank constraint, so their fractions compare directly. Removing the whole update returns the model to the base model within 0.020 0.020 in every run, so the interventions reach all of the update. The table below gives both fractions per model for both methods, with the stable rank and the share of the energy of the unconstrained update.
blocks.zh: 更新的级别很高,没有重量衰减的训练留下了稳定的级别,共享部分在18种型号上的能量份额不变(47.8 47.8和97.2 %97.2\%,与之相比46.6 46.6和97.2 %97.2\%),因此重量衰减不能产生高等级. 其共享的成分占其添加的能量的95%(中间值98%),而LORA在同一运行(D.3节)中的能量占89%(89),因此浓度不来自参数化。 这两种方法的得益大致相同,LORA的平均特质收益为0.442 0.442和0.437 0.437,没有等级限制,因此它们的分数直接比较. 移除整个更新在每次运行的0.020 0.020内将模型返回到基础模型,因此干预到达所有更新. 下表给出了两种方法的每个模型的分数,稳定的等级和无约束更新的能量份额.

blocks.en:
Pooled over runs as fractions of each method’s own gain, with only the shared component LoRA keeps 87 % 87\% [ 82 82 , 91 91 ] on the traits and the unconstrained update 69 % 69\% [ 57 57 , 80 80 ], and on the transformations 91 % 91\% [ 83 83 , 96 96 ] against 74 % 74\% [ 61 61 , 84 84 ]. With the shared component removed, LoRA keeps 39 % 39\% [ 28 28 , 51 51 ] against 26 % 26\% [ 13 13 , 39 39 ] on the traits, and 59 % 59\% [ 49 49 , 68 68 ] against 49 % 49\% [ 37 37 , 61 61 ] on the transformations. These intervals resample models. Resampling runs, the shared component alone keeps 87 % 87\% [ 83 83 , 90 90 ] against 69 % 69\% [ 63 63 , 75 75 ] on the traits and 91 % 91\% [ 88 88 , 94 94 ] against 74 % 74\% [ 69 69 , 78 78 ] on the transformations, and the intervals of the two methods separate in both classes.
The gap varies by model: with only the shared component, the two methods are close on Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-4B and far apart on SmolLM2-1.7B.
blocks.zh:
组合运行作为每种方法自身收益的分数,只有共享组件LORA保留了87 % 87 % [82 82,91 91] 的特征和不受限制的更新 69 % 69 % [57 57, 80 80], 以及91% 91 % [83 83, 96 96] 对 74 % 74 % [61 61, 84 ] 的转换。 随着共享组件的移除,LORA保留了39%的39\%[28 28,51],而特征为26%的26\%[13 13,3939],转型为59%的59\%[49 49,6868],而转型为49%的49\%[37 37,61]. 这些间隔重现模型. 复标运行,仅共享组件就保留了87% 87% [83 83,90],特征为69% 69% [63 63,75 75],特征为91% 91% [88 88,94],转换为74% 74% [69 69,78],两种方法的间隔在两个类别中分开.
差距因型号而异:只有共享组件,两种方法在Llama-3.1-8B和Qune3-4B上接近,在SmolLM2-1.7B上相距甚远.

blocks.en: Mistral-7B. A shift adapter trained directly on Mistral-7B reaches 97 % 97\% of LoRA’s gain on the traits and 92 % 92\% on the transformations ( Section D.10 ), so a constant suffices on this model. Its LoRA keeps the least with either component alone, 47 % 47\% of LoRA’s gain with only the shared component and 18 % 18\% with it removed, so neither component alone carries most of its gain. With only the shared component, it keeps 76 % 76\% on the traits, close to the other models, and 30 % 30\% on the transformations. We measure how strongly the full update changes each model by the perplexity on WikiText. The unconstrained update raises the perplexity of Mistral-7B by a median factor of 3.1 3.1 , against 1.0 1.0 for Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2.5-7B, so Mistral-7B reacts more strongly to an update, already before any component is removed, and its low fractions do not show a missing capacity. On the 17 tasks, Mistral-7B has two routes to its gain: its LoRA keeps 75 % 75\% of the gain with only the shared component and 78 % 78\% with it removed, while for the largest instruction-tuned model of each other family, removing the shared component keeps 30 % 30\% to 76 % 76\% .
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-07-29). Mistral-7B. 直接在Mistral-7B上训练的调值器在LORA的特性上达到97 % , 在转换上达到92 % , (D.10节),所以这个模型的常数就足够了。 它的LORA只保留其中任何一个部分,47%的LORA收益只有共享部分,18%的18 %被移除,因此,单靠两个部分都无法带来大部分收益。 只有共享组件,它保持了76%的76\%在特征上,接近其他模型,30%的30\%在转换上. 我们用WikiText上的迷惑度来衡量 完整更新对每个模型的改变有多强烈。 无约束更新使Mistral-7B的复杂度上升了3.1 3.1的中位因子,而Llama-3.1-8B和Quen2.5-7B的中位因子为1.0 1.0,因此Mistral-7B在任何组件被移除之前就已经对更新做出更强烈的反应,其低分量并不显示缺失容量. 在17项任务中,Mistral-7B有两条通往其收益的路线:其LORA只保留75%的75QQ收益,并只保留共享组件,而78%的78QQ收益被移除,而对于对方家族最大的指令调制模型,移除共享组件则保留30%的30QQ至76%的76QQ.

blocks.en: Without the rank constraint, the shared component holds more of the energy of the update and the behavior relies on it somewhat less, so the reliance does not come from the low rank.
blocks.zh: 没有等级限制,共享组件持有更多的更新的能量,行为对它的依赖也稍少一些,因此依赖并不来自低等级.

blocks.en: D.10 In-context learning
blocks.zh: D.10 文中学习

blocks.en: In-context learning adapts without training, through demonstrations in the prompt. We apply the two interventions to the demonstrations and to a LoRA trained in the same runs, and call each of these two ways of adapting a route . A shift adapter trained in the same runs is a third route.
blocks.zh: 内涵学习不经过训练就适应,通过即时演示. 我们用这两次干预来对付示威, 在同一跑道中训练的转向适配器是第三条路线.

blocks.en:
Experimental setup. We use the 18 models and the 9 behaviors of the setup: the traits French, bullet points, pirate and grumpy critic, the transformations copy, last word and conditional echo, and the maps cipher and lookup.
In each run the demonstrations are four question–answer pairs before the query. For the traits, the answers are the model’s own answers under the behavior’s system prompt, each passing the behavior’s rule-based verifier, and the prompt uses the chat template. For the transformations and maps, the answers are the task’s targets, and the prompt is plain text behind a preamble that asks the model to continue the pattern, because an instruction-tuned model under its template answers the last question instead. The maps get their whole 26 26 -word table before the 4 examples, since 4 examples cover only 4 of its 26 26 entries.
The field of the demonstrations is the change they make to the hidden state at the last token of the input, h ⁡ ( demonstrations + x ) − h ⁡ ( x ) h(\text{demonstrations}+x)-h(x) , and its shared component is the mean of that change over 40 40 probe queries. To keep only the shared component, we add it to the bare query, one vector per layer at every position of the input and the answer, scaled by α ∈ { 0.5 , 1 , 2 } \alpha\in\{0.5,1,2\} chosen per family and class on seed 0 0 . To remove it, we keep the demonstrations and subtract it at every position. As a control, a random vector of the same norm per layer is added and subtracted in the same way.
A rank-8 LoRA and a shift adapter are trained in the same run on the same 160 160 answers under the same prompt format, and the LoRA is run as trained, with only its shared component, and without it ( Section D.1 ). Every route is scored on the same 48 48 held-out queries, by the behavior’s rule-based verifier or, for pirate and grumpy critic, by token F1 against the model’s own answers under the system prompt. Fractions pool every run, and intervals resample models. The demonstration, probe, training and evaluation queries are disjoint.
blocks.zh:
实验设置. 我们使用设定的18种模型和9种行为:法国的特征,弹点,海盗和暴躁的批评家,变形复制品,最后的词和有条件的回声,以及地图的密码和检索.
每一次示威都是四个问题回答对, 对于特征,答案是模型在行为系统提示下自己给出的答案,每一个通过行为基于规则的验证器,提示使用聊天模板. 对于变换和地图,答案是任务的目标,而提示是前言后面的纯文本,它要求模型继续图案,因为其模板下的一个指示调制模型反而回答了最后一个问题. 这些地图在4个实例之前得到了完整的26个26字表格,因为4个实例仅涵盖其26个条目中的4个。
演示的场面是它们在输入的最后一个符号上对隐藏状态所作的改变,h (演示+x)−h⁡(x) h(\text{演示}+x)-h(x),其共享的成分是该变化的平均值超过40个探测查询. 为了保留共享的组件,我们把它添加到赤裸的查询中,在输入和答案的每个位置每层一个矢量,缩放为α { { { { { { { { α\ { { { { { { { 0, 1, { { { o { { { { { 0,1, { { o \ \ 0,1,2}, o o o o o 0 上的每个家庭和班级选取。 为了移除它,我们保留示威,并在每一个位置减去示威。 作为控件,每层都以同样的方式加减同一规范的随机矢量.
在一个8级LORA和一个班次适配器在相同的即时格式下在同一160个160个答案上进行同样的运行训练,LORA运行时是训练有素的,只有其共享组件,没有它(D.1节). 每条路线都是通过48个被搁置的查询, 由行为规则的验证人进行, 每跑一次小分数集合,间隔重现模型. 演示、探测、培训和评价询问是脱节的。

blocks.en:
Results. Figure 17 compares the two routes behavior by behavior. The demonstrations gain 0.30 0.30 on the traits, 0.60 0.60 on the transformations and 0.02 0.02 on the maps, where the LoRA gains 0.57 0.57 , 0.94 0.94 and 0.87 0.87 , and the shift adapter 0.57 0.57 , 0.91 0.91 and 0.68 0.68 .
With only their shared component, the demonstrations keep 64 % 64\% [ 47 47 , 92 92 ] of their gain on the traits and 46 % 46\% [ 40 40 , 52 52 ] on the transformations, where the LoRA keeps 87 % 87\% [ 82 82 , 91 91 ] and 89 % 89\% [ 82 82 , 95 95 ]. On the maps the LoRA keeps 70 % 70\% [ 59 59 , 79 79 ], and the demonstrations gain 0.02 0.02 , too little for their fraction to mean anything ( 33 % 33\% [ 3 3 , 84 84 ]).
Removing the shared component of the demonstrations keeps none of their gain: − 25 % -25\% [ − 43 -43 , − 11 -11 ] on the traits and − 2 % -2\% [ − 2 -2 , − 1 -1 ] on the transformations. Removing a random vector of the same norm keeps 15 % 15\% [ − 4 -4 , 34 34 ] on the traits and 14 % 14\% [ 3 3 , 27 27 ] on the transformations, so on both the removal is specific to the shared component. Removing the shared component of the LoRA keeps 43 % 43\% [ 31 31 , 55 55 ] on the traits and 62 % 62\% [ 50 50 , 73 73 ] on the transformations.

结果。 图17按行为比较了两种路线的行为. 演示在特征上收获了0.30 0.30,在变形上收获了0.60 0.60,在地图上收获了0.02 0.02,其中LORA号获得0.57 0.57,0.94 0.94和0.87 0.87,转向适配器0.57 0.57,0.91 0.91和0.68 0.68.
示威只保留了64%的64\%[4747,92 ]]在特征上的收益,以及46%的46\%[4040,52 ]]在转型上的收益,LORA保留了87%的87\%[82 82,91 ]]和89%的89\%[82 82,95 95]. 在地图上,LORA保留了70%的70 Q[59 59,79 79],示威获得0.02 0.02,对于他们的分数来说太小,没有意义(33% 33 Q[3 3,84 84]).
消除演示中共享的部分不会保留任何收益: - 25% - 25\% [−43-43,− 11-11] 在特征上, − 2% - 2\% [−2-2,− 1-1] 在转变上. 同一规范的随机矢量的去除使特性保持15% 15% → [− 4-4,34 34] ,变换特性保持14% 14% → [3 3,27],因此这两个去除都是针对共享成分的. 移除LORA的共享组件保留了43%的43\%[31 31,55 ]]的特征,以及62%的62\%[50 50,73 ]]的转换.

blocks.en: Pirate and grumpy critic. On these two traits the score and the generations disagree. The demonstrations gain 0.11 0.11 on pirate and 0.05 0.05 on grumpy critic, and with only their shared component they fall below the base model on both (gains of − 0.14 -0.14 and − 0.07 -0.07 ), which lowers the pooled trait numbers above. We read the saved generations of 10 instruction-tuned models. Under the demonstrations, the generations of Mistral-7B, SmolLM2-1.7B, Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-4B carry a pirate marker as often as under the shift adapter ( 87 % 87\% to 99 % 99\% of them, against 98 % 98\% to 100 % 100\% ), yet their F1 gain over the base model is 63 % 63\% to 106 % 106\% of the trained one (Mistral 0.42 0.42 against 0.41 0.41 for the shift adapter, SmolLM2 0.39 0.39 against 0.46 0.46 ), because the trained routes reproduce the teacher’s sentences and the demonstrations write their own. The three Qwen2.5 models carry the marker in 36 % 36\% to 41 % 41\% of their generations. Llama-3.2-1B refuses (“I can’t help with that”, F1 0.04 0.04 against 0.20 0.20 for the base model), and Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B continue the demonstration transcript (“I’ll answer your questions one by one, matey. Q: …”, markers in 49 % 49\% of their generations). The short pirate and grumpy critic spokes of Figure 17 therefore measure how closely the demonstrations reproduce the teacher’s answers, and the generations carry the pirate marker in 36 % 36\% to 99 % 99\% of cases in nine of these 10 models.

Median cosine per layer decile over every run on the 9 behaviors of the setup, quartiles shaded, for 3 pairs of routes: the shift adapter and the demonstrations, the LoRA and the demonstrations, the LoRA and the shift adapter. blocks.en:
Shared components and fields through depth. Figure 18 compares the shared components of the three routes, and their fields, layer by layer. The shift adapter’s vector and the shared component of the demonstrations are orthogonal at every layer: the median cosine per layer decile lies between 0.00 0.00 and 0.03 0.03 on the traits and transformations and is at most 0.08 0.08 on the maps, and at most 0.31 0.31 in any run and layer. The shared component of the LoRA, the vector per layer that keeping only it adds, is also orthogonal to that of the demonstrations (median cosine per layer decile at most 0.04 0.04 on the traits and transformations and 0.09 0.09 on the maps, at most 0.30 0.30 in any run and layer). The two trained routes agree more with depth, from a median cosine of 0.15 0.15 , 0.17 0.17 and 0.04 0.04 in the first layer decile on the traits, transformations and maps to 0.52 0.52 , 0.68 0.68 and 0.84 0.84 in the last.
The fields are not orthogonal. By the ninth layer decile, the fields of the shift adapter and the demonstrations reach a cosine of 0.47 0.47 on the traits and 0.51 0.51 on the transformations, the fields of the shared component of the LoRA and of the demonstrations 0.43 0.43 and 0.53 0.53 , and the fields of the two trained routes 0.77 0.77 and 0.66 0.66 , reaching 0.84 0.84 and 0.66 0.66 in the last decile. The trained routes add vectors orthogonal to the shared component of the demonstrations, and their fields meet the field of the demonstrations in the late layers.
blocks.zh:
通过深度共享组件和字段 。 图18比较了这三条路线的共享组件,以及它们的球场,层层. 转向适配器的矢量和演示的共享成分在每一层都是正交的:每层十进制的中位余弦位于特征和变换上0.00至0.030.03之间,在地图上最多为0.080.08,在任何运行和层上最多为0.310.31。 LORA的共享部分,即只保留其添加的每层矢量,也与演示物的矢量成正交(在特征和变换上,每层每十分位的中位数为0.04 0.04,在地图上为0.09 0.09,在任何运行和层中,最多0.30 0.30)。 两条经过训练的航线在深度上更为一致,从特征、变换和地图上第一层的0.15 0.15、0.17 0.17和0.04 0.04的中位余到最后一层的0.52 0.52、0.68 0.68和0.84 0.84。
田产不正统. 到第9层十分位,转向适配器的球场和演示品在特征上达到0.47 0.47的余弦,在转化上达到0.51 0.51的余弦,LORA的共享部分和演示品的球场0.43 0.43和0.53 0.53的余弦,两条训练有素的航线的球场0.77 0.77和0.66 0.66的余弦,在最后一个十分位中达到0.84 0.84和0.66 0.66的余弦. 训练有素的路线在示威的共同部分中增加了正交矢量,他们的田野在后层与示威现场相遇.

blocks.en: On the tasks. We run the same two interventions on 4 of the tasks of Section 3 , AG News, SST-2, OpenBookQA and HellaSwag, over the 18 models. Each run puts four label-balanced demonstrations before the query, takes their shared component as the mean change at the last token of the input over 300 300 probe queries, and chooses the scale α ∈ { 0.05 , 0.1 , 0.25 , 0.5 , 1 , 2 } \alpha\in\{0.05,0.1,0.25,0.5,1,2\} on a held-out slice of 300 300 rows. Every route is then scored on the task’s full evaluation split. A rank-8 LoRA trained in the same run on the task’s training rows, never on the demonstrations, is scored the same way.
blocks.zh: 在任务上。 我们用同样的两种方式处理第3节、AG新闻、SST-2、OpenBookQA和HelaSwag的4项任务。 每次运行在查询前都会进行四个标签平衡的演示,在输入的最后一个符号上将其共享的组件作为平均变化,超过300个探针查询,并选择α { { 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2}\alpha\in 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1,2}在300行的悬浮片上进行. 每条路线都得分, 在任务训练排上接受同样训练的8级LORA,

blocks.en:
Four demonstrations change these tasks little: the median gain over the runs is 0.033 0.033 (quartiles 0.011 0.011 to 0.078 0.078 ), and one run (Llama-3.2-1B on AG News) ends 0.267 0.267 below the bare prompt ( Figure 19 b). The demonstrations gain 0.05 0.05 or more on average only on AG News, SST-2 and OpenBookQA.
With only their shared component, the demonstrations keep 42 % 42\% [ 26 26 , 58 58 ] of their gain over every run, where the LoRA trained in the same runs keeps 83 % 83\% [ 75 75 , 89 89 ] of its own, and a random vector of the same norm keeps − 14 % -14\% [ − 36 -36 , − 1 -1 ]. On AG News and SST-2 the demonstrations keep 50 % 50\% and 47 % 47\% , where the LoRA keeps 94 % 94\% and 96 % 96\% on the same runs ( Figure 19 a). On OpenBookQA the demonstrations keep 20 % 20\% where the LoRA keeps 78 % 78\% , and on HellaSwag their mean gain is below 0.05 0.05 , too little for a fraction, while the LoRA keeps 66 % 66\% . The fractions of the LoRA on every task are in Section D.2 .
With 16 demonstrations, the shared component alone keeps 41 % 41\% [ 23 23 , 58 58 ] and removing it keeps 49 % 49\% [ 34 34 , 69 69 ], against 42 % 42\% and 39 % 39\% with four.
blocks.zh:
四次演示都很少改变这些任务:运行时的中位增益为0.033 0.033(quartiles 0.011 0.011至0.078 0.078),一次运行(Llama-3.2-1B在AG News上)结束于光速下0.267 0.267(图19b). 仅在AG News,SST-2和OpenBookQA上,示威活动平均得分为0.050.05或更高.
示威只保留了42%的42 \% [26 26, 58 58] 其每次运行的收益,在同一运行中训练的LORA保留了83%的83 \% [75 75, 89 89] 自身,同一规范的随机矢量保持了 — 14% - 14 \% [− 36 - 36, − 1 - 1]. 在AG News和SST-2上,示威活动保持50%的50%和47%的47%,而LORA则保持94%的94%和96%的96%在同一跑道上(图19a)。 在OpenBookQA上, 示威活动保留了20%的20%, 每项任务的LORA分数载于D.2节。
在16次示威中,仅共享部分就保留了41%的41\%[23 23,58 ]],删除部分则保留了49%的49\%[34 34,69 ]],而42%的42\%和39%的39\%有4\%.

blocks.en:
Removing the shared component from the prompt with the demonstrations keeps 39 % 39\% [ 17 17 , 57 57 ], against 80 % 80\% [ 71 71 , 87 87 ] for removing a random vector of the same norm, so the direction matters. The scale is chosen for keeping only the shared component and reused for the removal, and in 35 35 of the 216 216 runs the removal sends the model to one class, which widens the interval. At full strength it does so in every run, as on the behaviors.
Through depth, the shared components of the two routes are orthogonal, with a median cosine per layer decile between 0.00 0.00 and 0.02 0.02 over all runs, while their fields converge, from 0.00 0.00 in the first decile to 0.74 0.74 in the last (quartiles [ 0.59 0.59 , 0.85 0.85 ], Figure 19 c). Table 6 gives the values per model.
On behaviors and tasks, the shared component of the demonstrations is orthogonal to LoRA’s and keeps less of the gain than LoRA’s on the traits, the transformations and the tasks, so in-context learning reaches similar behaviors by a different route from LoRA.

These splits are unbalanced, so the majority-class rate is reported beside every result.

blocks.en: E.2 Full fine-tuning on the same tasks
blocks.zh: E.2 联合国 完全调整相同的任务

blocks.en: Full fine-tuning updates every weight. We train it with AdamW in bfloat16 for 500 500 steps, the budget of the LoRA, at a learning rate selected per model and task from the 6 rates of Section C.5 , on the 17 tasks and 18 models, scored on the same evaluation splits. The shift adapter is retrained in the same run at its selected rate, so every difference is paired within a run. The retrained shift adapter reproduces the shift adapter of Table 7 to a mean absolute difference of 0.004 0.004 .
blocks.zh: 完全微调更新每个重量。 我们和AdamW一起在bfloat16进行500个步骤的训练,这是LORA的预算,按照从C.5节的6个比率中选择的每个模式和任务的学习率,在17个任务和18个模式中,在同一评价分数上得分。 转向适配器按其选择的速率在同一运行中重新训练,因此每个差数都在运行内对齐. 重新训练的转向适配器复制表7的转向适配器,平均绝对差0.0040.004.

Pooled over the 18 models, full fine-tuning reaches 0.718 0.718 , the shift adapter and the rank-8 LoRA 0.745 0.745 , against 0.620 0.620 for the base model, a paired difference between the shift adapter and full fine-tuning of + 0.028 +0.028 [ + 0.025 +0.025 , + 0.030 +0.030 ] ( Table 8 ). The shift adapter is at or above full fine-tuning on every task except ARC-Challenge ( − 0.002 -0.002 ), and leads most on WinoGrande ( + 0.066 +0.066 ), CaseHOLD ( + 0.060 +0.060 ) and HellaSwag ( + 0.057 +0.057 ). Per model its lead ranges from + 0.011 +0.011 on Qwen3.6-27B to + 0.069 +0.069 on the base Gemma-2-2B.
Over 900 900 of these runs, the field of full fine-tuning has a cosine of 0.90 0.90 to its shared component and a field share of 0.81 0.81 , against 0.91 0.91 and 0.83 0.83 for the rank-8 LoRA, paired differences of − 0.009 -0.009 and − 0.015 -0.015 ( Figure 12 c). Full fine-tuning moves every input in nearly the same direction, as LoRA does.

在18种型号上合在一起,全微调达到0.718 0.718,转向适配器和级-8 LoRA 0.745 0.745,而基型号为0.620 0.620,转向适配器和全微调的对差为+0.028 + 0.028 [+0.025,+0.030] (表8). 除ARC-Challenge(−0.002 - 0.002)外,转向适配器在每项任务上均处于或高于完全微调,在WinoGrande(+0.066 + 0.066),CaseHOLD(+0.060 + 0.060)和HelaSwag(+0.057 + 0.057 + 0.057)上领先,每个型号的领先范围从Qune3.6-27B上的0.011 + 0.011到基座Gemma-2-2B上的0.069+ 0.069.
其中900900多次运行,全细调整领域其共享部分的同位素为0.90 0.90,战地份额为0.81 0.81,而第8级LORA为0.91 0.91和0.83 0.83,配对差异为−0.009-009和−0.015-0.015(图12c)。 完全的微调将每一个输入都向几乎相同的方向移动,就像LORA一样.

blocks.en: E.3 The comparison before instruction tuning
blocks.zh: E.3 联合国 指令调谐前的比较

blocks.en: We repeat the comparison on the 3 models that never received instruction tuning ( Section D.4 ), on the 17 tasks. The shift adapter reaches 0.748 0.748 and the rank-8 LoRA 0.743 0.743 , against 0.592 0.592 for the base model, a paired difference of + 0.005 +0.005 [ + 0.002 +0.002 , + 0.008 +0.008 ], and the shift adapter is at or above every rank from 1 1 to 64 64 . Full fine-tuning on the same models and tasks reaches 0.707 0.707 , below the shift adapter by + 0.041 +0.041 [ + 0.034 +0.034 , + 0.048 +0.048 ]. The parity with LoRA holds before instruction tuning, as the reliance on the shared component does ( Section D.4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们重复对从未接受指示调试的3种模式(D.4节)和17项任务的比较。 转向架适配器达到0.748 0.748和级-8 LoRA 0.743 0.743,对基准型号为0.592 0.592,对位差为+0.005 + 0.005 [+0.002 + 0.002 + 0.008 + 0.008],转向架适配器在1-1至64 64 的每个级以上. 完全微调相同的模型和任务达到0.707 0.707 ,在转动适配器下方为+0.041 + 0.041 [+ 0.034 + 0.034,+ 0.048 + 0.048]]. 指令调和前与LORA持平,与依赖共享组件一样(D.4节).

blocks.en: E.4 The shift adapter and the LoRA push in the same direction
blocks.zh: E.4 联合国 变速器和LORA向同一方向推进

blocks.en: The shift adapter and the LoRA are trained independently on the same teacher pairs, so we ask whether they push the inputs in the same direction. On the 17 tasks and 18 models, with both trained in the same run, the shared component of the LoRA aligns with the shift adapter at a cosine of 0.64 0.64 [ 0.60 0.60 , 0.68 0.68 ], against 0.06 0.06 [ 0.04 0.04 , 0.08 0.08 ] for a rank-8 LoRA with random weights and no training, measured in the same runs. On the 9 behaviors and 18 models, the two align at 0.53 0.53 [ 0.50 0.50 , 0.55 0.55 ], against 0.07 0.07 [ 0.05 0.05 , 0.11 0.11 ] for the random LoRA ( Figure 5 ). There, each input’s field points along its adapter’s shared component at a mean cosine of 0.85 0.85 [ 0.82 0.82 , 0.87 0.87 ] for the shift adapter and 0.84 0.84 [ 0.80 0.80 , 0.87 0.87 ] for the LoRA, against 0.66 0.66 [ 0.61 0.61 , 0.71 0.71 ] for the random LoRA. Weighting each layer by how far the two adapters move it raises the agreement between the shift adapter and the LoRA to 0.69 0.69 , while the random LoRA stays at 0.08 0.08 ( Section C.7 ). A LoRA that can vary what it adds with every input pushes along the direction the shift adapter learns.
blocks.zh: 转向调节器和LORA是在同一对老师身上独立训练的,所以我们问他们是否把输入推向同一个方向. 在17项任务和18项型号上,LORA的共享部分在0.64 0.64 [0.60 0.60,0.68 0.68]的余弦上与转向适配器对齐,对应0.06 0.06 [0.04 0.04,0.08] 的等级为8级的LORA,随机重量且没有训练,在同一运行中测量. 在9种行为和18种模型上,两种对齐为0.53 0.53 [0.50 0.50,0.55 0.55],对随机的LORA(图5)为0.07 0.07 [0.05 0.05,0.11 0.1]. 在那里,每个输入的字段点沿其适配器的共享部分,其平均余弦为0.85 0.85 [0.82 0.82, 0.87 0.87],转向适配器为0.84 0.84 [0.80 0.80, 0.87 0.87],而随机的洛拉为0.66 0.66 [0.61 0.61, 0.71 0.71]. 按两个适配器移动多远对每一层进行加权,使转向适配器与LORA之间的协议提高到0.69 0.69,而随机的LORA则停留在0.08 0.08(C.7节). 一个LORA,它能随着每一个输入而改变它所添加的东西,推动转向适配器学习的方向.

blocks.en: E.5 What a shift adapter can store
blocks.zh: E.5 联合国 变换器可以存储什么

blocks.en: With only its shared component, LoRA keeps the least of its gain on the maps, whose rule the model can only learn during adaptation ( Section D.6 ). A shift adapter trained directly on a map stores that content: it learns both maps, holds about 200 200 entries of a table, and splits into a shared component that performs the lookup and stored content that holds the entries. A map separates capacity from content. The base model holds the capacity to look an entry up and answer with it, but the entries of the table are new content, which the shift adapter has to store. Trained on few items, a shift adapter therefore answers a map on the entries it saw and not on the others, as stored content predicts, while on the behaviors it reaches most of its gain on instructions never seen in training ( Section E.6 ).
blocks.zh: LORA只拥有其共同组成部分,在地图上保留其收益最小,其规则是模型只能在适应时学习(D.6节)。 一个直接接受过地图存储内容培训的变位适配器:它学习两个地图,持有一个表格的大约200个条目,并分裂成一个共享组件来完成保存条目的浏览和存储内容. 地图将容量和内容区分开来. 基础模型具有向上查找一个条目并用它回答的能力,但表格的条目是新内容,转向适配器必须存储. 因此,一个调试器在少数项目上接受了训练,在它所看到的条目上回答地图,而不是在其他条目上回答,正如存储内容所预测的那样,而对于它的行为,它通过培训中从未看到的指示而获得的大部分收益(E.6节)。

blocks.en: Figure 22: The four combinations of shared component and stored content, and the answer each produces. The shared component (the training estimate) and the stored content are each added to the frozen model or left out, and the model answers a held-out prompt. With the stored content alone it writes ordinary text, with the shared component alone it invents an entry, and with both it returns an entry of a table. Each quoted answer is the first generated answer of Llama-3.2-3B (seed 0) under that combination.
blocks.zh: 图22:共享组件和存储内容的四种组合,答案各生成. 共享组件(培训估计)和存储内容各被添加到冷冻模型中或被忽略,模型回答一个被搁置的提示. 仅凭存储的内容,它会写普通的文本,仅用共享的组件就可以发明一个条目,两者都返回一个表格的条目. 每个引用的答案都是Llama-3.2-3B(种子0)在该组合下的第一个生成的答案.

blocks.en: A shift adapter learns the maps. We train a shift adapter directly on the cipher and on a lookup table whose entries are assigned at random, on 5 models from 4 families, and score its held-out generations by exact match. Each map has seven possible answers, so we read the score against the majority-class rate, the score of always giving the most common answer. The shift adapter exceeds that rate on both maps in every family, by 0.08 0.08 to 0.38 0.38 , with its answers spread over three to five of the seven, at the level of the LoRA. As a control, a third map, the number of words of the input modulo three, stays at or below the majority-class rate in every family. A shift adapter can therefore store content that pretraining never showed the model. The lower fraction on the maps in Section D.6 comes from the trained LoRA, which puts part of the map in its input-specific component, and a shift adapter trained directly on the map does without that component.
blocks.zh: 换班员学习地图. 我们直接在密码上和望台上训练一个变身器, 其条目是随机分配的, 从4个家庭的5个模型上, 并按精确的匹配来评分它被搁置的世代。 每张地图都有七个可能的答案, 所以我们读了比分 相对于多数阶层的比率, 得分总是给出最常见的答案。 转向适配器在每个家庭的两张地图上都超过了这个速率,比0.080.08到0.380.38,其答案分布在7个中的3到5个,在LORA一级. 作为控件,第三幅地图,输入的modulo 3的字数,在每个家族中都保持或低于多数阶级的速率. 因此,换位适配器可以存储预训从未显示模型的内容. D.6节地图的较低部分来自训练有素的LORA,该图将部分地图放在其输入特定组件中,而直接在地图上训练的变位适配器没有这个组件.

blocks.en: Figure 23: An actualizing state carries a finite amount of stored content. (a) Held-out lookup accuracy against the size of the table: the mean over the 18 models with a 95 % 95\% interval over models, each model faint behind it in its family’s color, and the rank-8 LoRA mean dashed. (b) The same per family, one line per model.

How much fits. We train a shift adapter on key–value tables of 100 100 to 500 500 entries and count the entries it answers on held-out queries. The count rises with the table, 99 99 , 146 146 , 181 181 , then 205 205 at 250 250 entries and 216 216 at 300 300 , and then falls, to 185 185 at 400 400 entries and 115 115 at 500 500 ( Figure 23 ). At 200 200 entries the models answer 0.55 0.55 to 1.00 1.00 of the table. A shift adapter therefore holds about 200 200 entries, and a larger table lowers the count. The field does not change at the limit: on the 5 families measured, from 100 100 to 500 500 entries, its magnitude ( 728 728 , 824 824 , 729 729 ), the share of its energy in the shared component ( 0.43 0.43 , 0.46 0.46 , 0.45 0.45 ) and the effective rank of its input-specific component ( 59 59 , 54 54 , 55 55 ) stay the same.
Rank does not move the limit: a rank-1 LoRA holds 500 entries as well as a rank-64 one ( 0.950 0.950 against 0.949 0.949 ). With only its shared component, a trained LoRA keeps 14 % 14\% of its gain at 500 entries, against 76 % 76\% at 100 100 , so past the shift adapter’s limit the content sits in the LoRA’s input-specific component.
Documents exceed the limit as well, and there the shift adapter stays close to the LoRA. On SQuAD a shift adapter recovers 56 % 56\% [ 53 53 , 59 59 ] of the gain of reading the document in context, against 61 % 61\% [ 59 59 , 64 64 ] for the LoRA, and on CoQA 13 % 13\% [ 10 10 , 16 16 ] against 17 % 17\% [ 14 14 , 21 21 ] ( 30 30 held-out documents each, 5 families).
blocks.zh:

文件也超过了限度,在那里,转向适配器停留在LORA附近. 在SQuAD上,一个调值器回收了56%的56分[53,53,59]个从上下文中读取该文件的收益,而在LORA上则回收了61%的61分[59,59,64]个,在CoQA上回收了13%的13分[10,10,16]个,在17%的17分[14,14,21](每个30个搁置文件,5个家庭).

The four kinds are the queried table’s entry, another table’s entry (any other table’s real entry), an invented entry, and ordinary text. (a) Bars are grouped by the stored content (none, the queried table’s, another table’s), and within a group by the source of the shared component: none, the training estimate (the mean of the 24 24 shift adapters under which the stored content was trained), an independent estimate from 24 24 other tables, or an estimate from a different task. The top row pools the 10 models, with bootstrap 95 % 95\% intervals over the 30 model-seed runs.
blocks.zh: 图24 每个栏将生成的答案分为四种,集合了10多个模型,每个模型有3个种子和4个存储内容表. 这四种是被询问表的条目、另一个表格的条目(任何其他表格的真正条目)、一个发明的条目和普通文本。 (a) 栏按所储存的内容(无、被询问的表、另一表)进行分组,在一组内按共同组成部分的来源进行分组:无、培训估计数(对所储存的内容进行培训的24个24个班次适配器的平均值)、24个其他表格的独立估计数或不同任务的估计数。 (b) 将被询问表的条目与被询问表的存储内容(每个模型(平均超过3个种子))放在共享组成部分的每个来源下的比率。 顶部排位将10个型号集合起来,在30个型号种子运行中,靴子的间隔为95% 95%。

blocks.en:
The shared component invokes the lookup, and the stored content supplies the entries. On the lookup, one trained shift adapter holds two things: the operation of looking an entry up, and the entries of one table. We separate them by construction. The shared component is estimated as the mean of 24 24 shift adapters, each trained on a different table over one set of 50 50 keys. With that estimate frozen in the model, a new per-layer vector, the stored content , is trained on the entries of a table outside the set. We then combine shared components and stored content from different sources and sort each generated answer into four kinds: the queried table’s entry, another table’s entry, an invented entry, and ordinary text (10 models, 4 tables of stored content, 48 48 held-out prompts each). One generated answer for each combination is shown in Figure 22 .
The stored content alone leaves the model’s behavior unchanged. The shared component alone makes the model look an entry up with nothing to read, so it invents one ( 0.98 0.98 [ 0.97 0.97 , 0.99 0.99 ] of answers). The shared component with another table’s stored content returns that table’s entries ( 0.99 0.99 [ 0.99 0.99 , 1.00 1.00 ]). A shared component estimated from 24 24 other tables still reads the stored content at 0.77 0.77 [ 0.70 0.70 , 0.84 0.84 ], from 0.99 0.99 or more on every Llama model to 0.34 0.34 on SmolLM2-1.7B ( Figure 24 ). Under a shared component trained for the reverse lookup, from value to key, the forward stored content returns 0.000 0.000 [ 0.000 0.000 , 0.001 0.001 ] of its entries, while a random direction at the same distance returns 0.76 0.76 [ 0.72 0.72 , 0.81 0.81 ], so the stored content holds the table in the direction the forward lookup reads it. The shared component carries the operation, and the stored content carries the content it reads.
blocks.zh:
共享组件引用了检索,存储的内容提供了条目. 在仰视上,一个训练有素的转向适配器持有两样东西:一是查看一个条目的操作,二是一个表格的条目. 我们用建筑来隔离他们 共享部分估计为24个24个班次适配器的平均值,每台在一套50个钥匙上经过不同的表格培训。 随着模型中这个估计被冻结,一个新的每层矢量,即存储的内容,就集外的表格条目进行培训。 然后,我们将共享组件和不同来源的存储内容合并,将每个生成的答案分为四种:被询问表的条目、另一个表格的条目、一个发明的条目和普通文本(10种模型、4个存储内容的表格、48个被搁置的提示)。 每种组合产生的一个答案见图22。
仅存内容没有改变模型的行为。 单是共享组件就使得模型看起来是一个没有读数的条目,所以它发明了一个(0.98 0.98 [0.97 0.97,0.99 0.99] 答案). 与另一表存储内容共享的部分返回该表的条目(0.99 0.99 [0.99 0.99, 1.00 1.00])。 根据24个其他表格的估计,储存内容为0.77 0.77 [0.70 0.70,0.84 0.84],从每个Llama模型的0.99 0.99或以上,到SmolLM2-1.7B模型的0.34 0.34(图24)。 在经过反向检索训练的共享组件下,从值到键,前方存储的内容返回其条目的0.000 0.000 [0.000 0.0001],而同一距离的随机方向则返回0.76 0.76 [0.72 0.72,0.81 0.81],所以存储的内容将表格放在前方浏览方向上. 共享组件承载操作,存储内容承载其读取的内容.

blocks.en: E.6 Training on few examples
blocks.zh: E.6 关于少数实例的培训

blocks.en: In the experiments above, we saw that a shift adapter can store about 200 200 table entries ( Section E.5 ). One could therefore ask whether its success on the behaviors comes from simply storing its training examples, i.e. , performing parameter-efficient memorization. To test this, we vary only the number of training examples. Across 4 architecture families (Qwen2.5-1.5B, Llama-3.2-3B, SmolLM2-1.7B and Gemma-2-2B) and 3 seeds, we train shift adapters and rank-8 LoRAs on 8 8 , 32 32 or 80 80 training examples ( 8 8 , 32 32 or 160 160 for the maps). For each seed, the training examples are drawn at random from the examples of the behavior. Every adapter is then evaluated on one set of 200 200 held-out examples, none of which is ever used for training, so all scores are on examples the adapter has never seen. We report the fraction of the gain at the largest training size that is kept at each smaller size.
blocks.zh: 在上述实验中,我们看到一个转向适配器可以存储约200200个表格条目(E.5节)。 因此,人们可以问,它在行为上的成功是否来自仅仅储存其培训实例,即执行参数高效的记忆。 为了检验这一点,我们只改变培训实例的数目。 在4个建筑家族(Quen2.5-1.5B、Llama-3.2-3B、SmolLM2-1.7B和Gemma-2-2B)和3个种子中,我们根据8个、32个或80个培训实例(地图8个、32个或160个160个)培训转向适配器和8个级LORA。 对于每个种子,培训实例都是从行为实例中随机抽取的. 每个适配器随后被评价为一组200个被搁置的范例,这些实例都从未用于训练,所以所有分数都是在适配器从未见过的实例上. 我们报告在最大培训规模上收益的一小部分,每小一个规模。

blocks.en: Behaviors. With 32 32 training examples, a shift adapter keeps on average 83 % 83\% of its gain at 80 80 training examples on the traits and 92 % 92\% on the transformations ( Figure 25 ). With only 8 8 training examples, it keeps 59 % 59\% on the traits and 68 % 68\% on the transformations. A rank-8 LoRA trained on the same examples keeps 71 % 71\% and 66 % 66\% . The values per family are given in Table 9 . All of these scores are on examples never seen in training, so the gain cannot come from storing the training examples. A few training examples thus suffice to actualize most of a behavior that the base model already holds.
blocks.zh: 行为者. 在32个培训实例中,一个班级适配器的平均收益率为83%,即80个关于特质的培训实例和92%的92个关于转型的培训实例(图25)。 只有8个培训实例,它保留了59%的特征和68%的转型。 71% 71 % 和 66% 66 % 每个家庭的数值见表9。 所有这些分数都出现在训练中从未见到的例子上,因此,存储训练例子不能带来收益. 因此,几个培训实例足以实现基本模型已经存在的大部分行为。

blocks.en: Figure 25: Fraction of the gain kept when training on fewer training examples. The fraction of the gain at the largest training size that a shift adapter (purple) and a rank-8 LoRA (red) keep when trained on fewer training examples, scored on 200 200 held-out examples. Thick lines pool the 4 families and 3 seeds as a ratio of sums, thin lines show each family. (a) Traits. (b) Transformations. (c) Maps.
blocks.zh: 图25:培训中较少培训实例时收益的分数。 换班员(purple)和8级LORA(红色)在培训次数较少的情况下保持的最大培训规模收益的一小部分,在200个搁置的例子上得分。 细线将4个家庭和3个种子作为总和的比例,细线显示每个家庭。 (a) 特质。 (b) 转变。 (c) 地图。

blocks.en: Lookup tables. The maps are the opposite case. The base model has the capacity to look an entry up and answer with it, but the entries of a table are new content that it does not hold. The lookup maps the first letter of the input to one of 26 26 unrelated words, so a correct answer can only come from a key seen in training. Trained on 8 8 training examples, which cover 8 8 of the 26 26 keys, a shift adapter answers 28 % 28\% of the evaluation prompts whose key it saw, and 0.1 % 0.1\% of the prompts with one of the 18 18 keys it never saw ( Figure 26 ). A rank-8 LoRA behaves the same way ( 48 % 48\% and 0 % 0\% ). The cipher, which substitutes letters, behaves the same way too: it answers 69 % 69\% on letters seen in training and none on the others, and its fraction in Figure 25 c is high only because the 8 8 training examples start with the letters of most evaluation prompts. A shift adapter thus stores exactly the entries it was trained on, while on the behaviors it reaches most of its gain on examples it has never seen. This separates storing content from actualizing a capacity that the base model already holds.
blocks.zh: 查询表。 地图正好相反。 基础模型具有向上查找一个条目并用它回答的能力,但一个表格的条目是它没有的新内容. 检索图将输入的第一个字母映射到26个无关的单词中的一个,因此正确的答案只能来自训练中看到的密钥. 培训了8个培训实例,其中涵盖26个钥匙中的8个,一个班次适配器回答28%的28%评价提示它看到了钥匙,0.1%的0.1%的提示带有它从未见过的18个钥匙之一(图26)。 一个8级的LORA行为方式相同(48% 48 % 和0 % 0 % ). 取代字母的密码行为也一样:它回答69%的69QQ在训练中看到的字母上,没有回答其他的,它在图25c中的分数之所以高,只是因为8 8 训练例子从大多数评价提示的字母开始. 一个变换器将它所训练的条目 准确存储在它身上, 而关于它的行为,它得到的大部分收益 在它从未见过的例子。 这把存储内容与实现基本模型已经具备的能力区分开来。

The fraction of the gain at 80 80 training examples kept with 8 8 and 32 32 training examples on the traits and the transformations, and the held-out lookup accuracy with 8 8 training keys, on the keys seen in training and on the 18 18 unseen keys. Pooled over 3 seeds, the last row over the 4 families.
blocks.zh: 表9:按家庭分列的几个培训实例的换班者。 在80个培训实例中,有一部分保留了8个8个和32个32个关于特征和转变的培训实例,还有8个8个培训钥匙、培训中看到的钥匙和18个18个隐形钥匙的预留查询精度。 集合了3个种子, 最后一排超过4个家庭。

blocks.en: Figure 26: Lookup accuracy on keys seen and not seen in training. Held-out lookup accuracy of a shift adapter and a rank-8 LoRA trained on 8 8 of the 26 26 keys, on the keys seen in training (dark) and on the 18 18 unseen keys (light), per family, pooled over 3 seeds. The base model answers none of the keys.
blocks.zh: 图26:在培训中看到和没有看到钥匙的检查精度。 在26个钥匙中的8个钥匙、在训练中看到的钥匙(黑暗)和每个家庭汇集3个种子的18个18个隐形钥匙(光)上,对1个变速器和1个8级LORA进行了培训。 基础模型没有回答任何密钥.

blocks.en: Averaging over example sets. If a shift adapter stored its training examples, shift adapters trained on different examples would hold different content, and averaging them would cancel it. The three seeds of one behavior and family are trained on three disjoint sets of 8 8 training examples. We average their three shift adapters and evaluate the average on examples that none of the three was trained on, together with each single shift adapter in the same run. On the traits, the average keeps 59 % 59\% of the gain of the full-data shift adapter, compared to 47 % 47\% for a single one, and it is higher in each of the 4 families. A single shift adapter scaled to the norm of the average keeps 50 % 50\% , so the improvement comes from the direction the three share, not from a change of norm. Averaging shift adapters of different behaviors instead lowers the score below the base model. On the transformations, the average keeps as much as a single shift adapter ( 66 % 66\% and 65 % 65\% ). On the lookup, where each seed saw different keys, it keeps less ( 7 % 7\% against 10 % 10\% ).
blocks.zh: 检视实例集。 如果一个变位适配器存储其培训实例,接受不同实例培训的变位适配器会持有不同内容,平均它们会取消. 一种行为和家庭的三种种子被训练为三套脱节的8个训练实例. 我们平均使用三个班次适配器,并用三个班次中都没有受过训练的例子来评价平均情况,以及在同一跑道中每个单一班次适配器。 在特征方面,平均保留了全数据转换器收益的59%-59%%,而单一数据为47%-47%,这在4个家庭中都更高。 单调适配器被放大到平均保持50%50\%的规范,因此改进来自方向三股,而不是规范的变化. 不同行为的变换适配器反而将分数降低到基准模型以下. 在变换时,平均保持的与单班适配器一样多(66%66\%,65%65\%). 在看时,每个种子都看到不同的键,它保持较少(7% 7 == 10% 10 = ).

blocks.en: Shift adapters trained on disjoint examples therefore find the same direction, and averaging them removes what is specific to each set of examples and strengthens the behavior. What a shift adapter learns from a few training examples is the direction that actualizes the behavior, not the examples themselves.
blocks.zh: 因此,接受过脱节实例培训的Shift适配器找到相同的方向,平均它们消除了每组实例特有的内容,加强了行为. 一个转动适配器从几个训练实例中学到的,是实际行为的方向,而不是例子本身.

blocks.en: E.7 The shift adapter on the other tasks
blocks.zh: E.7 联合国 其他任务的换班器

blocks.en: The comparisons above evaluate each shift adapter on the task it is trained on. If a shift adapter improved the model in general, it would also raise the accuracy on the other tasks. We therefore evaluate every shift adapter on all 17 tasks, on the 18 models, and compare it to a random vector with the same norm at every layer. On its own task, the shift adapter raises accuracy by 0.124 0.124 [ 0.108 0.108 , 0.142 0.142 ] on average. On the 16 other tasks for which the shift adapter was not trained, accuracy changes by − 0.004 -0.004 [ − 0.011 -0.011 , + 0.002 +0.002 ] with the shift adapter and by − 0.004 -0.004 [ − 0.006 -0.006 , − 0.001 -0.001 ] with the random vector. The gain of a shift adapter is thus specific to the task it is trained on, and on average performance on other tasks remains at the base model’s accuracy.
blocks.zh: 上面的比较评价了每个调整器接受过培训的任务。 如果一个转向适配器总体上改进了模型,也会提高其他任务的准确性. 因此,我们评价所有17项任务中的每个转向适配器,在18个模型上,并将其与每个层都具有相同规范的随机矢量进行比较. 转向适配器在自己的任务中,平均提高精度0.124 0.124 [0.108 0.108,0.142 0142]. 在未训练转向适配器的其他16项任务上,精度变化为−0.004 - 0.004 [−0.011 - 0.011,+0.002+ 0.002] 与转向适配器的精度变化为−0.004 - 0.004 [−0.006 - 0.006,−0.001] 与随机向量的精度变化为−0.001 - 0.001]. 因此,转动适配器的收益是具体针对它所训练的任务的,平均而言,其他任务的业绩仍然是基准模型的准确性。

blocks.en:
To see when the two parts of the principle appear during training, we repeat the comparison of Section E.1 and the interventions of Section D.1 along the training of OLMo-2-7B, which AI2 publishes with more than 900 900 intermediate checkpoints. We use 15 15 : five of stage-one pretraining on Dolma, at 1 1 B, 9 9 B, 105 105 B, 449 449 B and 3,896 3{,}896 B tokens, six of the 50 50 B-token stage two that follows, at 5 5 B, 13 13 B, 21 21 B, 30 30 B, 38 38 B and 50 50 B tokens into it, from the first of the 3 stage-two runs whose average is the released base, and the released base, supervised, preference-tuned and instruct models.
Each checkpoint follows the protocol of Section C.5 on the 17 tasks: for each task and method a rate is selected from six on a validation slice of the training split at seed 0 0 , and every seed is trained on the whole training split at that rate and scored on the full evaluation split. The accuracy of the base model is the zero-shot accuracy of the checkpoint on the same split, read beside the split’s majority class. A run where neither method scores more than 0.02 0.02 above the majority class counts as a run in which the potentiality has not yet formed and stays in every average. The rank-8 LoRA of each run is then scored under the two interventions, with every run pooled and intervals clustered by task, since one checkpoint at 3 seeds has 17 17 independent units, the tasks, and not 51 51 . Table 10 lists every checkpoint, Figure 6 draws it, and Figure 27 draws the task types with the LoRA beside the shift adapter.

blocks.en: F.2 Behaviors along the training of OLMo-2-7B
blocks.zh: F.2 OLMo-2-7B训练沿线的行为

blocks.en: Beside the accuracy on the tasks, we count at each checkpoint how many of a fixed set of behaviors the model can be made to produce, by three routes: two demonstrations in the prompt, a trained shift adapter and a rank-8 LoRA, each adapter trained on 160 160 questions and read on 40 40 held-out ones.
blocks.zh: 除了任务上的准确性外,我们在每个检查点计算出可以使模型产生多少一套固定的行为,通过三条路线:即时的两个演示,一个经过训练的转向适配器和一个8级的LORA,每个适配器训练160个160个问题,40个被搁置的问题阅读.

blocks.en: Behaviors. Three classes of behavior can be scored without a teacher or a judgment. There are 49 49 non-Latin writing systems, that is, answering in a language written in its own non-Latin script, such as Thai, Kannada, or Bengali, scored by Unicode script property, 45 45 Latin-script languages, scored by a language identifier, and 42 42 output forms, scored by the predicate each instruction states, such as answering only in questions or only in bullets. The output forms follow the verifiable-instruction construction of IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) . Several are its instruction types directly: no commas, a word or sentence count, bullets or a JSON object, capital letters, a forbidden word or letter, and a response language. The others, such as a sonnet or a pros-and-cons table, are built the same way. Every check refuses a degenerate answer, one that is too short, too repetitive or a phrase repeated in a loop, since such an answer can pass a predicate without following the instruction: a repeated character of a script passes a check that reads the share of letters in that script.
blocks.zh: 行为者. 三类行为可以没有老师或判断就得分. 有49个非拉丁书写系统,即用自己非拉丁文字写成的语言回答,如泰语,坎纳达语,或孟加拉语,由Unicode脚本属性评分;45个拉丁语标注语言,由语言标识符评分;42个输出表,由上游每个指令状态评分,如只回答问题或只回答子弹. 输出形式遵循IFEval可核查的指令构造(周等,2023年). 有几个是其直接的指令类型:没有逗号,单词或句子计数,子弹或JSON对象,大写字母,被禁止的单词或字母,以及回应语言. 其他如"诗经"或"亲和表",皆以同道而建. 每张支票都拒绝一个堕落的答案,一个太短,太重复或者一个循环中重复的短语,因为这样的答案可以在不遵循指令的情况下通过一个上游:一个脚本的重复字符通过一个读取该脚本中字母比例的支票.

blocks.en: Criteria. A behavior is lifted when the adapter raises the model’s own rate on it by more than 0.05 0.05 over the 40 40 held-out answers ( Figure 29 a, b), and reached when the model produces it in a majority of its answers, the criterion the prompt is held to and the one Figure 29 c uses for both adapters.
blocks.zh: 标准。 当适配器在40个搁置的回答(图29 a,b)中将模型自身的速度提高0.05 0.05以上时,行为就会解除,当模型在多数答案中生成时,即能坚持标准,两个适配器都使用图29 c。

blocks.en: Training target and learning rate. A pretraining checkpoint’s own answers under a system prompt do not contain the behavior: at 9 9 B tokens they hold the requested script in 0 0 of 49 49 writing systems. We therefore train every checkpoint toward the instruct model’s answers to the same 160 160 questions, one target for every checkpoint, and score every answer against the instruction itself. That target produces 42 42 of the 49 49 writing systems, 38 38 of the 45 45 languages and 20 20 of the output forms, and those are the counts below. The learning rate is selected per checkpoint, class and method, from 4 rates for the shift adapter and 3 for the LoRA, with a higher rate added wherever the highest one won, as the rate that reaches the most behaviors at seed 0 0 , and every seed is read at it ( Section F.4 ).
blocks.zh: 培训目标和学习率。 在系统提示下预先训练检查点自己的答案并不包含行为:在9时9分的B标志上,他们持有49个写作系统中0个的所请求的脚本. 因此,我们训练每个检查站,以指示模式对160,160个相同的问题的答复,每个检查站一个目标,并且根据指示本身得到每个答复。 这一目标在49个49个书写系统中产生了42个42个,在45个45个语言中产生了38个,在20个产出中产生了20个。 每个检查站、班级和方法选择学习率,从轮班适配器的4个班级和LORA的3个班级和3个班级,只要获得最高的班级,就增加一个较高的班级,作为0号种子时行为达到最高的班级,每个班级都读(F.4节)。

blocks.en:
Results. At 1 1 B tokens OLMo-2-7B produces none of the 42 42 writing systems by any route. At 9 9 B tokens two demonstrations reach 16 16 of them, a rank-8 LoRA 40 40 to 41 41 across the seeds, and a trained shift adapter 5 5 to 6 6 . From 105 105 B tokens on, the three routes stay close to the whole set: the prompt between 30 30 and 41 41 , the shift adapter between 33 33 and 42 42 , and the LoRA between 40 40 and 42 42 at every later checkpoint ( Figure 29 c). At 7 further checkpoints between 9 9 B and 105 105 B tokens, a trained shift adapter reaches 6 6 , 10 10 , 22 22 , 21 21 , 29 29 , 30 30 , 32 32 , 39 39 and 41 41 of the 42 42 writing systems at 9 9 B, 13 13 B, 21 21 B, 30 30 B, 42 42 B, 55 55 B, 68 68 B, 84 84 B and 105 105 B tokens, while a rank-8 LoRA stays between 36 36 and 42 42 . A rank-8 LoRA reaches these writing systems at 9 9 B tokens only with both of its components, while the shared component that a shift adapter actualizes forms between 9 9 B and 105 105 B tokens, as the shift adapter reaches more of them ( Section F.11 ).
The other two classes follow the same order. On the 38 38 languages the prompt reaches 3 3 at 9 9 B tokens, the shift adapter 0 0 to 1 1 and the LoRA 31 31 to 34 34 , and at 105 105 B tokens the three reach 11 11 , 16 16 to 26 26 and 35 35 to 37 37 . On the 20 20 output forms the LoRA reaches 12 12 to 13 13 at 9 9 B tokens, against 3 3 to 4 4 for the shift adapter and 5 5 for the prompt, and from 105 105 B tokens on all three sit between 8 8 and 15 15 . Over all 100 100 behaviors the LoRA reaches 84 84 at 9 9 B tokens, the shift adapter 9 9 to 11 11 and the prompt 24 24 , and at the instruct model the three reach 90 90 to 91 91 , 88 88 to 93 93 and 82 82 ( Figure 29 b). OLMo-2-1B, a second model with two pretraining stages, repeats the measurement at 12 12 checkpoints with the same target and the same rate rule ( Figure 30 a). At 1 1 B tokens a rank-8 LoRA already reaches 38 38 to 39 39 of the 42 42 writing systems, where two demonstrations reach none and a trained shift adapter 0 0 to 2 2 . At 21 21 B tokens the prompt reaches 26 26 and the shift adapter 18 18 to 21 21 , and from 105 105 B tokens on the three routes stay between 28 28 and 42 42 , reaching 38 38 , 41 41 to 42 42 and 41 41 to 42 42 at the released base model.
Pythia-12B, trained on the Pile by EleutherAI without a second pretraining stage, has no instruct model of its own, so its adapters train toward the answers of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct to the same questions. A rank-8 LoRA reaches 39 39 to 40 40 of the 40 40 writing systems that target produces at every one of its 8 8 checkpoints, including the first at 2.1 2.1 B tokens, where the prompt and a trained shift adapter reach none ( Figure 30 b). A trained shift adapter reaches 4 4 to 8 8 at 6.3 6.3 B tokens, 19 19 to 22 22 at 16.8 16.8 B, 30 30 to 34 34 at 54.5 54.5 B and 32 32 to 39 39 from 170 170 B tokens on, against 24 24 to 37 37 for the prompt over the same range.
In all 3 models a rank-8 LoRA reaches these behaviors at the first checkpoint we measure, and a shift adapter reaches them later, in Pythia-12B after about 50 50 times more tokens. A constant thus actualizes a behavior once pretraining has formed the capacity for it, as the principle predicts, while a LoRA can reach it earlier by adding what the base model lacks ( Section F.11 ).

blocks.en: To locate the edge, we measure the 18 models and the setup’s 4 traits at 9 angles and 7 magnitudes near the trained scale. Adherence halves 44.1 ∘ 44.1^{\circ} from the trained direction. An edge is read per run as the point where the straight line between two neighboring grid points crosses the threshold, and we report the median over runs. On the 4 traits of the setup, on the 18 models, the edge at 90 % 90\% of the trained shift adapter’s gain runs from 0.83 0.83 to 1.25 1.25 times the trained magnitude and to 31.4 ∘ 31.4^{\circ} , and the edge at half the gain from 0.70 0.70 to 1.66 1.66 times and to 44.1 ∘ 44.1^{\circ} . The same grid on the 12 verifiable instruction types of IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , on the 18 models, puts the edge at 90 % 90\% of the gain from 0.92 0.92 to 1.05 1.05 times the trained magnitude and at 16.4 ∘ 16.4^{\circ} , and the edge at half the gain from 0.59 0.59 to 1.27 1.27 times and at 58.7 ∘ 58.7^{\circ} . There a program decides compliance with no teacher, and the shape is the same: a narrow band in magnitude and a wide one in direction. On the 5 rule behaviors of the setup, on the 18 models, the edge at 90 % 90\% of the gain runs from 0.70 0.70 to 1.40 1.40 times the trained magnitude and to 42.6 ∘ 42.6^{\circ} , and the edge at half the gain spans the whole measured range of magnitudes, 0.5 0.5 to 2 2 times, and reaches 58.1 ∘ 58.1^{\circ} . blocks.en: Write a perturbed state in the coordinates the perturbation itself uses, a component α ​ cos ⁡ θ \alpha\cos\theta along the trained direction and a component α ​ sin ⁡ θ \alpha\sin\theta across it. The second is exact, since the perturbation orthogonalizes the added direction against the trained one before rotating. The first alone sets the edge. One shared curve in α ​ cos ⁡ θ \alpha\cos\theta accounts for a median 0.617 0.617 of the variation within one run, against 0.239 0.239 for the distance from the trained state, 0.261 0.261 for the angle and 0.131 0.131 for the magnitude. On the traits, the band of α ​ cos ⁡ θ \alpha\cos\theta that holds half the peak runs from 0.70 0.70 to 1.66 1.66 ( 0.60 0.60 to 1.84 1.84 with the rule behaviors), and inside that band the fall-off changes by at most 0.16 0.16 of the peak as the across component grows to twice the trained norm ( 0.28 0.28 at any fixed α ​ cos ⁡ θ \alpha\cos\theta ). The angle at which adherence halves therefore climbs with magnitude, from 33.9 ∘ 33.9^{\circ} at 0.85 × 0.85\times to 44.1 ∘ 44.1^{\circ} at the trained magnitude and 70.0 ∘ 70.0^{\circ} at 2 × 2\times over the runs that still fall below half there, which is what a constant α ​ cos ⁡ θ \alpha\cos\theta predicts. A region is therefore a band in that one component: what a state keeps depends on how much of the trained direction it retains.

blocks.en: We measure how far the edge depends on the kind of direction the shift adapter is rotated toward. The magnitude is held at the trained one and the added direction is drawn three ways: at random, inside the span of the other traits’ shift adapters, and along another trait’s own shift adapter. On the 4 traits of the setup and the 18 models, the shift adapter keeps 90 % 90\% of its gain up to 31.3 ∘ 31.3^{\circ} toward a random direction, 23.8 ∘ 23.8^{\circ} toward a direction inside the span and 12.9 ∘ 12.9^{\circ} toward another trait’s shift adapter, and half of it up to 43.9 ∘ 43.9^{\circ} , 38.6 ∘ 38.6^{\circ} and 25.6 ∘ 25.6^{\circ} . On the 5 rule behaviors, turning toward another behavior’s state halves the gain at 36.0 ∘ 36.0^{\circ} and keeps 90 % 90\% up to 22.0 ∘ 22.0^{\circ} , against 58.1 ∘ 58.1^{\circ} and 42.6 ∘ 42.6^{\circ} toward a random direction ( Section F.7 ). A region is about twice as wide across the directions the model does not use for another trait as across the directions it does, and the random edge exceeds the other-trait edge in 205 205 of the 213 213 runs and in all 4 traits. The in-span edge sits below the random edge in every trait. On the traits of the setup, the random edge agrees with that of Section F.7 , 43.9 ∘ 43.9^{\circ} against 44.1 ∘ 44.1^{\circ} , on separate runs ( Figure 33 ).

blocks.en: Figure 34: The connectivity test. We score adherence at five points on the straight segment between two independently trained states of one behavior, and on a segment from one state toward a random direction of the same norm.
blocks.zh: 图34:连通性测试. 在两个独立训练的 行为状态之间的直段 和从一个状态向同一规范的随机方向的一段之间 我们得分五分

blocks.en: We score adherence along the straight segment between two states of one behavior trained at different seeds, on the 18 models. The test is sketched in Figure 34 . We summarize each path by its lowest interior point, as a share of the mean adherence of its two endpoints. The path stays adherent along its whole length: over 369 369 segments on 10 traits, the lowest interior point keeps a median 100 % 100\% of the endpoint gain ( 100 % 100\% on bullets and French, 156 156 segments, and 96 % 96\% on one word, the lowest trait), and the worst per-model mean barrier, over the segments scored at two evaluation seeds, is − 0.019 -0.019 (Mistral-7B), at endpoint cosines from 0.13 0.13 on Tulu-3-8B-SFT to 0.91 0.91 on Gemma-2-2B ( Figure 35 ). On the 5 rule behaviors of the setup, on the 18 models, the lowest interior point on the line between two trained states keeps a median 98 % 98\% of their gain, from 90 % 90\% on the cipher and 94 % 94\% on the lookup to 100 % 100\% on copy, while the same line toward a random direction of the same norm keeps 0 % 0\% . Two states that share a sixth of their direction still connect without a trough, so the states that produce one behavior form one connected region. The two states need not share their supervision. A state trained on external gold answers (the base model’s own answers translated by a separate machine-translation model) and one distilled from a system prompt stay connected in all 11 models, and this holds in each of 3 languages: the lowest interior point keeps a median 98 % 98\% of the endpoint gain in French and German and 100 % 100\% in Spanish, never below 86 % 86\% , with the target language above 0.87 0.87 at every midpoint, 33 33 of 33 33 model–language pairs. Both routes reach the language they were trained for, so no path is scored on a state that never produced it (lowest rate over the 33 33 runs per language 0.92 0.92 , 0.88 0.88 and 0.88 0.88 , medians 1.00 1.00 , 1.00 1.00 and 0.96 0.96 ). A random direction of the same norm connects in none of the 33 33 . The two states connect whether or not a nearest-neighbor ranking of their fields places them close: in French the gold state is the prompt state’s nearest neighbor in 6 6 of the 11 11 models and 2 2 nd to 18 18 th in 4 4 , and it connects even on Qwen2.5-0.5B, where the ranking puts it 249 249 th among the model’s trait states ( 13 13 th to 20 20 th in German).
