blocks.en: F.11 When the shared component forms during pretraining
blocks.zh: F.11 联合国 当共享组件在预训期间形成时

blocks.en: In the sections above, we showed that a rank-8 LoRA produces nearly every writing system (answering in a language written in its own non-Latin script) from the early checkpoints of OLMo-2-7B on, while a shift adapter produces them from 105 105 B tokens on ( Section F.1 ). This leaves two possibilities. A constant that produces the writing systems may already exist at 9 9 B tokens, and training a shift adapter from zero may not find it. Or no such constant exists yet, and the LoRA reaches the writing systems in another way. We can use the interventions defined in Section D.1 to distinguish the two, since they test whether the gain of the trained LoRA depends on its shared component.
blocks.zh: 在上文各节中,我们显示,从OLMo-2-7B的早期检查站起,8级LORA几乎每个书写系统(用它自己的非拉丁文写成的语言回答)都产生,而一个班次适配器则从105个105B的符号(F.1节)上产生。 这留下了两种可能性。 生成书写系统的常数可能已经在9 9 B 个符号上存在,而训练一个零的转动适配器可能找不到. 或者还没有这种常数存在,LORA以另一种方式到达了书写系统. 我们可以使用D.1节中定义的干预措施来区分两者,因为它们检验训练有素的LORA的收益是否取决于其共同组成部分.

blocks.en: Setup. We train on OLMo-2-7B at the checkpoints of 9 9 B and 105 105 B tokens, with the protocol of Section F.1 and 3 seeds. A writing system counts as produced when it appears in the majority of 40 40 held-out answers, and we count over the 42 42 writing systems of Section F.1 . We train every method anew at 3 seeds, so the counts differ by a few from Figure 29 . We compare the following states: • A rank-8 LoRA , evaluated in full, with only its shared component, and with its shared component removed. These interventions tell whether the gain of the trained LoRA rests on a constant. • A shift adapter trained from zero , as in Section F.1 . • A shift adapter started from the demonstrations. Its training starts from the shared component of two demonstrations of the target ( Section D.10 ) instead of from zero. If a suitable constant existed near the one the demonstrations give, training from there would find it more easily. • The demonstrations , given in the prompt, and their shared component added on its own. • A random vector with the same norm as the shift adapter at every layer. It shows that a vector of this size does not produce the writing systems by itself.
blocks.zh: 设置. 我们用OLMo-2-7B在9个9个B和105个105个B标志的检查站进行训练,并配有F.1节和3个种子。 写作系统在40个被搁置的答复中大多数出现时,都算作生成,我们计算了F.1节的42个42个写作系统。 我们用3个种子来训练各种方法, 我们比较了下列情况:一个级别为8级的、经过全面评估的、只有其共同组成部分的,以及其共同组成部分的去除。 这些干预措施表明,受过培训的LORA是否持续受益。 • 支助 F.1节规定,从零开始训练的变换器,从演示开始。 其培训从目标的两个演示(D.10节)的共同部分开始,而不是从零开始。 如果在示威活动附近有一个适当的常数,从那里得到的培训就会更容易。 示威活动迅速进行, • 支助 任意矢量,每层与转向适配器具有相同的规范. 它表明这种大小的矢量本身不会产生书写系统.

blocks.en: A rank-8 LoRA , evaluated in full, with only its shared component, and with its shared component removed. These interventions tell whether the gain of the trained LoRA rests on a constant.
blocks.zh: 一个8级LORA, 完全评价,只有其共同部分, 并删除其共同部分。 这些干预措施表明,受过培训的LORA是否持续受益。

blocks.en: A shift adapter trained from zero , as in Section F.1 .
blocks.zh: 如F.1节所述,接受零度调适器训练。

blocks.en: A shift adapter started from the demonstrations. Its training starts from the shared component of two demonstrations of the target ( Section D.10 ) instead of from zero. If a suitable constant existed near the one the demonstrations give, training from there would find it more easily.
blocks.zh: 从示威开始就有一个变换器。 其培训从目标的两个演示(D.10节)的共同部分开始,而不是从零开始。 如果在示威活动附近有一个合适的常数,从那里得到的训练会更容易。

blocks.en: The demonstrations , given in the prompt, and their shared component added on its own.
blocks.zh: 示威活动迅速进行,

blocks.en: A random vector with the same norm as the shift adapter at every layer. It shows that a vector of this size does not produce the writing systems by itself.
blocks.zh: 任意矢量,每层与转向适配器具有相同的规范. 它表明这种大小的矢量本身不会产生书写系统.

blocks.en: At 9 9 B tokens. The full LoRA produces 40 40 to 42 42 of the 42 42 writing systems ( Table 11 ). Its shared component alone produces none of them in any seed, and at most one at any learning rate we tried. Removing the shared component also leaves none. At this checkpoint, the LoRA thus reaches the writing systems only through both of its components together, and no part of its gain comes from a constant. The other constants agree: the shift adapter started from the demonstrations produces at most two, and the shared component of the demonstrations added on its own and the random vector produce none. Trained from zero, the shift adapter reaches 7 7 to 8 8 .
blocks.zh: 9块9B的纪念品 完整的LORA生产了42个42个书写系统中的40个40个至42个42个(表11)。 单是其共同的成分,就没有任何一种种子,而且最多只有一种,我们努力学习。 删除共享组件时, 也无保留 。 在这个检查站,LORA因此只能通过两个部件一起到达书写系统,其收益没有一部分来自常数. 其他常数同意:从演示开始的转向适配器最多产生2个,演示的共享组件单独添加,随机矢量则不产生任何. 从零开始训练,转向适配器达到7 7到8 8

blocks.en: Table 11: Writing systems produced on OLMo-2-7B at 9 9 B and 105 105 B tokens. Number of the 42 42 writing systems of Section F.1 produced in the majority of 40 40 held-out answers, for each of the 3 seeds. The demonstrations are two of the target’s own answers ( Section D.10 ), not those of Figure 29 , so their counts differ from that figure.
blocks.zh: 表11: OLMo-2-7B上以9个9B和105个105B令牌生产的书写系统. F.1节的42个42个书写系统的数目,大部分40个被搁置的答案,每个3个种子。 示威是目标本身的两个答案(D.10节),而不是图29的答案,因此其数量不同于该数字。

blocks.en: At 105 105 B tokens. The shared component of the LoRA alone now produces 37 37 to 40 40 writing systems, while removing it leaves none: the gain of the LoRA now rests entirely on its shared component. A shift adapter trained from zero produces 38 38 to 41 41 , nearly as many as the full LoRA ( 42 42 ), and one started from the demonstrations 24 24 to 33 33 ( Figure 39 ). The random vector still produces none.
blocks.zh: 在105B的标志。 单是LORA的共享组件,现在产生37个37至40个40个书写系统,而去除它则没有留下任何内容:LORA的收益现在完全依赖于其共享组件. 从零开始训练的转向架可产生38个38个到41个41个,几乎相当于全LORA(42个42个),其中一个是从示威24个24个到33个33个(图39)。 随机矢量仍然产生无.

blocks.en: Figure 39: Writing systems produced by each method at 9 9 B and 105 105 B tokens. Writing systems produced in a majority of 40 40 held-out answers by each method on OLMo-2-7B, bars the mean over 3 seeds and dots the seeds.
blocks.zh: 图39:每种方法在9个9个B和105个105个B令牌上生产的书写系统. 在OLMo-2-7B上的每种方法下,大多数40个搁置的回答中产生的写作系统,将3个以上种子的平均值封住,并点点种子。

blocks.en: The two checkpoints thus show when the capacity forms. At 9 9 B tokens, a LoRA already produces the writing systems, but not through a constant: neither its own shared component nor any other constant we tested produces them. At 105 105 B tokens, the LoRA’s own shared component produces almost all of them, and a shift adapter trained from zero finds a constant that does the same. The capacity that a constant can actualize therefore forms during pretraining, between 9 9 B and 105 105 B tokens. We measure this on the trained LoRA itself, through its interventions, so the result does not depend on whether training a shift adapter succeeds. The potentiality and actuality principle thus states not only how adaptation works, but also from which point in pretraining it applies.
blocks.zh: 因此,两个检查站显示能力何时形成。 在9 9 B 令牌上,一个 LORA 已经生产了书写系统,但不是通过一个常数:它自己的共享组件或者我们测试过的任何其他常数都没有生产出来. 在105 105 B令牌上,LORA自己的共享组件几乎全部生产出来,一个从零训练的转动适配器发现一个常数也一样. 因此,一个常数在预训期间能够实现的形式,介于9个9个B和105个105个B的标志之间。 我们用训练有素的LORA本身来衡量这一点,通过它的干预,结果并不取决于培训一个适应者是否成功。 因此,潜在性和实际性原则不仅说明适应如何运作,而且说明它从哪一点开始适用。

blocks.en: F.12 Predicting before adaptation whether an actualizing state exists
blocks.zh: F.12 在适应前预测是否存在实际状态

blocks.en: The potentiality and actuality principle says that a shift adapter actualizes a capacity that the base model already holds. If so, it should be possible to see in the base model, before any adapter is trained, whether an actualizing state exists for a task. We test this with a linear readout of the hidden states of the unadapted model.
blocks.zh: 潜在性和实际性原则说,转动适配器实现一个基础模型已经具备的能力. 如果是这样,在训练任何适配器之前,应该可以在基模中看到某项任务是否存在实际状态. 我们用一个线性读取 隐藏状态的不适应模型。

blocks.en: Setup. We use 6 6 rules that map a list of 1 1 to 12 12 pseudo-words to one of 3 3 answers: the word count modulo 3 3 , the word count mapped to the 3 3 answers by a fixed random table, the first letter mapped by such a table, the letter count and the vowel count modulo 3 3 , and random labels, which follow no rule. On 4 architecture families, we train a shift adapter on 10,000 10{,}000 inputs for each rule ( 300 300 or 1,000 1{,}000 for the random labels) and evaluate it on held-out inputs, whose words never appear in training. Separately, before any adaptation, we fit a linear readout that predicts the answer from the hidden states of the unadapted model. The readout is fit at every input position and at 6 depths, and its position and depth are chosen on validation inputs. A rule can sit at different positions: the first letter, for instance, is read without error at the first token of the input, but at only 0.12 0.12 to 0.30 0.30 at the last token.
blocks.zh: 设置. 我们使用6 6 规则,将1 1 至 12 个假名列表映射到3 3 个答案中的一个: 单词数 modulo 3 3 3 个,用固定随机表映射到3 3 个答案的单词数,用这种表映射的第一个字母,字母数和元音数 modulo 3 3 个,以及任意标签,没有遵循规则. 在4个建筑家庭,我们用10 000 10{,} 000 个规则的输入(300 300或1000 1{,} 000 个随机标签)来训练一个变换器,并在被搁置的输入上加以评价,其文字从未出现在训练中。 单独地,在任何适应之前,我们安装了一个线性读出,从未适应模型的隐藏状态中预测答案. 读出在每一个输入位置和6深处都是合适的,其位置和深度根据验证输入选择. 一个规则可以坐在不同的位置:例如,第一个字母在输入的第一个符号读时没有错误,但在最后一个符号读时只有0.120.12到0.300.30.

blocks.en: Figure 40: Held-out accuracy of the shift adapter against a linear readout of the base model. For 6 6 rules on 4 architecture families, means over 3 seeds. Dotted lines mark chance, the solid line equality.
blocks.zh: 图40:转动适配器的挂载精度相对于基型的线性读出. 对于6条6条关于4个建筑家族的规则,意味着超过3个种子. 虚线标志机会,固线平等.

blocks.en: Results. For every rule that a shift adapter learns, the readout of the base model already recovers the answer ( Table 12 ). On the first letter, the word count, and the relabelled length, the shift adapter reaches 0.70 0.70 to 1.00 1.00 on held-out inputs, and the readout 0.77 0.77 to 1.00 1.00 . On the letter count, the vowel count, and the random labels, the readout stays near chance, and so does the shift adapter, as the principle predicts ( 0.31 0.31 to 0.40 0.40 , with chance at 0.33 0.33 ). Across all 24 24 pairs of rule and model, no shift adapter learns a rule that the readout of the base model does not already recover ( Figure 40 ). Across the 24 24 pairs, the accuracy of the shift adapter follows that of the readout, at a Pearson correlation of 0.98 0.98 and a Spearman correlation of 0.84 0.84 .
blocks.zh: 结果。 对于一个变位适配器学习的每一个规则,基模型的读出已经恢复答案(表12). 在第一个字母上,字数,以及重新标注的长度,转向适配器在被搁置的输入上达到0.70 0.70到1.00 1.00,读出0.77 0.77到1.00 1.00. 在字母计数上,元音计数,以及随机标注,读出时会保持接近概率,转动适配器也是如此,如原理预测(0.31 0.31至0.40 0.40,概率为0.33 0.33). 在所有24个24对规则和模型中,没有一个转向适配器学习到一个基本模型的读取尚未恢复的规则(图40)。 在24个24对中,转动适配器的精度跟随读出时的精度,在皮尔逊关联0.980.98和斯皮尔曼关联0.840.84.

blocks.en: Table 12: Accuracy of the shift adapter and of a linear readout of the base model. Held-out accuracy of the shift adapter (shift) and of a linear readout of the unadapted model (readout), for 6 6 rules with 3 3 answers each, chance 0.33 0.33 . Means over 3 seeds, except the random labels, trained on 300 300 or 1,000 1{,}000 inputs with 1 to 3 seeds.
blocks.zh: 表12:转动适配器的精确度和基准模型的线性读取度。 转向适配器(转动)和未调整型号的线性读出(读出)的挂出精度,对于6条6条规则,每条3个答案,概率0.330.33. 是指超过3个种子,除了随机标注,训练300300或1000 1{,}000个输入,配有1-3个种子.

blocks.en: Where adaptation has to add. The readout also indicates in advance where an actualizing state does not exist, and adaptation has to add to the base model. On the vowel count, which the readout does not recover, a rank-8 LoRA reaches 0.43 0.43 and 0.48 0.48 on Llama-3.2-3B and Qwen2.5-1.5B, and a rank-64 LoRA 0.55 0.55 and 0.52 0.52 , while the shift adapter stays near chance, at 0.37 0.37 and 0.36 0.36 . A LoRA can add what the base model lacks, while a constant, as the principle predicts, actualizes only what the base model holds.
blocks.zh: 适应必须添加的地方。 读出还预示了不存在实际状态的地方,适应必须加入基础模型. 在读出后无法恢复的元音计数上,Llama-3.2-3B和Quen2.5-1.5B上的一级8 LoRA达到0.43 0.43和0.48 0.38,而一级-64 LoRA 0.55 0.55和0.52 0.52 0.52,而转向适配器则停留在几近概率,分别为0.37 0.37和0.36 0.36. 一个LORA可以添加基模型所缺少的东西,而一个常数,如原理所预测,只能实现基模型所持有的东西.

blocks.en: A shift adapter thus actualizes what the base model already represents, and whether an actualizing state exists can be estimated on the base model before adaptation. Together with Section F.11 , this suggests a condition for the potentiality and actuality principle: a capacity can be actualized once the base model represents what the task needs, and the base model comes to represent it during pretraining.
blocks.zh: 转动适配器从而实现基准模型已经表达的内容,以及是否在适应之前可以在基准模型上估计实际状态。 与F.11节一起,这暗示了潜在性和实际性原则的一个条件:一旦基础模型代表了任务需要,就能够实现能力,基础模型在预训时会来代表它.

blocks.en: Appendix G Implications
blocks.zh: 附录G

blocks.en: G.1 Steering: extraction against training
blocks.zh: 组1 指导:从训练中提取

blocks.en: Steering adds a vector to the hidden states of the model. We compare vectors extracted without training with the shift adapter trained on the same behavior, on the 9 behaviors of the setup and the 18 models.
blocks.zh: 引导在模型的隐藏状态中增加了一个向量. 我们比较了未经训练提取的矢量 和接受过相同行为训练的 转向适配器 关于设置的9个行为和18个模型

blocks.en: Experimental setup. Three extraction methods give one steering vector per behavior: the mean difference of CAA ( Rimsky et al., 2024 ) , the leading principal component of the same differences ( Zou et al., 2023 ) , and the in-context task vector ( Hendel et al., 2023 ) . Each is added at the single best layer or at every layer, 6 variants in all, each added the way the shift adapter adds its vectors, one vector per layer. An extracted vector gives a direction but not a strength, so the strength of each variant is chosen from 5 values on 200 200 held-out instructions, and every method is scored on 800 800 further held-out instructions. The shift adapter trains on 400 400 instructions for 200 200 steps. For each run, the best extracted direction is the variant with the highest adherence on the 800 800 instructions, a choice that favors extraction. Scores follow Section C.6 : adherence on the traits, where 0 0 is the base model, and the exact-match rate on the transformations and maps.
blocks.zh: 实验设置. 三种提取方法给每个行为一个方向矢量:CAA的平均值差(Rimsky等人,2024年),相同差异的主要主要成分(Zou等人,2023年),以及内文本任务矢量(Hendel等人,2023年). 每层都是在单层最佳或每层添加,总共6个变体,每个变体都增加了转向适配器添加矢量的方式,每层一个矢量. 提取的向量给出方向而非强度,因此每个变体的强度从200个被搁置指令的5个值中选择,每个方法在800800个被进一步搁置指令上的得分. 转向架适配器列车按400400指令200200步运行. 对于每次运行,最好的提取方向是800800指令遵守率最高的变体,这个选择有利于提取. 分数跟随C.6节:对特征的坚持,其中00为基模型,在变换和地图上的精确比率.

blocks.en: Table 13: Extracted directions against the trained shift adapter on the setup. Held-out score on 800 800 instructions per run (adherence on the traits, exact match on the transformations and maps), mean over runs with a bootstrap 95 % 95\% interval over models. The best extracted direction is the best of the 6 extracted variants in each run.
blocks.zh: 表13:针对设置上训练有素的转向适配器提取方向. 每跑800,800个指令被搁置(遵守特征、转换和地图上的准确匹配),意味着在模型上95%的95%的间隔中被拖走。 最好的提取方向是每次运行中6个提取的变体中最好的.

blocks.en: Results. Pooled over the 9 behaviors, the trained shift adapter reaches a score of 0.68 0.68 [ 0.62 0.62 , 0.72 0.72 ], against 0.17 0.17 [ 0.14 0.14 , 0.20 0.20 ] for the best extracted direction ( Table 13 ). Per class, the shift adapter reaches 0.45 0.45 on the traits against 0.20 0.20 , 0.87 0.87 on the transformations against 0.10 0.10 , and 0.83 0.83 on the maps against 0.23 0.23 . The extracted directions come close to the trained shift adapter only on bullet points ( 0.88 0.88 against 0.89 0.89 ), and stay at or below the base model on French, pirate and grumpy critic, where the shift adapter reaches 0.19 0.19 to 0.43 0.43 . On the transformations and maps, the best extracted direction reaches at most 0.43 0.43 , on the cipher, against 0.78 0.78 to 0.99 0.99 for the shift adapter.
blocks.zh: 结果。 组合在9个行为上,训练有素的转向适配器达到0.68 0.68[0.62 0.62,0.72 0.72]的分数,对0.17 0.17 [0.14 0.14,0.20 0.20]的最佳提取方向(表13). 每类,转向适配器在特征上达到0.45 0.45对0.200.27,在变换上达到0.870.87对0.100.10,在地图上达到0.830.83对0.230.23. 提取方向接近训练后的转向适配器只在弹点上(0.88 0.88对0.89 0.89),并停留在法国,海盗和暴躁评论家的基模上或以下,转向适配器达到0.190.19对0.430.430.43. 在变换和地图上,最好的提取方向最多达到0.43 0.43 ,在密码上达到0.78 0.78 到 0.99 0.99 的转动适配器.

blocks.en: G.2 Steering on AxBench
blocks.zh: G.2 指导Ax Bench

blocks.en: Figure 41: A shift adapter steers close to the LoRA on AxBench. The 500 500 concepts of AxBench on Gemma-2-2B, a shift adapter against a rank-8 LoRA, paired per concept, at the rates the judged steering score selects. (a) Adherence, the score of the main text: the overlap of the generation with the reference answer, as a gain over the base model. (b) Steering score, the benchmark’s judge on each generation. (c) Concept detection, the area under the curve of the trained state read as a probe, with chance as dashed lines. In each panel, Δ \Delta is the mean over concepts of the shift adapter’s score minus the LoRA’s.
blocks.zh: 图41:一个转向适配器在Ax Bench上向靠近LORA方向行驶. Ax Bench在Gemma-2-2B上的500个概念,一个班次适配器与一个等级为8的LORA相对应,按判断方向分数所选择的速率对准每个概念. (a) 坚持,正文的分数:生成与参考答案的重叠,作为比基模型的增益. (b) 指导评分,每一代的基准评分。 (c) 概念探测,训练状态曲线下的区域读作探测器,机会为破折线。 在每张面板中,\\Delta是当值适配器的得分减去LORA的得分的比值。

blocks.en:
AxBench ( Wu et al., 2025 ) steers on 500 500 concepts drawn from a sparse autoencoder of Gemma-2, each a text description with positive and negative examples. We train a shift adapter and a rank-8 LoRA on Gemma-2-2B for every concept, 6 rates for the shift adapter and 4 for the LoRA, and score them on the two axes of the benchmark. Steering is judged by GPT-4o-mini, the benchmark’s judge model, on each generation with its prompts unchanged: the presence of the concept, the relevance to the instruction and the fluency, each from 0 0 to 2 2 , combined by their harmonic mean. Detection is the concept-against-negative separation the trained state gives when read as a probe. Each method’s rate is the one with the best steering score, chosen for every concept on the other 499 499 concepts, so that a concept never takes part in choosing its own rate. This gives 3 × 10 − 2 3\times 10^{-2} for the shift adapter and 6 × 10 − 4 6\times 10^{-4} for the LoRA on every concept, and both ranges continue past these rates. Each concept is judged on its own held-out instructions at 64 64 generated tokens, where the benchmark’s leaderboard judges 10 10 fixed instructions at 128 128 tokens, so our levels are not its leaderboard numbers and the comparison is between the two methods under one protocol.
On the benchmark’s steering score the shift adapter reaches 0.867 0.867 and the LoRA 0.914 0.914 , a paired difference of − 0.047 -0.047 [ − 0.072 , − 0.021 ] [-0.072,-0.021] over the 500 500 concepts, − 0.05 -0.05 , − 0.06 -0.06 and − 0.04 -0.04 on the seeds ( Figure 41 b). On adherence to the reference answer, the score of the main text, the shift adapter reaches 0.064 0.064 against 0.073 0.073 for the LoRA, a paired difference of − 0.009 -0.009 [ − 0.011 , − 0.007 ] [-0.011,-0.007] ( Figure 41 a). At the rate the judge selects, the shift adapter puts the concept into more of its answers and keeps less of the reference wording, and at 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} its adherence is 0.090 0.090 , above the LoRA’s. On the presence of the concept alone the shift adapter scores 0.965 0.965 and the LoRA 0.983 0.983 , and on the other two judged scores it is below the LoRA, by 0.09 0.09 on relevance to the instruction and by 0.02 0.02 on fluency. On detection the shift adapter reaches an area under the curve of 0.571 0.571 , above chance on 374 374 of the 500 500 concepts, and the LoRA 0.686 0.686 , above chance on 464 464 , a difference of − 0.115 -0.115 [ − 0.126 , − 0.105 ] [-0.126,-0.105] ( Figure 41 c). The rate moves the three scores apart: from 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} to 3 × 10 − 2 3\times 10^{-2} the steering score rises from 0.851 0.851 to 0.867 0.867 , while adherence falls from 0.090 0.090 to 0.064 0.064 and the area under the curve from 0.607 0.607 to 0.571 0.571 . A shift adapter steers within 6 % 6\% of the LoRA, and the state of the LoRA separates the concept from its negatives better.

Extracted directions on the same protocol. We compare the trained methods with 3 directions extracted without training, as in Section 5 , on the same concepts and under the same protocol.
The mean difference is, at every decoder block, the mean hidden state over the response tokens of the concept’s 48 48 training examples minus the mean over those of the 64 64 shared negatives, AxBench’s DiffMean and the contrast of CAA.
The principal component is the leading component of the same positives centered on the negative mean, sign-aligned with the mean difference ( Zou et al., 2023 ) .
The in-context direction is the last-token displacement that a prompt of 4 of the concept’s examples induces over the bare prompt, averaged over 16 16 of its instructions ( Hendel et al., 2023 ) .
Each direction is added the way the shift adapter adds its vectors, one vector per block, the unit direction at a block scaled by a multiple of the base model’s activation norm there, at every block or, for the mean difference, at AxBench’s block 20 20 alone.
The multiples bracket the best value ( 0.005 0.005 to 0.08 0.08 at every block, 0.02 0.02 to 0.8 0.8 at one block), the multiple of each direction is the smallest one within 0.005 0.005 of the best steering score, chosen for every concept on the other 499 499 concepts, the rule that selects the trained methods’ rates, and each direction is judged on the same two held-out instructions per concept as the trained methods. Table 14 gives the result.
The best extracted direction, the mean difference at every block, reaches a steering score of 0.207 0.207 at multiple 0.04 0.04 and 0.017 0.017 at 0.08 0.08 , where the generations degenerate. At block 20 20 it reaches 0.180 0.180 , the principal component 0.160 0.160 and the in-context direction 0.166 0.166 .
The trained shift adapter reaches 0.867 0.867 and the LoRA 0.914 0.914 on the same concepts, a paired difference of − 0.660 -0.660 [ − 0.697 , − 0.623 ] [-0.697,-0.623] between the best extracted direction and the shift adapter.
On the concept sub-score the extracted directions reach 0.16 0.16 to 0.26 0.26 against 0.97 0.97 for the shift adapter, and they raise the steering score above zero on 76 76 to 132 132 of the 500 500 concepts against 435 435 for the shift adapter and 446 446 for the LoRA. Their relevance sub-scores are above those of the trained methods, and so is their fluency, except for the mean difference at every block ( 0.79 0.79 ).
The level of the mean difference at block 20 20 , 0.180 0.180 , is the level the benchmark’s own board reports for it, 0.178 0.178 ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , under a protocol that differs in the instructions and the length judged.

blocks.en: Conventions. The permutation test of each of the 91 91 pairs in Section 5 is a pairwise comparison and carries no family-wise correction. Every comparison of the 14 atlases uses the 75 75 behaviors that every atlas holds ( Section C.4 ). The association with capability is unchanged ( ρ = 0.68 \rho=0.68 ) when capability is measured in bits per byte instead of log-likelihood per token. RSA and mutual- k k NN rise with the capability of the pair and CKA does not ( Figure 42 ): over the 91 91 pairs, RSA at Spearman ρ = 0.68 \rho=0.68 ( p = 0.003 p=0.003 ), mutual- k k NN at ρ = 0.40 \rho=0.40 ( p = 0.033 p=0.033 ) and CKA at ρ = − 0.38 \rho=-0.38 ( p = 0.93 p=0.93 ), each p p from a one-sided permutation of the model labels. The 3 measures differ in what they cannot see. RSA ranks the cosines between states, so it does not see one state rescaled or the cosines changed in any order-preserving way. CKA centers the atlas first, so it does not see the atlas moved as a whole or rescaled. Mutual- k k NN reads neighbor sets, so it does not see any change that leaves each state’s neighbors in place. A rotation of the coordinates is invisible to all three: a similarity between two atlases reads the pattern of distances among their states, not their coordinates, which differ from model to model. Figure 43 draws the similarity over the 91 91 pairs and through depth.
blocks.zh: 公约。 第5节91对每对的穿梭试验是双向比较,不带家庭式修正。 14个地图集的每个比较都采用每个地图集所持有的75个75个行为(C.4节). 当能力按每字节比特计量,而不是按每令牌的对数比特计量时,与能力的关联不变(ρ=0.68\rho=0.68). RSA和相互-k k NN随配对的能力而上升,CKA不上升(图42):91-91对以上,RSA在Spearman ^ = 0.68\rho = 0.68(p = 0.003 p = 0.003),相互-k k K NN在 ^ 0.40\rho (p = 0.033 p = 0.033),CKA在 ^ → 0.38\rho =-0.38 (p = 0.93),每页均从模型标签的单侧穿透而来. 这三项措施在它们无法看到的方面有所不同。 RSA在州与州之间对宇宙圈进行排序,因此它不会看到一个州重新调整或宇宙圈以任何保持秩序的方式改变. CKA首先将地图集集中起来,因此它不认为地图集整体移动或重新缩放. KNN读取邻居的设定, 坐标的旋转对于所有三个都是看不见的:两个地图集之间的相似性读取了它们各邦之间的距离的规律,而不是它们的坐标,它们因模型而异. 图43显示了91对和深度的相似性。

blocks.en: Gan and Isola (2026) add Gaussian noise of a fixed size to every weight of a pretrained model, score each perturbed model on a selection split, and keep the best, which they call experts. Under the principle, a perturbation finds an expert only where the region of actualizing states of the behavior is wide enough to be hit by chance ( Section 5 ). We repeat their search on the setup and relate where it finds experts to the size of the region measured in Section F.7 .
blocks.zh: 甘和伊索拉(2026年)将固定大小的高斯噪声加入预训模型的每个重量,在选择分数上给每个扰动模型打分,并保持最佳,他们称之为专家. 根据该原则,只有在行为状态实际化的区域足够广,足以偶然受到打击的情况下,才会发现一名专家(第5节)。 我们重复对设置的搜索,并将专家发现的地方与F.7节所测区域的规模联系起来。

blocks.en: Experimental setup. For each model we draw 300 300 perturbed models at each noise size, 6 sizes for GSM8K, the task of Gan and Isola (2026) , and 3 for each of the 9 behaviors of the setup (5 GSM8K sizes for Tulu-3-8B-SFT, and 3 and 2 for the Qwen2.5-7B base model), with the sizes placed per model in units of the displacement they cause in the hidden state. Each perturbed model is scored on a selection split of 32 32 items, and the 20 20 best are scored again on a disjoint held-out split of 64 64 items. A perturbed model is an expert when it still answers fluently (distinct-2 of at least 0.5 0.5 ) and gains at least 0.10 0.10 over the base model on the held-out split. For each model, task and seed, the expert fraction is the share of the 20 20 re-scored models that are experts, at the noise size with the highest mean share over the other two seeds of the same model and task, so that the size is never chosen on the seed it is read on.
blocks.zh: 实验设置. 对于每个型号,我们在每个噪声大小上画300,300个扰动型号,GSM8K的6个大小,甘和伊索拉的任务(2026年),以及设置的9个行为(图鲁-3-8B-SFT的5个GSM8K大小,Quen2.5-7B基型的3个和2个),每个型号的大小被放置在它们导致的隐藏状态的迁移单元中. 每个扰动型号在32个32项的选配分上得分,20个最佳型号再次在64个64项的脱节搁置分中得分. 扰动模型是专家,当它仍然能流利地回答(至少0.5 0.5 的歧义-2),并在被搁置的分裂上比基模型获得至少0.10 0.10的增益. 对于每个模型,任务和种子,专家分数是20个20个重排模型中作为专家的分数,其噪声大小与同一模型和任务的其他两个种子相比平均分数最高,因此在读取的种子上从未选择大小.

blocks.en: Where the search finds experts. On GSM8K the expert fraction is 0.20 0.20 on average over the 18 models. It is highest on Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen3.5-9B ( 0.87 0.87 each) and the Qwen2.5-7B base model ( 0.68 0.68 ), followed by Qwen3.5-4B ( 0.38 0.38 ), Qwen2.5-7B ( 0.25 0.25 ), Llama-3.1-8B ( 0.22 0.22 ), Tulu-3-8B-SFT ( 0.18 0.18 ) and Qwen3.6-27B ( 0.12 0.12 ), and at most 0.03 0.03 on the other 10 models. On the behaviors of the setup it is 0.013 0.013 on average: the search finds experts on 12 pairs of model and behavior in 8 models (copy and the conditional echo on the base models of Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-2B and Qwen2.5-7B, the conditional echo on Qwen2.5-3B, the conditional echo and bullets on Qwen2.5-0.5B, and bullets on Qwen2.5-1.5B, Qwen2.5-7B and SmolLM2-1.7B), and none in the other models.

blocks.en: Experts and the size of the region. In the 18 models, the behaviors on which the search finds an expert have wider regions than those on which it finds none ( Figure 44 ). Over the 72 72 pairs of model and behavior in the 8 models where the search finds any expert, the region size separates the two at an AUC of 0.82 0.82 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and correlates with the expert fraction at Spearman + 0.43 +0.43 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Over all pairs in the 18 models, the same values are 0.79 0.79 and + 0.27 +0.27 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 each). Split into quartiles of region area, the search finds an expert in 0 % 0\% of the pairs of the narrowest quartile (mean area 0.29 0.29 ), then in 3 % 3\% and 10 % 10\% , and in 17 % 17\% of the widest (mean area 0.71 0.71 ). The 12 expert pairs have regions covering 0.39 0.39 to 0.85 0.85 of the grid, and French, pirate and grumpy critic, the three behaviors with the narrowest regions, hold no expert in any model.

The dashed diagonal is a full match. The stars are the trained shift adapter (purple) and LoRA (red) references, whose own answers a shift adapter recovers.

blocks.en: Relation to trained states. We compare the experts on GSM8K with a shift adapter trained on GSM8K, and the two arrive at the same state. Their fields point the same way: over the 328 328 experts, the median cosine between an expert’s field and the trained adapter’s field is 0.23 0.23 . They solve the same problems: of the held-out problems an expert solves beyond the base model, the trained adapter solves 1.36 1.36 times as many as chance would give, and more than chance for 91 % 91\% of the experts ( Figure 45 a). A shift adapter trained on an expert’s answers keeps 48 % 48\% of the experts’ improvement, measured on a separate split of GSM8K that played no part in selecting the experts (a ratio of sums over the 328 328 experts distilled), where the same training on the trained adapter’s own answers keeps 92 % 92\% ( Figure 45 b).
blocks.zh: 与训练有素的州的关系。 我们比较GSM8K上的专家和接受过GSM8K上训练的转向适配器,两人到达同一状态. 他们的球场同样指向:超过328,328位专家,专家球场与训练有素的适配器球场之间的中位余弦为0.230.23. 他们解决了同样的问题:在专家解决的超出基准模型的被搁置问题中,受过训练的适配器解决的机会是机会的1.361.36倍,91%的91.%的专家解决的机会不止(图45a)。 接受过专家回答培训的换班员保留了专家改进的48 % , 其衡量标准是:在挑选专家时没有发挥作用的GSM8K的分数(与328,328名专家的分数之比), 接受过培训的换班员自己回答的同一培训保持了92% 92 % (图45 b)。
